items.title: Star Collector: Enchantment of the Western Med
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 16 Days Apr 18 – May 04, 2026 16 Days Apr 11 – Apr 27, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the best Western Mediterranean ports in detail during this cruise through Italy, Monaco, France, Spain, Gibraltar, and Portugal. Stroll among opulent casinos, high-end boutiques, and historic Formula One landmarks in Monte Carlo. Sip wormwood-based absinthe in the French village of Antibes outside of Cannes. Or meander among the dusky walls and long shadows in Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, taking in the aromas, sights and sounds of the Catalonian heart of Spain.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Enchantment of the Western Med

items.title: Star Collector: Riviera Rhapsody
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Venice on Wind Surf 25 Days Apr 18 – May 13, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Oohs and ahhs over the sublime scenery alternate with oohs and ahhs over magnificent manmade creations on this voyage along the Dalmatian Coast, Ligurian Riviera, Côte d’Azur, and Costa del Sol. This is a stretch where Blue Flag beaches jostle for elbow space and castles, palaces and cathedrals take every form known to man. This is where the imaginations of Cezanne, Monet, Matisse and Picasso were ignited. Here is where great romances blossomed: Richard Burton and Elizabeth Taylor in Portofino; Princess Grace and Prince Rainier in Monte Carlo. Sail through waters where the legendary sirens are said to live, play a game of picign with gregarious Croatians. Our yachts take you to less-visited ports like Sanary-sur-Mer, and get you closer to town than the big ships can get in places like Dubrovnik, Venice, Barcelona and Málaga.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Riviera Rhapsody

items.title: Spanish Symphony
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Barcelona on Wind Surf 8 Days Apr 18 – Apr 26, 2026 8 Days Jun 22 – Jun 30, 2026 8 Days Mar 17 – Mar 25, 2027 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Poised as if to kiss the continent of Africa, Andalusia hugs the southern coast of Spain and embraces cultural influences from both sides of the strait. This is the birthplace of Don Juan and Carmen, evening paseos by women in lace mantillas, cape-twirling matadors. In short, it is quintessential Spain. The beaches of the Costa del Sol are legendary. And behind lie equally magnificent mountain ranges sheltering picturesque “white villages.” Here you won’t find cookie-cutter castles, but amazing cultural amalgams like the Alhambra and Alcázar. On your elegant ship, you will cruise past larger ships right to the heart of old towns and to the steps of friendly bodegas.
items.tourOgTitle: Spanish Symphony

items.title: Star Collector: Pacific Coast Passage: Costa Rican Rainforests to Seattle's Evergreen Shores
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to Seattle, Wa on Star Seeker 16 Days Apr 20 – May 06, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a voyage from Costa Rica to Seattle, blending nature, culture, and cuisine. Start with a tour of Curú National Wildlife Refuge, exploring tropical forests and mangroves on foot or in kayaks. Move up the coast to relax on Playa del Coco’s beach or indulge your adventurous spirit while snorkeling or ziplining. In Mexico, visit Puerto Chiapas coffee plantation and taste the local liquors, coffee, chocolate, and mole of Mexico. In Huatulco, visit the Izapa Mayan Ruins, then from Manzanilla, explore Comala's historic town, where you can sample the local ponche (similar to tequila). When you arrive in Puerto Vallarta, enjoy beach time, explore the old town, and devour delicious tacos. Rejuvenate your body and mind with onboard spa treatments or a morning yoga class. Your expedition ends in Seattle, with Pacific Northwest coffee, world-class art, and an eclectic culinary scene.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Pacific Coast Passage: Costa Rican Rainforests to Seattle's Evergreen Shores

items.title: Star Collector: Mayan Monuments & Alaskan Glaciers
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to Juneau, Ak on Star Seeker 25 Days Apr 20 – May 15, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a voyage of natural and cultural contrasts ranging from Costa Rican rainforests to snow-capped peaks and turquoise-tinged Alaskan glaciers. Join a naturalist outside Curu for an exclusive private tour to see sloths, anteaters, howler monkeys, and tropical birds. Ply the quiet mangrove waters in a six-person boat beyond Puerto Chiapas in search of exotic birds, then visit with local fishermen who share their routines and daily challenges. Indulge in a Huatulco steam bath in the tradition of ancient Mayans. Sample fresh fish and tasty truffles at Seattle's iconic Farmer's Market. Wander one of North America's oldest and largest Chinatowns in Vancouver and savor delicious dim sum. Drop a line in the waters of Tongass National Forest and cook your Alaskan seafood catch with the help of a skilled Ketchikan chef. Kayak past sparkling ice floes to Tracy Arm's colossal glaciers.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Mayan Monuments & Alaskan Glaciers

items.title: Creatures & Cultures of Costa Rica & Mexico
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to Puerto Vallarta on Star Seeker 8 Days Apr 20 – Apr 28, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Live out your dreams of ziplining through the Costa Rican rainforest, and explore the Mexican Riviera from Mayan ruins to mezcal on this 8-night voyage. Costa Rica’s biodiversity and natural beauty astounds, and you’ll experience it at its best with three Costa Rican ports, two of which are Windstar exclusives: Playas del Coco and Curú Wildlife Reserve. Wade ashore in a “wet landing” at Curú, then follow your guide in search of rare rainforest creatures. Snorkel the pure waters of Playas del Coco. Go sport fishing in Manzanillo. And get a three-dimensional picture of Mexico’s wonderful culture as you travel from Mayan temples to small fishing villages. As an added bonus, you’ll sail this region in April — widely considered one of the best months to visit, as the dry season is ending, and waters are at their clearest.
items.tourOgTitle: Creatures & Cultures of Costa Rica & Mexico

items.title: Tulip Season in Holland & Belgium
items.journeyText: Journey from Amsterdam to Amsterdam on Star Pride 7 Days Apr 21 – Apr 28, 2026 7 Days Apr 28 – May 05, 2026 7 Days Apr 22 – Apr 29, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Visit Holland at the height of tulip season on this Northern Europe cruise, when the country’s fields explode in vibrant swaths of every imaginable color. Wander through the enchanting Keukenhof Gardens, home to millions of blooms. Then, set off on a coastal voyage to small countryside cities. Explore the quaint streets of Harlingen — a small-ship exclusive — and wander along its old canals, merchant houses and charming little alleys. Rotterdam offers a mix of modernity and history, with its bustling seaport and the timeless beauty of The Hague. Enjoy an overnight in Antwerp, whose exclusive seaport accepts only one ship per day, and explore the city’s rich artistic heritage — and the world’s largest Diamond District. From the culinary delights of Bruges to the architectural wonders of Ghent, each call is a chapter in a story of discovery and delight.
items.tourOgTitle: Tulip Season in Holland & Belgium

items.title: Mediterranean Island Mosaic
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 8 Days Apr 22 – Apr 30, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Hidden harbors. Legendary landmarks. Everything that makes the Mediterranean magical. This voyage has it all. The colorful kaleidoscopes of Rome and Barcelona invite you to celebrate their high-spirited energy, while the seductive scent of oranges and olives that perfumes the enchanting islands of Elba, Corsica, Mallorca, and Menorca entices you to explore their seductive secrets. From the wild green mountains of Mallorca to the striking white pebble beaches of Portoferraio – let us delight your senses and ignite your imagination.
items.tourOgTitle: Mediterranean Island Mosaic

items.title: Star Collector: Twice the Tahiti
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 18 Days Apr 23 – May 11, 2026 18 Days Jul 23 – Aug 10, 2026 18 Days Dec 10 – Dec 28, 2026 SEE ALL 8 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Ideal for anyone who can’t get enough of Tahiti, this unique sailing features twice the visits to ports, so you have double the opportunities to see and experience what you love — and you can do anything you passed up during your previous stop. Dive or snorkel among dizzying schools of tropical fish and friendly dolphins in the lagoon of Rangiroa, the second largest coral atoll in the world. Learn about oyster pearl farming at the Anapa Pearl Farm on the west coast of Tahaa. Skim the turquoise Pacific waters off the coast of Bora Bora on a personal watercraft as your guide leads you on a tour that circumnavigates the island, giving you expansive views of the steep jungle slopes of Mount Pahia and Mount Otemanu. Whether this is your first visit or the continuation of a lifelong obsession with this idyllic archipelago, this Tahitian voyage offers double the fun, relaxation and romance.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Twice the Tahiti

items.title: Dreams of Tahiti
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 7 Days Apr 23 – Apr 30, 2026 7 Days May 21 – May 28, 2026 7 Days May 28 – Jun 04, 2026 SEE ALL 139 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
Create lifetime memories as your Windstar yacht sails the ethereal paradise of Tahiti, enhanced by curated Tahiti excursions that bring you closer to the region's extraordinary beauty and culture. On your French Polynesia voyage, you’ll explore cerulean seas, lush greenery in Raiatea, and Moorea’s dark peaks, ending each day with a fiery sunset. A Windstar yacht — especially one where you can swim, snorkel or kayak right from the aft Marina Platform — is the perfect way to take in these remarkable sights. 

Visit six spectacular islands — which would otherwise be difficult to combine on one vacation, with immersive Tahiti excursions that showcase both iconic highlights and local traditions. Tour romantic Bora Bora, with its legendary white-sand shores (and a visit to a private motu, or islet), and Huahine, visiting millennium-old ruins. Overnight visits allow cultural immersion; learn to tie a pareo and sample local cuisine while mingling with villagers. Windstar’s Signature Beach Party features a splendid barbecue and a rare and dazzling performance of Polynesian fire dancing.
items.tourOgTitle: Dreams of Tahiti

items.title: Aegean Sea Odyssey
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Istanbul on Star Legend 8 Days Apr 24 – May 02, 2026 8 Days Oct 11 – Oct 19, 2026 8 Days Apr 09 – Apr 17, 2027 SEE ALL 6 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Greek temples and Turkish mosques punctuate the golden coastlines of these ancient rival nations throughout this 8-day coastal exploration of the Aegean Sea, scenic Dardanelles and the Sea of Maramara. Transit the narrow, time-saving Corinth Canal to Itea and the sacred ruins in the Sanctuary of Apollo. Sip tart and flavorful white wines made from local Assyrtiko, Athiri and Aidani grapes grown atop the windy ridges of Santorini. Hike between black lava rocks and white pumice stones to the smoldering crater on Nea Kameni. Shop for fresh fruit and vegetables in an open Turkish market with a local chef, then return to his Bodrum restaurant and cook up Turkish meals paired with regional wines and beer. Stroll in the shade of former terrace houses and columned buildings in ancient Ephesus prior to a late-night stay in the markets and cafes of Kusadasi, Turkey.
items.tourOgTitle: Aegean Sea Odyssey

items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Star 8 Days Apr 24 – May 02, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Idyllic islands, charming cobbled villages, spectacular scenery, intriguing history. Capture the heart of the Mediterranean in a single voyage. Each small harbor is especially suited for small ship exploration. Enjoy the best of the region — from the ancient ruins of Sparta and Mystras to the pure indulgence of the Mediterranean lifestyle.
items.tourOgTitle: Enchanting Greece & the Amalfi Coast

items.title: Yachtsman's Harbors of the Rivieras
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 8 Days Apr 26 – May 04, 2026 8 Days Sep 11 – Sep 19, 2026 8 Days Sep 15 – Sep 23, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Follow in the footsteps of artists and writers — and the world’s fanciest yachts, too — as you immerse yourself in the intoxicating atmosphere of the Italian Rivera and France’s Côte d’Azur. You’ll explore delightful resort towns and small villages where Matisse, Picasso, Van Gogh and others found inspiration. Admire the architecture of Gaudí in Barcelona. Try your luck at the Grand Casino in Monte Carlo. Visit Michelangelo’s astonishing Sistine Chapel, and the Roman Colosseum. Along the way, admire castles and ancient ruins, with access to many UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The leisurely pace of your voyage allows time to swim and sail, directly from your yacht’s Marina Platform. As you explore idyllic coastal scenes, you’ll quickly understand why the Rivieras are among the most treasured yachting destinations in the world.
items.tourOgTitle: Yachtsman's Harbors of the Rivieras

items.title: Star Collector: Tequila to Tundra: Sailing North America's West Coast
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Vallarta to Juneau, Ak on Star Seeker 17 Days Apr 28 – May 15, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Combine the tropical warmth of Puerto Vallarta with pristine Alaskan coastlines during this cruise along North America's West Coast. Enjoy tranquil days at sea, utilizing our spa facilities, complimentary exercise classes, and gourmet dining. Stand in the refreshing mist of Snoqualmie Falls and sample local Washington State wines. Admire towering totems and mountain views from Vancouver's Stanley Park. Kayak in Misty Fjords' waters gliding past cliffs and waterfalls. Cast for wild salmon swimming past Sitka, or tour a wildlife sanctuary where a native master carver transforms logs into totem poles. Float near massive tidewater glaciers in Alaska's ice-filled Tracy Arm. Accompany a professional photographer as you learn how to anticipate wildlife behavior and create the best photo compositions amid wildflowers, bald eagles, and possibly foraging brown bears.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Tequila to Tundra: Sailing North America's West Coast

items.title: Ocean Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Vallarta to Seattle, Wa on Star Seeker 8 Days Apr 28 – May 06, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge yourself in leisurely, unscheduled days where time suspends in the magic of the sea. Sleep late. Dine early. Establish your own rhythm in sync with the waves and the arc of the sun and moon overhead. Watch the constellations drift and let your mind shake off all the cobwebs of shore. Feast on the impossible beauty of liquid sunsets, and let your soul dance with the dolphins in the spray off the bow.
items.tourOgTitle: Ocean Crossing

items.title: Tahiti & the Tuamotu Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 11 Days Apr 30 – May 11, 2026 11 Days Feb 18 – Mar 01, 2027 11 Days Jun 27 – Jul 08, 2027 SEE ALL 6 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: The trade winds of French Polynesia have enticed sailors for centuries — and now those same beautiful breezes call you to voyage through the windward and leeward Society Islands to the serene natural beauty of the Tuamotu Islands, where pristine atolls and crystal lagoons welcome you to a hidden paradise. You’ll receive your own personal set of snorkeling equipment and fins for the duration of the voyage, custom-fit by our Marina team. So you can snorkel from your yacht’s Marina Platform, or from the beach, without having to wait in line to rent equipment. Visit Fakarava to see rare species found nowhere else on earth. In fact, Fakarava’s reef is such a unique ecosystem it’s been named a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. And with glass-bottom boats, AquaSafaris, snorkeling and SCUBA excursions, you can explore this magical world even if you don’t want to get wet.
items.tourOgTitle: Tahiti & the Tuamotu Islands

items.title: Star Collector: Aegean & Bosporus Escapades
items.journeyText: Journey from Istanbul to Barcelona on Star Legend 16 Days May 02 – May 18, 2026 16 Days Oct 19 – Nov 04, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail along the sunniest coastlines and most iconic shores as you explore small ancient ports and large cosmopolitan cities throughout Italy, Greece, and Turkey. Snack on local Sardinian seafood as you take in the diverse sights, bustling sounds, and unique aromas throughout San Benedetto’s old Cagliari Fish Market. Wander Erice’s cobbled medieval lanes prior to sitting down with a Sicilian chef for lessons on how to prepare an authentic, 3-dish meal sourced from regional ingredients. Uncover the mysteries of the oracle Pythia at the Sanctuary of Apollo atop the ruins of Delphi complex near Itea, then transit the narrow Corinth Canal to explore the Parthenon atop the Acropolis in Athens. Dine beneath the stars and the weathered columns of Ephesus during an evening 5-course dinner paired with classical music from the Aegean Chamber Orchestra.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Aegean & Bosporus Escapades

items.title: Star Collector: Grecian Gems and Spanish Charms
items.journeyText: Journey from Istanbul to Lisbon on Star Legend 24 Days May 02 – May 26, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a coastal journey tracing the northern contours of the Mediterranean Sea, exploring Greece and Spain. Visit the ancient ruins in Lemnos, the windmills of Mykonos, and tour Delphi's Temple of Apollo. Glide through the narrow Corinth Canal, an ancient shortcut connecting the Ionian and Aegean Seas. In Athens, stroll past historical sites like Hadrian’s Library, the Roman Agora and the Panathenaic Stadium. On Corfu, take a private boat tour to secret beaches near Paleokastritsa. Sample local cuisine like moussaka and seafood in Argostoli, and in Málaga, tour Picasso's museums. Visit Barcelona’s Las Ramblas and the emblematic architecture of Antoni Gaudí, from La Sagrada Familia to Park Güell. Discover millennia of history in Cartagena and Tangier’s bustling Grand Socco market. This voyage promises an unforgettable exploration of history and culture along the Mediterranean coast.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Grecian Gems and Spanish Charms

items.title: Treasures of the Greek Isles
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Star 7 Days May 02 – May 09, 2026 7 Days May 07 – May 14, 2026 7 Days May 09 – May 16, 2026 SEE ALL 51 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Visit sun-drenched places as you sail the Greek Isles, discovering a world abounding with seaside scenery and ancient treasures on cruises that Greece is best known for. On such legendary islands as Santorini and Mykonos, views of azure sea and white-washed villages will take your breath away. On your Greek islands cruise, you may embrace the magic and mythology of ancient temples built to honor Greek gods and goddesses. Visit UNESCO World Heritage Sites such as the amazing hilltop Acropolis in Athens, the haunts of St. John on the tiny island of Patmos, and the ancient Roman city of Ephesus. You may imagine you are Mark Antony, as you walk the same marble streets where the Roman general (and lover of Cleopatra) was once cheered by residents. Dine among the fascinating ruins as a complimentary treat, a Windstar-exclusive evening Destination Discovery Event planned for Ephesus.
items.tourOgTitle: Treasures of the Greek Isles

items.title: Classic Italy & Dalmatian Coast
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Star Explorer 9 Days May 04 – May 13, 2026 9 Days Oct 25 – Nov 03, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore timeless cities to tiny ports of unmatched beauty on one of the classic cruises from Rome to Venice. Pose in front of the Roman Colosseum and see the ancient city of Pompeii. Sail through the breathtaking Bay of Kotor and explore the famously picturesque towns of the Amalfi Coast. Wander the ancient cobblestone streets of the Sicilian town of Taormina and along the famous fortifications of the medieval city of Dubrovnik, dubbed “paradise on earth.” Your cruise will explore some of the most beautiful coastline in the world, places of legends and heroes, inspiration for writers and poets – and in popular culture, filming locations for the popular HBO TV series “Game of Thrones.” The leisurely pace allows time to swim in crystal clear sea and discover hidden beaches; kayak or tour by Zodiac along untouched coastline; visit bucket list sights; and sip, dine, and otherwise discover local culture in three fascinating countries.
items.tourOgTitle: Winter Italy and the Dalmatian Coast

items.title: One Day Pacific Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Seattle, Wa to Vancouver, Bc on Star Seeker 1 Days May 06 – May 07, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
Embarking on a one-night cruise from Seattle to Vancouver offers a delightful taste of yachting life and traveling in style. As you sail through the scenic Puget Sound, enjoy an included dinner created by James Beard Foundation chefs, thoughtful entertainment and stunning views of the Pacific Northwest. The journey provides a perfect blend of relaxation and exploration, with opportunities to unwind on deck or utilize the spa. Arriving in Vancouver, you will be greeted by the city's vibrant skyline and cultural attractions, the perfect way to set the stage for an unforgettable long weekend in this dynamic city.

Make it a complete roundtrip experience and enjoy a seamless getaway with a $75 coach transfer returning you from the Vancouver pier to Seattle’s Pier 66.
items.tourOgTitle: One Day Pacific Adventure

items.title: Wine Cruise: Scenic Alaska
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Juneau, Ak on Star Seeker 8 Days May 07 – May 15, 2026 8 Days Aug 07 – Aug 15, 2026 8 Days Jul 02 – Jul 10, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Mist-shrouded evergreen forests, soaring eagles and whale pods abound on this cruise that features visits to Sitka, Juneau, Haines, and Ketchikan. Fish for halibut, lingcod and rockfish on a guided fishing trip near the picturesque Tongass National Forest. Bicycle remote coastal roads and hike the soft trails of a mossy temperate rainforest outside Sitka, or try your hand stretching molten glass in a local artist studio. Experience the clamor and challenges of directing a dog team from a dogsled. Alaska’s pristine beauty remains the perfect accompaniment to baked salmon served on an aromatic cedar planks, decadent king crab legs and rustic clam chowder with Yukon potatoes, and this journey is rich in opportunities for sampling fresh-caught seafood and authentic local fare.
items.tourOgTitle: Wine Cruise: Scenic Alaska

items.title: Star Collector: Mediterranean Moments & Monuments
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Lisbon on Star Legend 16 Days May 10 – May 26, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: This southern Mediterranean cruise from Greece to Spain gives you a small ship exclusive transit of the Corinth Canal grants extra moments to savor the hallowed ruins of the Oracle of Delphi. Ride mountain bikes to villages, Venetian ruins, and rural countryside during a scenic Corfu cycling tour. Explore Taormina and the fragrant Villa Comunale garden prior to boarding a boat bound for the Blue Grotto's shimmering waters near Messina. Browse handcrafted copper and ceramic wares at outdoor Moroccan markets and dine with locals  during a late-night stay in Tangier. This city comes alive after the sun sets. Take in a Flamenco performance and admire the unique Moorish influences in Spanish architecture during your two-night Seville port stay . Sip sweet port wines at sunset along the scenic Tagus River during a two-night port stay in Lisbon.

items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Bordeaux on Star Legend 24 Days May 10 – Jun 03, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Delight in an exclusive Mediterranean adventure though the inimitable blend of Spanish, Portuguese and French cultures.  Take a private cooking lesson and enjoy the stunning landscapes of Corfu as you sample local wines. Swim with caretta turtles on the island of Kefalonia and ride a cable car to wander the cobblestone streets Sicily’s medieval town of Erice. Ride a bike through Valencia, touring streets past the Silk Exchange and the Turia riverbed gardens. In Morocco, explore the colorful Grand Socco (Souk) of Tangier or the famous Blue City of Chaouen. Sail the Guadalquivirsan River, enjoying a night of Flamenco. Tour Lisbon with architectural highlights like Belem Tower and Jeronimos Monastery. Voyage to the pilgrimage site of Santiago de Compostela, the endpoint of the Camino de Santiago. Stroll the scenic waterfront promenade of Gijon, to sip the area’s acclaimed cider.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Greek Beaches, Italian Isles & Iberian Coastlines

items.title: A Piece of Greece, a Slice of Sicily and the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Barcelona on Star Legend 8 Days May 10 – May 18, 2026 8 Days Oct 27 – Nov 04, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover Italy and Greece at their best, when towns and beaches are less crowded and the weather is just right for strolling historic ruins. Feast your eyes on the smooth bone-white columns of Athens’ Parthenon, and the honeycombed spires of Barcelona’s Sagrada Família. Inhale the aroma of wild rosemary and thyme mingled with fresh-baked guttiau bread in Cagliari. In Messina, watch as the bell tower clock’s bronze characters come to life, announcing noon with a lion’s fierce roar and a rooster’s loud crow. Enjoy the sweet sound of Argostoli’s street musicians playing kantades. And discover Delphi, where oracles channeled the prophecies of Apollo to kings. On this voyage, you’ll visit ports like Itea, reserved for yachts; in Trapani, you'll dock closer to key attractions than larger ships can; and you'll cross the Corinth Canal, too narrow for modern ships, but just wide enough for your yacht.
items.tourOgTitle: A Piece of Greece, a Slice of Sicily and the Corinth Canal

items.title: Tahiti & the Tuamotu Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 10 Days May 11 – May 21, 2026 10 Days Nov 23 – Dec 03, 2026 10 Days Dec 28 – Jan 07, 2026-2027 SEE ALL 14 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: The trade winds of French Polynesia have enticed sailors for centuries — and now those same beautiful breezes call you to voyage through the windward and leeward Society Islands to the serene natural beauty of the Tuamotu Islands, where pristine atolls and crystal lagoons welcome you to a hidden paradise. You’ll receive your own personal set of snorkeling equipment and fins for the duration of the voyage, custom-fit by our Marina team. So you can snorkel from your yacht’s Marina Platform, or from the beach, without having to wait in line to rent equipment. Visit Fakarava to see rare species found nowhere else on earth. In fact, Fakarava’s reef is such a unique ecosystem it’s been named a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. And with glass-bottom boats, AquaSafaris, snorkeling and SCUBA excursions, you can explore this magical world even if you don’t want to get wet.
items.tourOgTitle: Tahiti & the Tuamotu Islands

items.title: Star Collector: Twice the Tahiti
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 17 Days May 11 – May 28, 2026 17 Days Nov 23 – Dec 10, 2026 17 Days Dec 28 – Jan 14, 2026-2027 SEE ALL 13 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Ideal for anyone who can’t get enough of Tahiti, this unique sailing features twice the visits to ports, so you have double the opportunities to see and experience what you love — and you can do anything you passed up during your previous stop. Dive or snorkel among dizzying schools of tropical fish and friendly dolphins in the lagoon of Rangiroa, the second largest coral atoll in the world. Learn about oyster pearl farming at the Anapa Pearl Farm on the west coast of Tahaa. Skim the turquoise Pacific waters off the coast of Bora Bora on a personal watercraft as your guide leads you on a tour that circumnavigates the island, giving you expansive views of the steep jungle slopes of Mount Pahia and Mount Otemanu. Whether this is your first visit or the continuation of a lifelong obsession with this idyllic archipelago, this Tahitian voyage offers double the fun, relaxation and romance.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Twice the Tahiti

items.title: Quick Getaways: Belgium: A Sweet Getaway
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to London / Hms Belfast on Star Pride 3 Days May 12 – May 15, 2026 3 Days May 07 – May 10, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Short but incredibly sweet, this 3-day mini-cruise shows off tiny Belgium’s oversized charms from medieval streets to romantic canals and mouthwatering chocolates. Board your ship in London right next to HMS Belfast (Tower Bridge), one of the most exclusive cruise ports in the world just across the Thames. We’ll cross the English Channel to Ostend, the sea port for Bruges. The whole center of the city is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and our evening departure gives you time to explore. Next, we’ll make our way up the River Scheldt to Antwerp, a yacht exclusive port. This city has its own share of historic guildhalls and churches. But it’s also replete with modern architecture, museums filled with Flemish masters and small-cozy beer cafes.  Plenty to fill every hour until we head back across the Channel to London.
items.tourOgTitle: Quick Getaways: Belgium: A Sweet Getaway

items.title: Star Collector: Culture & Charms of Italy & Croatia
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 18 Days May 13 – May 31, 2026 18 Days Sep 19 – Oct 07, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Roam between the broken monoliths and columns in the Roman Forum, Western Civilization’s former epicenter. Gaze across Catania’s umber-hued, terracotta-tiled skyline to the steaming summit of Mount Etna as you sample authentic Sicilian dishes. Sip citrus-sweet limoncello from frosty glasses. Land at the tiny port of Lipari in the Aeolian Islands north of Sicily, and explore a Norman Castle built in medieval times, or master the art of Sicilian-style pizzas as you combine local ingredients into your own culinary creation. Step inside the cool and shady Romanesque splendor of Kotor Cathedral in Montenegro, or venture to the nearby pedestrian-only village of Perast to sample sweets. Your delightful journey concludes in Venice among romantic gondolas and exquisite Italian architecture.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Culture & Charms of Italy & Croatia

items.title: Star Collector: Iconic Italy: Centerpiece of the Mediterranean
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 21 Days May 13 – Jun 03, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail the stunning Adriatic, sip hearty Sicilian wines, and indulge in amazing Italian meals during this 21-night cruise from Venetian canals to cosmopolitan Rome. Drizzle one of the world's highest rated olive oils on freshly baked bread at a Croatian family farm. Cook up savory Montenegrin culinary delights under the tutelage of an award-winning Kotor chef. Float into the ethereal wonders of the fabled Blue Grotto outside Giardini Naxos. Bicycle with Maltese locals from a fishing village to spectacular seaside views atop the imposing Dingli Cliffs. Discover the charming ports of Trapani and Porto Empedocle in Sicily, gateways to ancient ruins, hilltop villages, and rich culinary traditions. Wander the fragrant Balio Gardens in the medieval town of Erice on the island of Sicily. Shop one-of-a-kind artisan crafts in cozy shops along the Amalfi Coast.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Iconic Italy: Centerpiece of the Mediterranean

items.title: Classic Italy & Dalmatian Coast
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 8 Days May 13 – May 21, 2026 8 Days Jul 24 – Aug 01, 2026 8 Days Aug 18 – Aug 26, 2026 SEE ALL 7 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore timeless cities to tiny ports of unmatched beauty on one of the classic cruises from Rome to Venice. Pose in front of the Roman Colosseum and see the ancient city of Pompeii. Sail through the breathtaking Bay of Kotor and explore the famously picturesque towns of the Amalfi Coast. Wander the ancient cobblestone streets of the Sicilian town of Taormina and along the famous fortifications of the medieval city of Dubrovnik, dubbed “paradise on earth.” Your cruise will explore some of the most beautiful coastline in the world, places of legends and heroes, inspiration for writers and poets – and in popular culture, filming locations for the popular HBO TV series “Game of Thrones.” The leisurely pace allows time to swim in crystal clear sea and discover hidden beaches; kayak or tour by Zodiac along untouched coastline; visit bucket list sights; and sip, dine, and otherwise discover local culture in three fascinating countries.
items.tourOgTitle: Classic Italy & Dalmatian Coast

items.title: Quick Getaways: St. Malo Getaway

items.tourMetaDescription: Enjoy an after-dark voyage down the Thames past the illuminated Tower of London, Canary Wharf and the Cutty Sark Clipper. Relish in pampering from your attentive crew, world-class dining, and expansive windows perfect for viewing the varied and interesting Channel traffic. The ramparts of St. Malo herald your arrival in the Brittany region of France, known for its seafood, scenery, and Celtic heritage. Explore the Old Town and admire grand houses dating from the days of the corsairs. There are creamy Cancale oysters and authentic buckwheat crêpes to taste with cidre to sip. The highlight of your visit may be viewing the beauty of Mont St. Michel, a UNESCO site considered one of the great religious sites in all of Europe. The sandcastle-like abbey perching on a tiny island is a technical and artistic wonder, described as being “to the ocean what the Pyramid of Cheops is to the desert.”
items.tourOgTitle: Quick Getaways: St. Malo Getaway

items.title: James Beard Foundation: Scenic Alaska
items.journeyText: Journey from Juneau, Ak to Vancouver, Bc on Star Seeker 8 Days May 15 – May 23, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Mist-shrouded evergreen forests, soaring eagles and whale pods abound on this cruise that features visits to Sitka, Juneau, Haines, and Ketchikan. Fish for halibut, lingcod and rockfish on a guided fishing trip near the picturesque Tongass National Forest. Bicycle remote coastal roads and hike the soft trails of a mossy temperate rainforest outside Sitka, or try your hand stretching molten glass in a local artist studio. Experience the clamor and challenges of directing a dog team from a dogsled. Alaska’s pristine beauty remains the perfect accompaniment to baked salmon served on an aromatic cedar planks, decadent king crab legs and rustic clam chowder with Yukon potatoes, and this journey is rich in opportunities for sampling fresh-caught seafood and authentic local fare.
items.tourOgTitle: James Beard Foundation: Scenic Alaska

items.title: Star Collector: Iberian Charms & Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Bordeaux on Star Legend 16 Days May 18 – Jun 03, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin your voyage in Bordeaux, France, visiting picturesque destinations on your way to Barcelona, Spain.  An overnight stay in Bordeaux allows you to savor world-renowned wines. Sail on to Bilbao, Spain, and enjoy another overnight. Continue to Gijon, Spain, known for its maritime heritage, before heading to Vigo, Spain. Discover the charm of Porto, Portugal, with its riverside vistas. In Lisbon, Portugal, experience an overnight stay that lets you wander through the narrow streets of Alfama. Next, sail to Seville, Spain, where an overnight stay allows time to explore the grand Seville Cathedral. Cross over to Tangier, Morocco, where the vibrant souks offer a taste of Moroccan charm. Continue to Malaga, Spain, birthplace of Picasso. In Cartagena, uncover Roman ruins. Valencia, with its futuristic City of Arts and Sciences, is the next stop before concluding your journey in Barcelona.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Iberian Charms & Splendors

items.title: Star Collector: French Elegance and Spanish Flair
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Paris/Rouen on Star Legend 23 Days May 18 – Jun 10, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Uncover a wealth of treasures on a remarkable voyage from Paris, France to Barcelona, Spain, enriched by multiple overnight port stays. Your journey begins with an overnight stay in Rouen, offering time to explore Paris's iconic landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the charming Montmartre district. From there, sail down the western coast of France, where four days among Bordeaux's vineyards await, providing a perfect opportunity for exploration and wine tasting. In St. Malo, walk along the medieval fortifications, delving into the city's storied maritime past. As the cruise continues through the Iberian Peninsula, experience Bilbao, renowned for its contemporary art and architecture. In Seville, marvel at the grandeur of the Alcázar and soak in the vibrant-historic city. The adventure extends to Tangier, where the exotic charm of Moroccan souks and promise a truly immersive experience.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: French Elegance and Spanish Flair

items.title: Moroccan Markets & Iberian Icons
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Lisbon on Star Explorer 8 Days May 18 – May 26, 2026 8 Days May 05 – May 13, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Traverse the Mediterranean to Tangier, Malaga, Seville, and Lisbon and enjoy contrasting customs, cuisine, and cultures that influence life throughout Europe and North Africa. Visit a hacienda outside Cartagena and graze on regional cheeses and dried hams as you watch an equestrian performance. Master paella cooking with a local chef on a picturesque Andalusian patio. Sail to Tangier, Morocco and wander the ancient Roman ruins of Lixus - a site only excavated within the last 100 years - before browsing handcrafted wares in tiny shops on Azilah's narrow streets. Stay overnight in Seville for a Flamenco show paired with a delicious and delightful Spanish dinner. Sip robust port wines during your overnight stay in Lisbon, and then venture to the village of Sintra and its majestic Pena Palace, the favored summer home of Portuguese royalty for over six centuries.

items.title: A Bite of Belgium & Feast of Fjords
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland on Star Pride 13 Days May 19 – Jun 01, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Culture, history and scenic beauty fill every frame of this Northern Europe adventure as you depart the River Thames and Edinburgh’s iconic castle. Look up as we pass beneath the glass observation floor of the Tower Bridge to see the envious glances of tourists above. Then cross the English Channel to  Belgium, a cultural amalgam with not one but three official languages: Dutch, French, and German. Feast your eyes on Flemish and Renaissance architecture lining the streets of Antwerp and reflecting off the canals of Bruges. Enchanting Norway is next with magical cities like Alesund, with its charming Art Nouveau architecture, and Trondheim, with its Bakklandet district filled with colorful old wooden houses. Soak up eye-popping fjord and mountain scenery as you visit Romsdalfjord in Andalsnes.  Embark on outdoor adventures like glacier explorations as you explore all Norway has to offer.
items.tourOgTitle: A Bite of Belgium & Feast of Fjords

items.title: Historic Harbors of Italy & Beyond
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 13 Days May 21 – Jun 03, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Fall in love with sailing again on the elegant Wind Surf. This sailing visits Italian seaside villages, smoldering Sicilian volcanoes, and imposing Malta monuments. Wander between shady palms and quarried caves at the Neapolis Archaeological Park--an UNESCO World Heritage Site where ancient actors orated, artisans wove ropes, and tyrants eavesdropped on prisoners. Roll offroad on mountain bikes to a scenic Maltese village beyond the high-walled port of Valleta, Malta. Meander between Pompeii's Roman baths, markets, and temples beneath brooding Mount Vesuvius. Stroll from the Spanish Steps to the Trevi Fountain to the fabled Pantheon during a walking tour of cosmopolitan Rome. Board a Portovenere boat bound for Cinque Terre's picturesque terraces and sample fresh mussels paired with local wines in the colorful village of Vernazza.
items.tourOgTitle: Historic Harbors of Italy & Beyond

items.title: Endless Days in Norway
items.journeyText: Journey from London Greenwich to Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland on Star Pride 10 Days May 22 – Jun 01, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Scenery lovers and active outdoorsy types will both find plenty to love on these fjord-focused cruises Norway is best known for. Take a cable car to a mountain peak overlooking Andalsnes and the Romsdal Alps, hike back down or go for a scenic train ride through the mountains and across the picturesque stone Kylling Bridge. Visit tiny Olden at the inner end of Nordfjord and hike to a glacier’s face, or take the Skylift to lofty views. Go mountain biking on Mount Fløyen in Bergen, or wander the shops at the colorful Hanseatic wharf. In Trondheim, you can do both – use the city’s free bikes for a ride around town to check out the emerging foodie scene. We’ll follow the fjord all the way to the sea and beyond, to the island of Frøya, where much of the world’s farmed fish is grown and tables are set with fresh crab, scallops, and local cheese. These are the kinds of immersive experiences that define the cruises Norway travelers seek: close encounters with fjords, mountains, and coastal culture.
items.tourOgTitle: Endless Days in Norway

items.title: Alaskan Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Seward, Anchorage, Alaska on Star Seeker 10 Days May 23 – Jun 02, 2026 10 Days Jul 18 – Jul 28, 2026 10 Days Jun 12 – Jun 22, 2027 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
"Conde Nast Traveler 2019 Hot List ""As far as Alaskan expeditions go, this itinerary gives passengers more access to so many aspects of the state's culture than any competitor.""  - Conde Nast Traveler 
Witness the grandeur of Alaska’s premier glaciers: Mendenhall in Juneau, Kenai Fjords’ Harding Icefield, Tracy Arm’s twin Sawyer Glaciers. Discover Alaskan Native villages, Russian cathedrals, and Gold Rush history. Thrill as you watch a wild brown bear snatch a struggling salmon from a stream or a humpback whale breach off the bow. Cruise Misty Fjords and Kenai Fjords on your lovely all-suite ship, waters beyond the reach of larger Alaska cruise ships."
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Splendors

items.title: Star Collector: Palates & Palettes of Northern Spain and France
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Paris/Rouen on Star Legend 15 Days May 26 – Jun 10, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Impressionist artists like Monet and Renoir spent a lifetime trying to capture the beauty and soul of western France. It took Julia Child just one meal in Normandy to fall in love with French cuisine. Be won over on this sensory journey to Northern Spain and France. Follow the Comino to the cathedral at Santiago de Compostela, a pilgrimage site for a thousand years. Sip cider in Gijon at the heart of “Green Spain,” a place even many Spaniards are unfamiliar with. Treat your palate to Basque cuisine. You’ll see hills covered in vineyards and chateaux in Bordeaux, Monet’s famous water lilies in Giverny, Mont St. Michel abbey perched on a tiny island like a wedding cake ornament, and as many Parisian wonders as you can absorb with a two-night stay in Rouen. Delicious. Moving. Awe-inspiring. This voyage is all that and more.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Palates & Palettes of Northern Spain and France

items.title: Star Collector: Atlantic Europe: Northern Spain, Western France & British Isles
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland on Star Legend 25 Days May 26 – Jun 20, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover new faces of countries you thought you already knew as we make our way along Northern Spain’s lush Asturian coast, then explore western France to the Channel Islands. Taste Asturian cider and wine from some of Bordeaux’s 53 appellations, sample delicious Basque pintxos, and surrender to the call of Parisian pâtisseries. Choose from an incredible array of attractions from Mont St. Michel to Versailles to Monet’s Giverny. Charming islands like Guernsey welcome you to British Isles. Stroll the world-famous abbey gardens on the Isles of Scilly, with plants from as far away as Brazil and Burma. Ponder the mysteries of Stonehenge from Portland and the Callanish Standing Stones near Stornoway. Drive the spectacular Antrim Coast to the Giant’s Causeway in Northern Ireland. Bump elbows with Dubliners over a Guinness, and find Edinburgh Castle brimming with history.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Atlantic Europe: Northern Spain, Western France & British Isles

items.title: Connoisseur’s Delight: Northern Spain & Portugal
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Bordeaux on Star Legend 8 Days May 26 – Jun 03, 2026 8 Days May 13 – May 21, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Some experiences are just too good to rush, and this voyage to Northern Spain, Portugal, and Bordeaux is one of them. That’s why our thoughtfully planned itinerary includes long days in port and overnight stays — time to savor the very best of this bountiful region. Taste Galicia’s legendary seafood fresh from the Bay of Biscay, sample port within sight of the Douro River in Porto, share pintxos with new Basque friends, and wine and dine amid French vineyards on the “hill with a thousand chateaux.” When you’re not busy pampering your palate, delve into the fascinating history of this region. There are ancient Roman baths in Gijon, medieval Old Towns, and countless modern wonders like Portugal’s stunning, multicolored Pena Palace and the iconic Guggenheim in Bilbao.
items.tourOgTitle: Connoisseur’s Delight: Northern Spain & Portugal

Bask in the Mediterranean sun as you discover hidden coves and azure waters, or linger over regional wines and cuisine that celebrate the island’s French and Italian influences. This journey blends natural beauty with cultural charm for an unforgettable escape.

items.tourMetaDescription: Follow in the footsteps of Joan of Arc, King Arthur, William Wallace, and St. Patrick on this multifaceted journey. Walk along the banks of the Seine and admire the restored Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris during your two-night stay. Dine and sip wine at a 17th-century chateau in Saint-Émilion during an overnight in Bordeaux. And explore the French countryside from half-timbered houses to wedding cake abbeys. Across the Channel, find haunting stone circles and boisterous English gardens, stern-faced castles and friendly Irish pubs, all wrapped in wild scenery and legends based in both fact and fantasy. Explore Titanic history and the Giant’s Causeway from Belfast. Ride a steam train through Hogwarts scenery from Fort Williams. Then wrap it all up in Stornoway and Edinburgh where famous castles, Iron Age villages, and medieval streets bring the Celtic past to life.

items.tourMetaDescription: This comprehensive exploration of France includes an overnight in Rouen (Paris), and visits the Normandy, Brittany, and Aquitaine regions of France. And feast your eyes on timeless scenery: the abbey on Mont St. Michel, St. Malo’s pink sandstone cliffs, Monet’s garden in Giverny where water lilies still have the power to inspire. See iconic sights like the Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame. And write your own adventures as you hike the unspoiled wild Breton coast.

items.title: Rome & Prix du Monde of Monaco
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Wind Surf 8 Days Jun 03 – Jun 11, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Surrounded by glitterati on the glistening Wind Surf you fit right in; your insider’s experience at Monaco’s legendary Prix du Monde, the jewel in the crown of this exceptional cruise. Visit some of the unique ports — Portoferraio and Palamos, and iconic cities like Rome and Monte Carlo — strolling famous promenades, shopping elite boutiques, and taking in world-renowned beaches. Then during your overnight in Monte Carlo, enjoy exclusive access to special Windstar private Prix du Monde of Monaco events and two days of world-class Formula One time trials and racing. It’s the ultimate expression of Windstar’s style, and open to only a very limited number of guests.
items.tourOgTitle: Rome & Prix du Monde of Monaco

items.title: Star Collector: Greek Classics & Hidden Gems Unveiled
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Spirit 14 Days Jun 04 – Jun 18, 2026 14 Days Jun 11 – Jun 25, 2026 14 Days Jun 18 – Jul 02, 2026 SEE ALL 8 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore white-washed towns perched high on dramatic cliffs overlooking the azure Aegean Sea. Discover hidden beaches with crystal-clear waters and engage with local fishermen in charming small ports where larger ships can’t go. Take in views from the well preserved hilltop Castle of Palamidi. Visit the Grotto of St. John and witness nuns making honey and fruit liquor on the islet of Patmos. In Santorini, sip coffee while admiring the dramatic village of Oia. Wind around the narrow streets Monemvasia—a pedestrian-only village built into a cliffside. Visit the isle of Syros with neoclassical architecture and lively activity in Miaouli Square. Hike Mount Zas for breathtaking panoramic views. For something 180 degrees from ordinary, embark on the lunar-like landscape of Milos. This voyage blends traditional ancient sites with a hidden side of Greece most travelers have never seen.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Greek Classics & Hidden Gems Unveiled

items.title: Off The Beaten Path Greek Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Spirit 7 Days Jun 04 – Jun 11, 2026 7 Days Jun 18 – Jun 25, 2026 7 Days Sep 24 – Oct 01, 2026 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Set a course for hidden harbors and the delights of off the beaten path Greece during a seven-day cruise to Hellenistic islands and a moonlight dinner concert in the Turkish ruins of Ephesus. Explore the colorful interior of the Cathedral of St. George atop Syros, a stately hillside landmark founded in the 1200s and continually restored after devastating battles. Listen as a moonlight concert reverberates across the ancient Celsus Library walls during your candlelight dinner in Ephesus. Drink the decadent sweetness of local Muscat wines pressed at Samos and learn about their most famous and calculating resident-the mathematician Pythagora. Wander the weathered Doric decor of the temple of Demeter prior to sampling the culinary perfection of pan-seared calamari in Naxos. Relax on the sunny and sandy expanses of the most scenic beaches in the Cyclades. Browse handmade clothing in unspoiled Folegandros and Milos-tiny island refuges yet to be found by tourists.
items.tourOgTitle: Off The Beaten Path Greek Islands

items.title: British Isles Medley
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland on Star Legend 10 Days Jun 10 – Jun 20, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: See all the shades of the U.K. on this 10-day itinerary, with rare stops in small ship-only ports like Swansea and Fort William. Explore the Jurassic Coast with its breathtaking St Michael’s Mount, and discover the unique Celtic heritage that separates Cornwall from the rest of England. Ponder neolithic standing stones and ride a steam train across the iconic Harry Potter bridge with visions of Hogwarts in your head. If you’re a garden fan, fasten your seatbelt, because the British Isles erupt into a glorious fanfare of color at nearly every port you’ll visit features one or more eye-popping choices like the Royal Botanical Garden in Edinburgh. Depending on the departure, you will either overnight in Paris with time to check “must sees” off your list, or end your voyage in Amsterdam with its charming canals and historic buildings – a cherry on an already amazing journey.
items.tourOgTitle: British Isles Medley

items.title: Star Collector: North Sea Enchantments: United Kingdom & Norway
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Bergen on Star Legend 17 Days Jun 10 – Jun 27, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Browse handmade traditional tartan patterns, sip smokey Irish whiskeys, and wander the cobbled lanes of small Norwegian fishing villages during a sweeping exploration of iconic destinations and little-known havens throughout Ireland, Scotland, and Norway. Take a vineyard tour on the Isles of Scilly and sample local wines. Stomp your feet to traditional Irish melodies as you enjoy a delicious regional meal at a picturesque tavern nestled in the Dublin Mountain foothills. Accompany a local Irish whiskey reviewer on a walking tour and stop at one of Belfast's oldest pubs for tastings paired with seared scallops and regional cuisine. Escape to the tiny fishing village of Ergesund and discover 1800s Norwegian rural life inside a cozy country farmhouse. Drift past veiled waterfalls and precipitous cliffs during a scenic cruise of Sognefjord, Norway's most picturesque inlet. Wake to coffee and savory brunost cheese melting atop warm toast during a Bergen overnight stay.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: North Sea Enchantments: United Kingdom & Norway

items.title: Star Collector: Legends of the Pacific: French Polynesia, Tonga & Fiji
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Lautoka, Viti Levu on Star Breeze 22 Days Jun 11 – Jul 03, 2026 22 Days Jul 08 – Jul 30, 2027 22 Days Jul 20 – Aug 11, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Journey through the heart of the South Pacific on this voyage between Tahiti and Fiji. Sail to legendary islands like Bora Bora, Moorea, Raiatea, and Huahine in French Polynesia, where  mountains, crystal-clear lagoons, and vibrant island culture await. Explore the pristine Cook Islands, where you can bask on Aitutaki’s famous lagoon and experience the charm of Rarotonga’s markets and volcanic peaks. Cross the International Dateline to reach the friendly shores of Tonga, one of the few remaining Polynesian kingdoms, where limestone caves, coral reefs, and authentic village traditions invite deeper exploration. In Fiji, discover lesser-visited gems such as Taveuni, Savusavu, and Dravuni, known for their  beauty and welcoming spirit. This island-hopping adventure offers a perfect balance of tropical relaxation and cultural discovery—with the added luxury of Windstar’s water access Marina.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Legends of the Pacific: French Polynesia, Tonga & Fiji

items.title: Iberian Icons & Hidden French Harbors
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Lisbon on Wind Surf 11 Days Jun 11 – Jun 22, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Hoist the sails and glide across the sparkling Mediterranean to small ports throughout France, Spain, and Portugal on an 11-night voyage rich in culture, local cuisine, and delicious wines. Venture inland from Sète to the fortified medieval city of Carcassonne to tour towers or explore the ornate Basilica of Saint-Nazaire, then dine on delectable French cuisine. Meander through a Medieval market and admire Gothic and Romanesque architectural influences during a walking tour of scenic Tarragona, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Shop for stylish leather bags and wallets at an upscale Spanish leather boutique or take in beachside views in Palma de Mallorca. Visit Gibraltar's summit to see monkeys, Morocco's distant mountains, and ships transiting the mouth of the Mediterranean.
items.tourOgTitle: Iberian Icons & Hidden French Harbors

items.title: Quick Getaways: A Taste of Southern France
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Tarragona (Barcelona) on Wind Surf 3 Days Jun 11 – Jun 14, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the charm of southern France on a 3-night Mediterranean escape filled with culture, history, and flavor.  Kayak along imposing and scenic rocky cliffs outside Sète, France. Ride through the Languedoc countryside to the medieval city of Carcassonne--a storied French fortified village circled by walls, surrounded by watchtowers, and immortalized by generations of artists and stonecutters. Walk along Collioure's French Fauvism Road and admire the brushstrokes and techniques of Matisse and Derain, two famed Fauvist painters who captured settings throughout this quaint fishing village. Master wine tasting techniques in the company of a skilled oenologist as you examine, sniff, and sip regional wines.
items.tourOgTitle: Quick Getaways: A Taste of Southern France

items.title: Alaskan Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Seward, Anchorage, Alaska on Star Seeker 12 Days Jun 12 – Jun 24, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
"Conde Nast Traveler 2019 Hot List ""As far as Alaskan expeditions go, this itinerary gives passengers more access to so many aspects of the state's culture than any competitor.""  - Conde Nast Traveler 
Witness the grandeur of Alaska’s premier glaciers: Mendenhall in Juneau, Kenai Fjords’ Harding Icefield, Tracy Arm’s twin Sawyer Glaciers. Discover Alaskan Native villages, Russian cathedrals, and Gold Rush history. Thrill as you watch a wild brown bear snatch a struggling salmon from a stream or a humpback whale breach off the bow. Cruise Misty Fjords and Kenai Fjords on your lovely all-suite ship, waters beyond the reach of larger Alaska cruise ships."
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Splendors

items.title: Spanish Symphony
items.journeyText: Journey from Tarragona (Barcelona) to Lisbon on Wind Surf 8 Days Jun 14 – Jun 22, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Poised as if to kiss the continent of Africa, Andalusia hugs the southern coast of Spain and embraces cultural influences from both sides of the strait. This is the birthplace of Don Juan and Carmen, evening paseos by women in lace mantillas, cape-twirling matadors. In short, it is quintessential Spain. The beaches of the Costa del Sol are legendary. And behind lie equally magnificent mountain ranges sheltering picturesque “white villages.” Here you won’t find cookie-cutter castles, but amazing cultural amalgams like the Alhambra and Alcázar. On your elegant ship, you will cruise past larger ships right to the heart of old towns and to the steps of friendly bodegas.
items.tourOgTitle: Spanish Symphony

items.title: Portuguese Passages & Spanish Shorelines Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Tarragona (Barcelona) to Lisbon on Wind Surf 12 Days Jun 14 – Jun 26, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Combine a culturally immersive inland journey throughout Portugal with a scenic tracing of Spain’s iconic coastlines during this remarkable 12-day combination cruise and land tour. The experience features coastal sailing from Barcelona to Lisbon, Portugal, complemented by a scenic Douro River cruise in Pinhão as part of the inland experience. Inhale intermingled aromas of seafood and spicy bean soup on Porto’s glowing twilight streets as melancholic fado lyrics and guitarra strings reverberate across stone walls. Light a candle amid prayerful pilgrims in the silence of Fátima’s most sacred sites. Peer into the spiraling, moss-lined columns of the Initiation Well near the misty Sintra Forest. Bask in the Douro Valley’s unique sunlit glow as you stand among the rocky contours of steep terraced vineyards. Master the art of tapas cooking under the direction of an Andalusian chef near Málaga. Sip sherries and wander among old barrels in Cadiz wine cellars. Kayak between scenic caletas, or quays, in Mallorca’s clear coastal waters.
items.tourOgTitle: Portuguese Passages & Spanish Shorelines Cruise Tour

items.title: Flowers of the South Pacific: Fiji, the Cook Islands & French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Lautoka, Viti Levu on Star Breeze 15 Days Jun 18 – Jul 03, 2026 15 Days Jul 15 – Jul 30, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Remote beaches and rich Polynesian culture abound throughout this iconic South Pacific voyage to Fiji, Tonga, the Cook Islands, and French Polynesia, where you’ll experience the pristine beauty of turquoise lagoons, white-sand beaches, and vibrant coral reefs. On Rarotonga, join a guided nature trek, where you’ll learn about the island’s culture and history from a local. Explore the subterranean splendors of 'Ana Hulu in Tonga, a coral limestone cavern concealing centuries-old freshwater lakes, or wander scenic rainforest paths in Taveuni's Bouma National Heritage Park. Indulge in sweet cocoa farm treats during a delicious tree-to-bar tour on Vana Levu, or dine on Fijian fish dishes and tropical fruit cocktails. Rekindle romantic magic at beachside resort accommodations during an overnight stay on Bora Bora, and allow flowers to perfume the air as you sail into a fiery sunset.
items.tourOgTitle: Flowers of the South Pacific: Fiji, the Cook Islands & French Polynesia

items.title: Norway's Southern Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland to Bergen on Star Legend 7 Days Jun 20 – Jun 27, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the authentic, unhurried hospitality of little-known fishing villages throughout this cruise along small islands, meandering scenic inlets, and hidden harbors on a Norway cruise along the southern coastline. Savor the simplicity of bygone Norwegian sailing life, old-fashioned sweets, and local history at Klöckers Hus. Wander the elaborate gardens at Barony Rosendal, a manor house and meeting place for Norwegian high society for more than 250 years. Nibble farm-grown strawberries and juicy raspberries as you pet local llamas amid Skjolden's mountain-framed rural ambiance. Trace your fingers along the carved details of old wooden bowls that once served salted herring, crispy flatbreads, and tangy smoked salmon before enjoying your own helping of succulent cod or lamb shanks at local Bergen waterfront restaurants.
items.tourOgTitle: Norway's Southern Splendors

items.title: Alaskan Explorations & Denali Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Vancouver, Bc on Star Seeker 14 Days Jun 20 – Jul 04, 2026 14 Days Jul 24 – Aug 07, 2026 14 Days Jun 18 – Jul 02, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Awaken and inspire your sense of adventure as you sail north through Canada’s Inside Passage, visiting the Alaskan towns of Wrangell and Haines. A journey through stunning landscapes, rich history, and unique wildlife. Admire the glaciated slopes and ice floes of Alaska’s Misty Fjords, Tracy Arm and Kenai Fjords, but keep a weather eye on the horizon for the telltale spray and black fins of orca pods. Disembark in Seward and ride inland to Fairbanks and scenic Denali National Park. Caribou, foxes and Dall sheep observations are nearly certain, but even the locals grow excited about grizzly and wolf pack sightings. A detailed float along the Chena River provides additional opportunities for ursine encounters prior to your transfer to Fairbanks Airport and your reentry into the predictabilities of a less-adventurous modern civilization.
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Explorations & Denali Cruise Tour
