items.title: Star Collector: Enchantment of the Western Med
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 15 Days Jun 22 – Jul 07, 2026 15 Days Mar 17 – Apr 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the best Western Mediterranean ports in detail during this cruise through Italy, Monaco, France, Spain, Gibraltar, and Portugal. Stroll among opulent casinos, high-end boutiques, and historic Formula One landmarks in Monte Carlo. Sip wormwood-based absinthe in the French village of Antibes outside of Cannes. Or meander among the dusky walls and long shadows in Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, taking in the aromas, sights and sounds of the Catalonian heart of Spain.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Enchantment of the Western Med

items.title: Star Collector: Western Mediterranean & Adriatic Discovery
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Venice on Wind Surf 23 Days Jun 22 – Jul 15, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This extended Mediterranean route moves from Portugal to Spain, France, Italy and Croatia, built around variety, small-ship access, and ports like Palamós, Sanary-sur-Mer, Amalfi, Otranto, and Rab. Enjoy a full day and evening in Lisbon before calling on Cádiz, Gibraltar, Málaga, Almería, Cartagena, and Palma de Mallorca. Barcelona adds a major cultural stop before the itinerary shifts toward ports many larger ships skip, including Palamós and Sanary-sur-Mer. Then it’s on to Monte Carlo and Cannes, capped by a late call in Portofino for dinner ashore and harbor views. Portoferraio, Elba keeps the pace relaxed before Civitavecchia opens the door to Rome. The final stretch spotlights southern Italy: Amalfi, Marina di Vibo Valentia, Reggio Calabria, Taranto, and Otranto, followed by Rab and Venice.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Western Mediterranean & Adriatic Discovery

items.title: Spanish Symphony & Madrid Medley Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Barcelona on Wind Surf 12 Days Jun 22 – Jul 04, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Hop from port-to-port on an extraordinary Spanish Symphony & Madrid Medley cruise itinerary that takes you along the picturesque Andalusian coast and deep into the heart of Spain. Immerse yourself in Almeria’s Moorish heritage, Costa del Sol’s “white villages,” and Mallorca’s stunning beaches, with plenty of time to enjoy Lisbon’s charming cobblestone streets and Barcelona’s bold Gaudi architecture. Traveling by high-speed train, you’ll spend four nights at a five-star hotel in Madrid, immersing yourself in the capital’s vibrant culture. Highlights of this Madrid cruise experience include early entry to the renowned Prado Museum and an exclusive flamenco dinner show at Spain’s only Michelin-starred tablao. You’ll take a daytrip to admire medieval Segovia’s first-century Roman aqueduct and iconic Alcázar Castle, and spend a night in Barcelona, where you’ll be whisked away to a beautiful 450-year-old winery in the Penedés region.
items.tourOgTitle: Spanish Symphony & Madrid Medley Cruise Tour

items.title: Lands of the Midnight Sun
items.journeyText: Journey from Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland to Reykjavik on Star Pride 11 Days Jun 25 – Jul 06, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Cruise beneath the Midnight Sun to sparkling Norwegian fjords, steaming Icelandic geysers, ancient Scottish standing stones, and the bucolic Faroe Islands. Hear the echoes of Old Norse tongues, see lands once lauded in ancient Viking sagas, and witness sights that will stir your soul. As a guest of Windstar, you experience it all from a uniquely thrilling perspective.
items.tourOgTitle: Lands of the Midnight Sun

items.title: Star Collector: Endless Days of the North Sea & Iceland
items.journeyText: Journey from Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland to Reykjavik on Star Pride 18 Days Jun 25 – Jul 13, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore the finest small ports in Scotland, Norway, and the Faroe Islands (Denmark) before circumnavigating Iceland on this 17-day summertime adventure. Cover the shorelines of Scotland and Norway, stopping off to see Denmark’s Faroe Islands. Explore Iceland’s majestic fjords, imposing volcanoes and remote rocky reaches. Discover the challenges faced by Iron Age communities near Kirkwall, Scotland, sample almond ring cake and other Norwegian culinary delights at a historic farm near Bergen, Norway, and kayak among sea birds and urban artistry in Alesund, Norway. Iceland excursions include flights above waterfalls and volcanoes on Heimaey Island, detailed archaeological examinations of a medieval farm near Seydisfjordur, and relaxing moments immersed in the natural geothermal waters of the Myvatn Nature Baths outside Akureyri.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Endless Days of the North Sea & Iceland

items.title: Yachtsman’s Mediterranean Rivieras & Madrid Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 11 Days Jun 26 – Jul 07, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: The magnificent ports of the Rivieras each have their own distinctive allure. In Madrid, you’ll have four nights to immerse yourself in its vibrant culture. Beat the crowds to the Prado Museum, to revel in Spanish masterpieces. Learn to cook tapas at a boutique cooking school. Enjoy a flamenco show and a three-course Michelin star dinner. Spend a day in Segovia, a medieval city (also UNESCO World Heritage site) featuring an ancient Roman aqueduct that winds around the edge of town. Get a guided tour through the city’s Gothic-style Cathedral, stopping at the iconic Alcázar castle. Indulge in a wine tasting at the Cavas Cordoniu cellars in the wine region of Catalonia, where you’ll learn the art of wine tasting. Your travel between Barcelona and Madrid will be in Comfort Class via high-speed train. Windstar picks up your luggage so it will be waiting for you at your hotel.
items.tourOgTitle: Yachtsman’s Mediterranean Rivieras & Madrid Cruise Tour

items.title: Enchanting Meteora, Greece, and Amalfi Coast Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 10 Days Jun 29 – Jul 09, 2026 10 Days Oct 12 – Oct 22, 2026 10 Days Oct 14 – Oct 24, 2026 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Enjoy the perfect blend of ancient marvels and breathtaking natural beauty on this Greece and Amalfi Cruise Tour. Delve deep into Greek and Roman history as you visit the home of the Oracle at Delphi, Meteora’s mystical monasteries, and the awe-inspiring ruins of Rome and Pompeii. Walk medieval lanes in Mystras and Monemvasia past a surprisingly harmonious mix of Byzantine castles, Norman churches and Moorish palaces. But don’t let the fascinating past overshadow the sheer beauty of the present. Appreciate every pixel of stone buildings covered with jasmine, oleander and bougainvillea. Cruise the dramatic coast of Sorrento and Amalfi, a tapestry of cliffs, grottoes, beaches and picturesque seaside towns. And linger in amazing gems like colorful Ponza with its gelato-colored buildings and tiny harbor – a place only big enough for small ships like ours.
items.tourOgTitle: Enchanting Meteora, Greece, and Amalfi Coast Cruise Tour

stops.port: E. VENIZELOS ATHENS AIRPORT TO ATHENS CRUISE TOUR HOTEL

items.title: Star Collector: Riviera & Italian Glamour
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Venice on Wind Surf 15 Days Jun 30 – Jul 15, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Combine secluded, palm-lined beaches and picturesque hidden harbors with southern Europe's iconic cathedrals, casinos, ruins, and artistic masterpieces during this remarkable voyage. Cycle past sun-dappled cork farms and crumbling Roman walls to the Medieval village of Pals. Inhale delicate French flower fragrances during a perfume factory tour near Sanary-sur-Mer. March through the first of many Roman towns founded in ancient Gaul. Roll the dice at a Monte Carlo casino and browse a princely car collection. Gaze across colorful villages and tiny vineyards perched atop the Amalfi Coast's cliffs and ravines. Visit prestigious archeological museums and scenic seaside boulevards in Reggio Calabria. Taranto, with its rich history and coastal views, offers a glimpse into ancient Roman and Greek culture, while Otranto reveals charming old town streets and breathtaking Adriatic Sea vistas.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Riviera & Italian Glamour

items.title: Star Collector: Europe's Classical Coastlines from the Riviera to the Adriatic
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Venice on Wind Surf 24 Days Jun 30 – Jul 24, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Escape to unspoiled scenery of the lesser-known, inviting coastline, Mediterranean destinations during this southern Europe cruise. Indulge in late-night dining during evening port visits to Monaco, Italy, and Croatia. Venture into the surreal worlds of melting clocks and ethereal landscapes at the Dalí Theatre-Museum near Palamos, Spain. Sit down to a Tuscan meal of pasta and wines while you learn about a local Portoferraio family. Stand among 2,500-year-old Riace Bronzes and iconic Greek statues that are archaeological centerpieces at the famed Museo Nazionale Della Magna Grecia in Reggio Calabria. Stretch out on Otranto's white sand beaches and seek out sweet gelato and delectable citrus refreshments during a late-night port stay. The coast of Croatia, with its stunning Adriatic shoreline, offers picturesque beaches, crystal-clear waters, charming medieval towns ready to be explored.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Europe's Classical Coastlines from the Riviera to the Adriatic

items.title: Yachtsman's Harbors of the Rivieras
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 7 Days Jun 30 – Jul 07, 2026 7 Days Jun 28 – Jul 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Follow in the footsteps of artists and writers — and the world’s fanciest yachts, too — as you immerse yourself in the intoxicating atmosphere of the Italian Rivera and France’s Côte d’Azur. You’ll explore delightful resort towns and small villages where Matisse, Picasso, Van Gogh and others found inspiration. Admire the architecture of Gaudí in Barcelona. Try your luck at the Grand Casino in Monte Carlo. Visit Michelangelo’s astonishing Sistine Chapel, and the Roman Colosseum. Along the way, admire castles and ancient ruins, with access to many UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The leisurely pace of your voyage allows time to swim and sail, directly from your yacht’s Marina Platform. As you explore idyllic coastal scenes, you’ll quickly understand why the Rivieras are among the most treasured yachting destinations in the world.
items.tourOgTitle: Yachtsman's Harbors of the Rivieras

items.title: Vatican & Italian Riviera Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 9 Days Jun 30 – Jul 09, 2026 9 Days Jun 28 – Jul 07, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge your sense of wonder during this journey that combines a multi-day inland exploration to Rome with an Italian Riviera cruise and a scenic sailing along the steep and majestic Italian and French Rivieras. Sidestep the ordinary Vatican crowds during a tour of the Sistine Chapel and some sectors of the Vatican Museums. Discover the Roman Colosseum through the eyes of gladiators on an exclusive visit to Rome’s most recognizable landmark. Savor fresh handmade pasta dishes and rich Chianti wines amidst the warm ambiance and sincere hospitality of a neighborhood Italian restaurant. Your cruise features unforgettable opportunities to experience the scenic Portoferraio Biosphere Reserve and explore the historic vineyards of Elba, set along the storied Italian Riviera. Watch beachcombers from white-linen sidewalk cafés or sunbathe on romantic sandy beaches in Cannes. Inhale seafood aromas and herbal fragrances in a Barcelonan open market.
items.tourOgTitle: Vatican & Italian Riviera Cruise Tour

items.title: Delphi & Meteora: Grecian Treasures Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Star 10 Days Jul 01 – Jul 11, 2026 10 Days Jul 08 – Jul 18, 2026 10 Days Jul 15 – Jul 25, 2026 SEE ALL 36 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Delve into the ancient wonders of early Western Civilization on this 10-day journey featuring Meteora and Delphi, with time to explore the islands of Greece aboard a trusted Greece cruise line. Stroll the monument-lined Sacred Way toward the Grand Temple of Apollo in Delphi. Savor a moonlit Turkish dinner and romantic concert among the ruins of Ephesus in Turkey during Windstar’s complimentary Destination Discovery Event, an exceptional experience included at no additional cost. Imagine the sense of adventure among Medieval Turkish raiders as you stare at natural sandstone pillars throughout Meteora Valley. Sip local Assyrtiko wine paired with freshly caught calamari while relaxing high above Santorini’s steep volcanic slopes. Relax by the crystal clear waters of Acropolis, Mykonos and Santorini beaches. Gaze across the Baroque-styled parapets of Palamidi Castle at Nafplio’s red-tiled roofs and the azure Argolic Gulf.
items.tourOgTitle: Delphi & Meteora: Grecian Treasures Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Mediterranean’s Glamorous Summer Resorts
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 14 Days Jul 02 – Jul 16, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail along the scenic Amalfi coastline and explore the uncrowded islands of Corsica and Sardinia. Learn how Monemvasia's founders hid an entire Medieval city from mainland raiders and sip delicious regional wines. Delve into living a Spartan existence in Sparta and Byzantine Medieval life in Mystras. Wander Taormina's cobbled lanes and take in views of Mount Etna and Naxo Bay over generous pours local of Sicilian Nero d'Avola wine. Linger late at an outdoor restaurant over sweet Limoncello and tiramisu indulgences during a Sorrento overnight. Alghero is known for its Catalan heritage, medieval architecture, and stunning beaches. Follow weathered Roman forum flagstones and the shadowy corridors of Rome's Colosseum. Venture inland from Bastia to the terraced vineyards of Oletta and Patrimonio for authentic Corsican hospitality, tart sheep cheeses, and hearty regional wines.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Mediterranean’s Glamorous Summer Resorts

items.title: Star Collector: Shades of Southern Italy & Greece via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 21 Days Jul 02 – Jul 23, 2026 21 Days May 11 – Jun 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Stunning coastlines and enchanting islands are waiting for you on this voyage through the Italian Mediterranean. Enjoy Sicily’s charms, along with scenic treasures like Cinque Terre and historic wonders from Pompeii to the Palace of the Grand Masters. Discover Sicily with five port calls that circle the island. As a crossroads of civilizations you never know what you’ll find here: the Greek temples of Agrigento in Porto Empedocle one day, Palermo’s Arab-Norman cathedrals with their dazzling mosaics another, ancient Syracuse the next. Bite into that iconic Sicilian pastry, cannoli. Find delicious Calabrian cuisine in Puglia. Cross the narrow Corinth Canal to Delphi. Take in the breathtaking chalk-white cliffs of Bonifacio and the honey-colored limestone palaces of Valletta. Pinch yourself when you wake up in Sorrento with Mt. Vesuvius in the distance, or in Portovenere on the Bay of Poets.

items.title: Flowers of the South Pacific: Fiji, the Cook Islands & French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Lautoka, Viti Levu to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 13 Days Jul 03 – Jul 16, 2026 13 Days Jul 30 – Aug 12, 2027 13 Days Aug 11 – Aug 24, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Remote beaches and rich Polynesian culture abound throughout this iconic South Pacific voyage to Fiji, Tonga, the Cook Islands, and French Polynesia, where you’ll experience the pristine beauty of turquoise lagoons, white-sand beaches, and vibrant coral reefs. On Rarotonga, join a guided nature trek, where you’ll learn about the island’s culture and history from a local. Explore the subterranean splendors of 'Ana Hulu in Tonga, a coral limestone cavern concealing centuries-old freshwater lakes, or wander scenic rainforest paths in Taveuni's Bouma National Heritage Park. Indulge in sweet cocoa farm treats during a delicious tree-to-bar tour on Vana Levu, or dine on Fijian fish dishes and tropical fruit cocktails. Rekindle romantic magic at beachside resort accommodations during an overnight stay on Bora Bora, and allow flowers to perfume the air as you sail into a fiery sunset.
items.tourOgTitle: Flowers of the South Pacific: Fiji, the Cook Islands & French Polynesia

items.title: Star Collector: Legends of the Pacific: French Polynesia, Tonga & Fiji
items.journeyText: Journey from Lautoka, Viti Levu to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 20 Days Jul 03 – Jul 23, 2026 20 Days Jul 30 – Aug 19, 2027 20 Days Aug 11 – Aug 31, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Journey through the heart of the South Pacific on this voyage between Tahiti and Fiji. Sail to legendary islands like Bora Bora, Moorea, Raiatea, and Huahine in French Polynesia, where  mountains, crystal-clear lagoons, and vibrant island culture await. Explore the pristine Cook Islands, where you can bask on Aitutaki’s famous lagoon and experience the charm of Rarotonga’s markets and volcanic peaks. Cross the International Dateline to reach the friendly shores of Tonga, one of the few remaining Polynesian kingdoms, where limestone caves, coral reefs, and authentic village traditions invite deeper exploration. In Fiji, discover lesser-visited gems such as Taveuni, Savusavu, and Dravuni, known for their  beauty and welcoming spirit. This island-hopping adventure offers a perfect balance of tropical relaxation and cultural discovery—with the added luxury of Windstar’s water access Marina.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Legends of the Pacific: French Polynesia, Tonga & Fiji

items.title: Scenic Alaska
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Juneau, Ak on Star Seeker 7 Days Jul 04 – Jul 11, 2026 7 Days Aug 07 – Aug 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Mist-shrouded evergreen forests, soaring eagles and whale pods abound on this cruise that features visits to Sitka, Juneau, Haines, and Ketchikan. Fish for halibut, lingcod and rockfish on a guided fishing trip near the picturesque Tongass National Forest. Bicycle remote coastal roads and hike the soft trails of a mossy temperate rainforest outside Sitka, or try your hand stretching molten glass in a local artist studio. Experience the clamor and challenges of directing a dog team from a dogsled. Alaska’s pristine beauty remains the perfect accompaniment to baked salmon served on an aromatic cedar planks, decadent king crab legs and rustic clam chowder with Yukon potatoes, and this journey is rich in opportunities for sampling fresh-caught seafood and authentic local fare.
items.tourOgTitle: Scenic Alaska

items.title: Alaskan Coastal Adventures & Denali Discovery Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Juneau, Ak on Star Seeker 11 Days Jul 04 – Jul 15, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on an exploration of Alaskan coasts, glacial fjords, and majestic mountains on this inland tour and scenic cruise highlighting the “must-sees” of Alaska. Amble Fairbank’s Gold Rush streets and savor the sumptuous simplicity of Alaskan crab legs paired with locally crafted amber ales. Board a riverboat bound for a rustic Athabascan Indian village on the Chena River. Keep your camera and binoculars ready while you are on the lookout for caribou, Dall sheep and reclusive riverbank grizzly in Denali National Park. Board a train bound for Talkeetna, then sample artisan ice cream and gourmet coffees as you relax shoulder-to-shoulder with Denali wilderness expedition teams and seasoned mountaineering parties. Cycle remote Sitka coastal roads. Drift close to blue-hued glacial ice on a guided kayak excursion in Tongass National Forest. Lead a raucous team of friendly canines on a dogsled ride across Mendenhall Glacier’s alabaster expanses.
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Coastal Adventures & Denali Discovery Cruise Tour

items.title: Around Iceland
items.journeyText: Journey from Reykjavik to Reykjavik on Star Pride 7 Days Jul 06 – Jul 13, 2026 7 Days Jul 13 – Jul 20, 2026 7 Days Jul 20 – Jul 27, 2026 SEE ALL 14 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: In the land of fire and ice, your Windstar voyage around Iceland brings you to an otherwordly landscape. Glaciers top mountains, even volcanos. Startlingly blue lagoons, heated by vents from under the Earth's crust. Your cruise begins in the capital city of Reykjavik. As your ship circumnavigates the island, Iceland cruise excursions reveal once-in-a-lifetime experiences, such as hikes on ice and on lava fields. You may explore lava caves with helmet and flashlight or take a flightseeing tour over icy glacial terrain. Nature tours by Zodiac provide up-close views of humpback whales. History tours include Viking lore. Under the near 24-hour Midnight Sun, your Iceland cruise takes you far beyond the typical tourist hot spots – including an overnight in Seydisfjordur, with its colorful chalet-style homes. The leisurely pace affords time to converse with the locals, sample Icelandic cuisine and craft beer.
items.tourOgTitle: Around Iceland

items.title: Star Collector: Italian Charms & Croatian Coastlines
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Surf 17 Days Jul 07 – Jul 24, 2026 17 Days Aug 01 – Aug 18, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Journey from Southern Italy to the Istrian Coast on this Italian charms & Croatian Coastline cruise. You’ll start in Vibo Valentia to see the beaches of Southern Italy. You can visit the Bronze Statues of Riace Warriors in Reggio Calabria. Next, stop in Taranto to gaze at Greek ruins. In Otranto, you will have a chance to see the historic conical homes in Alberobello. From Puglia, you will detour to the island of Rab in the Northern Dalmatia region of Croatia. Walk through Rovinj’s cobblestone streets up to the St. Euphemia Cathedral. Have an overnight in Dubrovnik. Your Calabrian to Istria pilgrimage continues in Montenegro, as you sail the fjord that leads to Kotor, a UNESCO site. Your final stop is in Piran, Slovenia. Take a tour to Lake Bled and visit Bled Church on an island in the middle of the lake. Your expedition ends in Venice, where you can explore the city at your own pace.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Italian Charms & Croatian Coastlines

items.title: Bella Italia - A Southern Italian Romance
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Surf 8 Days Jul 07 – Jul 15, 2026 8 Days Aug 01 – Aug 09, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Rediscover small-ship cruising's unique advantages and immerse yourself in southern Italy during this sailing to the Calabria and Puglia regions. Follow your Amalfi guide past deep ravines, hidden seabird nests and dramatic Mediterranean vistas on a trek to an Italian hamlet. Cook up your own Calabrian cuisine and dine on salamis, warm crusty breads and fresh cheeses during a cooking class in Vibo Valentia. Admire 2,500-year-old bearded bronze statues of Greek Riace warriors.  Explore the narrow, labyrinth-like lanes of Taranto in Puglia, a spectacular coastal city rich in Greek ruins. Wander through Otranto, a historic coastal town known for its picturesque harbor and the stunning Otranto Cathedral with its famous mosaic floor. Glide through emerald-green seas and seek out soaring terns and darting schools of fish during a placid kayak tour in the waters of Rab, Croatia.
items.tourOgTitle: Bella Italia - A Southern Italian Romance

items.title: Star Collector: Corsica, Sardinia & Amalfi Memories
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 14 Days Jul 09 – Jul 23, 2026 14 Days Jul 16 – Jul 30, 2026 14 Days Jul 23 – Aug 06, 2026 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail to Italian islands with unique cultural heritage, and to small resort-style ports popular with well-heeled but laid-back Europeans. Rocky coves and vivid blue waters make these islands worth visiting. Enjoy the view as you approach the tall limestone cliffs supporting the medieval town of Bonifacio on Corsica, cruise past Stromboli Volcano, and call at the mainland port of Amalfi where the coastal scenery is literally legendary. Explore all this beauty with activities ranging from dolphin watching to kayaking to bicycling on the bucolic island of Lipari. You’ll find an abundance of history and culture to boot, from Bronze Age ruins to Napoleon’s Corsican legacy, and artsy seaside towns like Sardinia’s Bosa, where colorful houses catch the eye, and the 12th-century castle is almost an afterthought. Enjoy after-hours treats from illuminated fortresses to artisanal sunsets in Alghero.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Corsica, Sardinia & Amalfi Memories

items.title: Treasure Troves of Corsica & Sardinia
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 7 Days Jul 09 – Jul 16, 2026 7 Days Jul 23 – Jul 30, 2026 7 Days Aug 20 – Aug 27, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Rustic pastas garnished with regional sheep cheeses and hearty red wines enhance the cultural flavors of this seven-day Sardinia cruise. Visit popular Italian vacation spots that are destinations rich in unhurried authenticity. Venture inland from Bastia to the tiny, terraced village of Oletta and sample family-owned Corsican wines in the shade of olive and chestnut groves. Relax in the quiet solitude of an Ajaccio beach or nibble on dried hams, colorful olives, and succulent fruits at the daily morning market at Corsica's coastal capital. Learn about Alghero's Catalan origins and Gothic architecture, then linger late into the evening over plates of decadent Sardinian pasta flavored with local pecorino romano cheeses during an overnight port stay. Shop for handcrafted Sardinian ceramics and leather bags or relax with beachside refreshments among locals in the tiny port of Golfo Aranci.
items.tourOgTitle: Treasure Troves of Corsica & Sardinia

items.title: Star Collector: Legends of Scandinavia & the Baltic
items.journeyText: Journey from Stockholm to Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland on Star Legend 17 Days Jul 15 – Aug 01, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: How do you describe an itinerary where every port is a star? All the Scandinavian “musts” are here –  half-timbered houses, charming small villages where most cruise ships don’t visit, stunning Norwegian fjords. But there’s so much more. Discover the dunes of the Lithuanian Sahara, a Danish vineyard, Norway’s forest nymphs. A World War II concentration camp, Cold War missile silos, a Viking warship, a rock church. In Gdansk, Poland, explore the roots of Solidarity, and a town where weathervanes seem to cluster together like schools of fish. All this mixed up with delicious microbreweries, exhilarating outdoor adventures, and shops that entice with everything from honey-colored amber to colorful Dala horses.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Legends of Scandinavia & the Baltic

items.title: Seven Gems of the Baltic
items.journeyText: Journey from Stockholm to Copenhagen on Star Legend 7 Days Jul 15 – Jul 22, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Join Windstar on an unforgettable Baltic voyage across seven countries, exploring the well-preserved medieval streets of Tallinn, Estonia; the modern vibrancy of Helsinki, Finland; and beyond. Enjoy an overnight in Stockholm, Sweden, where you’ll experience the world’s oldest open-air museum and savor the local fare, like kroppkakor (hearty potato dumplings) or kålpudding (cabbage pudding). Discover the medieval charm and stunning architecture of Riga, Latvia and Gdansk, Poland by strolling through their historic Old Towns. Navigate the unspoiled Curonian Spit by kurenkahn, a traditional flat-bottom boat, or kayak along the scenic coastline of Bornholm, Denmark, exploring the tranquil bays. Each destination is carefully curated to offer a blend of historical insights, natural beauty and modern Scandinavian living.
items.tourOgTitle: Seven Gems of the Baltic

items.title: Star Collector: 2026 Grand Europe Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Stockholm to Piraeus, Athens on Star Legend 80 Days Jul 15 – Oct 03, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Come abord this grand voyage to soak up the World's most beautiful landscapes: Norwegian fjords, Italy’s Cinque Terre, Northern Ireland’s Giant’s Causeway. Experience history at ancient Ephesus, on D-Day beaches, and as you wander the buried city of Pompeii. View the world’s most stunning architecture, including the Moorish beauty of the Alhambra, the Guggenheim, and Barcelona’s Sagrada Familia. With frequent overnight stays and late evening departures, you can reach attractions inland and get a literal taste of local cultures, from wine tasting in Bordeaux to a paella cooking class in Valencia. On a Windstar Grand Voyage the crew becomes like a second family, learning to anticipate your every desire and making the yacht your new home. With such an intimate group of cruisers onboard, shipmates quickly become friends, sharing past travels and port adventures.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: 2026 Grand Europe Adventure

items.title: Adriatic Icons & Venetian Treasures
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Venice on Wind Surf 9 Days Jul 15 – Jul 24, 2026 9 Days Aug 09 – Aug 18, 2026 9 Days Sep 10 – Sep 19, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin and end in one of the world’s most romantic cities, make your way up and down the eastern Adriatic exploring medieval Old Towns, Dalmatian resorts and traditional Croatian culture. Feel goosebumps as you wind your way up Montenegro’s stunning fjord to Kotor and make your sea approach to Venice. Visit famous Croatian resort towns like Hvar, where perfect pebble beaches lure the rich and famous. Spend the night in Dubrovnik, as magical after dark as it is by day. Taste Dalmatian prosciutto in Zadar and wild truffles in Rovinj. Discover the vaguely Italian flavor of Piran, a legacy of 500 years under Venetian rule. Shop for amazing handicrafts like Pag Island lace and Zovnica wool purses. Relax on a seaside promenade with a glass of Croatian wine. And as your voyage draws to a close, return to Venice where every canal and wafer-thin alleyway leads to serendipitous discoveries.
items.tourOgTitle: Adriatic Icons & Venetian Treasures

items.title: Italy and the Allure of the Aeolian Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 7 Days Jul 16 – Jul 23, 2026 7 Days Jul 30 – Aug 06, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Scenic vineyards, dizzying Amalfi coastal vistas, timeless village piazzas, and ancient Roman ruins make perfect backdrops for this cruise along Italy's coast to the isles of Corsica and Sardinia. Relax on a sandy beach outside Ponza or escape on a boat tour to the clear turquoise waters and sundrenched shorelines punctuated by shadowy coastal grottos. Sip the sweetness of local Amalfi limoncello and tour the haunting ruins of Pompeii. Cycle past geologic wonders on Lipari - the largest and most storied of the seven Aeolian isles - then pause at an Italian hamlet for liquid refreshments and light bites. Luxuriate along the Emerald Coast near Porto Cervo, Sardinia's luxurious enclave for reclusive yacht owners and Europe's most expensive real estate. Inspect the dramatic vistas of Bonifacio, Corsica's oldest settlement known for its cliffs, medieval citadel, and stunning coastal views.
items.tourOgTitle: Italy and the Allure of the Aeolian Islands

items.title: Alaskan Explorations & Denali Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Seward, Anchorage, Alaska on Star Seeker 14 Days Jul 18 – Aug 01, 2026 14 Days Jun 12 – Jun 26, 2027 14 Days Jul 17 – Jul 31, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Awaken and inspire your sense of adventure as you sail north through Canada’s Inside Passage, visiting the Alaskan towns of Wrangell and Haines. A journey through stunning landscapes, rich history, and unique wildlife. Admire the glaciated slopes and ice floes of Alaska’s Misty Fjords, Tracy Arm and Kenai Fjords, but keep a weather eye on the horizon for the telltale spray and black fins of orca pods. Disembark in Seward and ride inland to Fairbanks and scenic Denali National Park. Caribou, foxes and Dall sheep observations are nearly certain, but even the locals grow excited about grizzly and wolf pack sightings. A detailed float along the Chena River provides additional opportunities for ursine encounters prior to your transfer to Fairbanks Airport and your reentry into the predictabilities of a less-adventurous modern civilization.
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Explorations & Denali Cruise Tour

items.title: Endless Days in Norway
items.journeyText: Journey from Copenhagen to Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland on Star Legend 10 Days Jul 22 – Aug 01, 2026 10 Days Jul 25 – Aug 04, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Scenery lovers and active outdoorsy types will both find plenty to love on these fjord-focused cruises Norway is best known for. Take a cable car to a mountain peak overlooking Andalsnes and the Romsdal Alps, hike back down or go for a scenic train ride through the mountains and across the picturesque stone Kylling Bridge. Visit tiny Olden at the inner end of Nordfjord and hike to a glacier’s face, or take the Skylift to lofty views. Go mountain biking on Mount Fløyen in Bergen, or wander the shops at the colorful Hanseatic wharf. In Trondheim, you can do both – use the city’s free bikes for a ride around town to check out the emerging foodie scene. We’ll follow the fjord all the way to the sea and beyond, to the island of Frøya, where much of the world’s farmed fish is grown and tables are set with fresh crab, scallops, and local cheese. These are the kinds of immersive experiences that define the cruises Norway travelers seek: close encounters with fjords, mountains, and coastal culture.
items.tourOgTitle: Endless Days in Norway

items.title: Star Collector: Scottish and Viking Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Copenhagen to Dun Laoghaire, Dublin on Star Explorer 18 Days Jul 22 – Aug 09, 2026 18 Days Jul 25 – Aug 12, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Savor the sight of indigo fjords and colorful fjord towns, and delve into Celtic culture from Scottish tartans and historic Highland castles to lively Irish celidhs. Incredible scenery takes many forms: Rapunzel-like waterfalls, romantic ruins, crooked old warehouses, wild islands. And with a mix of popular ports and several small maiden ports, there’s always something new to discover. Explore Bergen’s UNESCO wharf and Alesund’s famous Art Deco architecture – two towns in a neck-and-neck race for the most picturesque fjord city. Discover neolithic ruins on remote Scottish isles, sip local tipples from Guinness to whisky, and trace legends to their source at the Giant’s Causeway and Loch Ness. This unique itinerary includes maiden calls to tiny fjord towns like Andalsnes, Froya, and OldenLoen, as well as Trondheim, Norway’s charming and walkable first capital.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Scottish and Viking Adventure

items.title: Star Collector: Southern Italian Enchantment & Balkan Beaches
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Venice on Wind Surf 16 Days Jul 24 – Aug 09, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Legends like Rome, Venice and Dubrovnik just scratch the surface of this cruise to Italy and the Dalmatian Coast. Take your time investigating both sides of Italy’s “boot” from the Vatican to authentic Sicilian pizza. We’ll linger in Southern Italy to explore small Puglian towns known only to locals. Cruise past the stunning white cliffs of Vibo Valentia. Pop your head inside the conical white trulli houses in Alberobello, and the Reggio Calabria Museum with its life-sized bronze Riace Warriors. Find yourself overwhelmed by the baroque beauty of Lecce, the Florence of the south, and delve into a Southern Italian culinary culture that turns pasta into works of art. Across the Adriatic you’ll find medieval walled cities like Dubrovnik and Kotor, with late stays in both so you can wander Old Town streets. Discover Croatia’s amazing beaches, travertine waterfalls and lush green pine forests.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Southern Italian Enchantment & Balkan Beaches

items.title: President's Cruise: Mãori Storytellers & French Polynesian Treasures
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 11 Days Jul 30 – Aug 10, 2026 11 Days May 30 – Jun 10, 2027 11 Days Sep 05 – Sep 16, 2027 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail to pristine and uncrowded coves during this exploration of tropical isles and Māori culture throughout French Polynesia. Slip onto your own Waverunner and set a course for remote snorkeling on Raiatea. In the Cook Islands, relax on isolated Rarotonga beaches, then venture into friendly Aitutaki for small town tropical fruit smoothies, tuna poke bowls and fish curry. Take in the Māori culture and language as you interact with Cook Island natives. Sip refreshments on a sunset sailing across Bora Bora's lagoon waters prior to an overnight port stay, or check into romantic bungalows on the beach at an island resorts. Sample fragrant Taha'a vanilla at a plantation or explore stone temples and archaeological sites on Huahine. Then, board an outrigger canoe bound for a remote motu, where you'll learn how to cook up a local lunch with a side of relaxing warm, sandy beachfront.
items.tourOgTitle: President's Cruise: Mãori Storytellers & French Polynesian Treasures

items.title: Comprehensive Iceland Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Reykjavik to Reykjavik on Star Pride 10 Days Jul 31 – Aug 10, 2026 10 Days Aug 21 – Aug 31, 2026 10 Days Jul 05 – Jul 15, 2027 SEE ALL 9 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Take in the glow of pink midnight skies as you stand before fragile moss-shrouded arctic deserts punctuated by alabaster icefields on a 10-day combination cruise and tour that integrates inland adventures with a coastal circumnavigation of Iceland. Venture inshore to Iceland’s untouched regions, including the Hraunfoss Lava Falls and glowing blue ice caverns beneath the Langjokull Glacier. Bask in the steamy comfort of Blue Lagoon’s outdoor geothermal spa. Wander Reykjavik’s cultural museums and make your way along inviting side streets where former fishing homes offer basement bars. Sample Kjötsúpa, a regional lamb stew rich in root vegetables. Spend an evening amid the colorful and quirky Seydisfjordur, a summer haven for artists and a jumping-off point for naturalists and scientists studying puffins, kittiwakes and innumerable wildlife in the nearby Skálanes Nature Reserve.
items.tourOgTitle: Comprehensive Iceland Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Luck and Legends - Ireland and Scotland
items.journeyText: Journey from Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland to Paris/Rouen on Star Legend 18 Days Aug 01 – Aug 19, 2026 18 Days Aug 04 – Aug 22, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This Scotland and Ireland cruise inspired the world's best poets, writers, and composers for centuries. Create your own travel opus on this sailing to mysterious stone age monoliths and genial coastal communities. Seek out red squirrels and elusive pine martens on a guided stroll to Rogie Falls on Scotland's Blackwater River near Invergordon. Explore the neolithic circles and the prehistoric settlement of Skara Brae, just beyond the white walls of Orkney's storied Skaill House. Walk on some of the 40,000 coastal basalt stones along the Giant's Causeway beyond Portrush. Indulge in Galway's local fish and chips, or stroll amid megalithic limestone tombs in The Burren--imposing monuments predating Egypt's pyramids. Lean out over the battlements of Blarney Castle and kiss the Blarney Stone for luck, then unwind with smokey whiskey samples at Cork County's storied Jameson Distillery.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Luck and Legends - Ireland and Scotland

items.title: Gaelic Explorers
items.journeyText: Journey from Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland to Dun Laoghaire, Dublin on Star Legend 8 Days Aug 01 – Aug 09, 2026 8 Days Aug 04 – Aug 12, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: From the pubs of Dublin to the castles of Edinburgh, this immersive cruise to Scotland journeys through hills and highlands, idyllic islands, and lyrical landscapes. Here in the land of good Scotch and great golf, astonishing natural beauty meets refined elegance in beautiful ports and quaint marinas, with ancient sites like Skara Brae offering a glimpse into Scotland's earliest history. Celebrate Scotland's iconic past and lively present – and toast the spirit of the Emerald Isle.
items.tourOgTitle: Gaelic Explorers

items.title: Treasure Troves of Corsica & Sardinia: A Total Solar Eclipse
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Wind Spirit 7 Days Aug 06 – Aug 13, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: The solar eclipse on August 12, 2026, will captivate observers worldwide. One of the prime spots to witness this celestial event is at sea, where you'll have an unobstructed view of the horizon as the eclipse reaches totality. The eclipse will travel directly over Mallorca, providing a unique opportunity to see totality along the horizon. Explore Corsica and Sardinia, showcasing rustic pastas and regional sheep cheeses. Discover Alghero's Catalan roots. In Bastia, explore the charming old town and stroll through the vibrant Vieux Port. Please Note: Viewing the total solar eclipse will depend on the weather and Windstar Cruises cannot guarantee the viewing conditions of the total solar eclipse. There is the possibility that passengers may not see the totality or may only see it for a brief period, due to factors that are out of our control.

items.title: Alaskan Coastal Adventures & Denali Discovery Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Juneau, Ak on Star Seeker 12 Days Aug 07 – Aug 19, 2026 12 Days Jul 02 – Jul 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on an exploration of Alaskan coasts, glacial fjords, and majestic mountains on this inland tour and scenic cruise highlighting the “must-sees” of Alaska. Amble Fairbank’s Gold Rush streets and savor the sumptuous simplicity of Alaskan crab legs paired with locally crafted amber ales. Board a riverboat bound for a rustic Athabascan Indian village on the Chena River. Keep your camera and binoculars ready while you are on the lookout for caribou, Dall sheep and reclusive riverbank grizzly in Denali National Park. Board a train bound for Talkeetna, then sample artisan ice cream and gourmet coffees as you relax shoulder-to-shoulder with Denali wilderness expedition teams and seasoned mountaineering parties. Cycle remote Sitka coastal roads. Drift close to blue-hued glacial ice on a guided kayak excursion in Tongass National Forest. Lead a raucous team of friendly canines on a dogsled ride across Mendenhall Glacier’s alabaster expanses.
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Coastal Adventures & Denali Discovery Cruise Tour

items.title: Circumnavigating Ireland
items.journeyText: Journey from Dun Laoghaire, Dublin to Paris/Rouen on Star Legend 10 Days Aug 09 – Aug 19, 2026 10 Days Aug 12 – Aug 22, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Uncover the rich experiences awaiting you on this 8-day Ireland and Northern Ireland cruise. Stroll past 400-year-old stone walls and gleaming brass fixtures while inhaling fragrant whiskey aromas at the world's oldest licensed whiskey distillery outside Londonderry, Ireland. Experience the breathtaking Cliffs of Moher as you cruise between Galway and Dingle. Take in the sweeping coastal views 2,000 feet above the waves at the crest of Slieve League Cliffs, one of Europe's highest coastal precipices and a mere giant's boulder toss from the white-walled village of Killybegs. Visit Killary Fjord, the only fjord in Ireland. Tap your toes to Irish flutes and sip tea near stone monuments that make up the Dingle Peninsula's rich archaeological heritage. Kiss the Blarney Stone atop the storied battlements of Blarney Castle. Then, sample Irish coffee with Cork locals at an authentic pub.
items.tourOgTitle: Circumnavigating Ireland

items.title: Star Collector: Irish Stout to Bordeaux Wine: A Tour of Ireland and France
items.journeyText: Journey from Dun Laoghaire, Dublin to Bordeaux on Star Legend 17 Days Aug 09 – Aug 26, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Irish dancing, twinkling Parisian lights and sublime French wines enhance your tasteful cultural immersion throughout this sailing around Ireland and along the French coastline. Explore Ireland's Inishowen Peninsula, a natural encapsulation of Emerald Isle habitats, and wander sandy coastal reaches and cobbled village lanes prior to tea and local treats at a village beyond Londonderry. Take a stroll around St. Mary's quay to the formidable Star Castle, a 1593 fortification built to reinforce England. Spend two exceptional days in Paris visiting the Louvre Museum, Versailles and Notre-Dame during your extended port stay at Rouen. Venture inland from the coastal town of Lorient for Breton tea time with the Duchess of Rohan amid Josselin Castle's tasteful elegance. Unwind over exceptional glasses of blended red wines and fine French cuisine during an overnight Bordeaux port stay.

items.title: Around Iceland: A Total Solar Eclipse
items.journeyText: Journey from Reykjavik to Reykjavik on Star Pride 7 Days Aug 10 – Aug 17, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: The solar eclipse on August 12, 2026, promises to be a spectacular celestial event. The best place to experience this incredible phenomenon – Iceland. The eclipse will pass directly over the Western coast of Iceland, near Isafjordur. Your Windstar cruise around Iceland brings you to otherworldly landscapes. Dark volcanic peaks rise above fluorescent green hillsides. Blue lagoons, heated by vents from under the Earth's crust. Your cruise begins in the capital city of Reykjavik. You may take a flightseeing tour that includes filming locations for the TV show, “The Game of Thrones.” Nature tours by Zodiac provide up-close views of humpback whales. Your Iceland cruise takes you far beyond the typical tourist hot spots – including an overnight in Seydisfjordur, with its colorful chalet-style homes. The leisurely pace affords time to converse with the locals and sample Icelandic cuisine.
items.tourOgTitle: Around Iceland: A Total Solar Eclipse

items.title: Star Collector: Captivating Corsica & Sardinia
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 14 Days Aug 13 – Aug 27, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail away to the alluring islands of the Mediterranean where cultures and cuisines meld in a delicious synergy and medieval citadels stand guard over delectable pebble beaches. Revel in the French feel of Mallorca with its Art Nouveau buildings and musical Catalan language. Find hints of Britain on Menorca from Georgian architecture and row houses to gin distilleries, then head outdoors to fully appreciate this UNESCO World Biosphere Reserve. Explore Corsica in its entirety, from the stunning limestone cliffs raising Bonifacio above the sea to charming and walkable Calvi. Overnight in Italy’s Alghero, a Sardinian town with a Catalan influence and Iberian charm. In Golfo Aranci, Sardinia, discover the stunning coastline with crystal-clear waters, picturesque coves, and rugged cliffs, perfect for exploring by boat or relaxing on secluded beaches.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Captivating Corsica & Sardinia

items.title: Star Collector: Mediterranean Crossroads: Spain, France, Italy & Greece
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Spirit 21 Days Aug 13 – Sep 03, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Follow a wide-ranging Mediterranean route that connects Spain, France, Italy, and Greece into one continuous journey shaped by small-ship access and thoughtful pacing. From the Balearic Islands to Corsica’s varied coastline, the voyage favors ports where life unfolds steps from the dock, including Mahón, Calvi, Bastia, Ajaccio, and cliff-backed Bonifacio. Time deepens the experience with overnights in Alghero and Sorrento, allowing evenings ashore for local dining, waterfront walks, and unhurried exploration. As the route moves east through Sicily and Messina, island landscapes give way to classical Greece, with calls in Gythion and Monemvasia offering access to Sparta, Mystras, and medieval stone towns before the journey concludes in Athens.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Mediterranean Crossroads: Spain, France, Italy & Greece

items.tourMetaDescription: Sample the Mediterranean’s magic on an art-focused voyage from Rome to Barcelona with curated excursions. Explore Elba, Corsica, Mallorca and Menorca, fragrant with citrus and olives, between Mallorca’s green mountains and Portoferraio’s white pebble shores. Inspiring and creatively focused. Along the way, deepen your creative journey with immersive onboard experiences, including an artist-led workshop where you’ll craft your own small mosaic piece to take home as a lasting keepsake. Inspiring, immersive, and creatively focused.

items.title: Lake Como & Adriatic Romance Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 11 Days Aug 15 – Aug 26, 2026 11 Days Apr 17 – Apr 28, 2027 11 Days Sep 28 – Oct 09, 2027 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge in rustic Italian cuisine, Roman relics and Baroque masterworks on a 11-day odyssey that combines a picturesque overland exploration of Lake Como and Venice with an extensive cruise through the Adriatic and along Italy’s West Coast. Delve into the depths of delectable Northeast Italian wine vintages and savor Amarone’s cherry and cinnamon nuances in a cool, underground Valpolicella winery. Overnight provides time to float past Venice’s romantic arched bridges and ancient alleyways on a gondola ride. Dip a kayak blade in the clear waters near old harbor walls outside Dubrovnik. Sample homemade cheeses and sausages in a family-run olive grove near Kotor. Wander between restored mosaics, broken columns and cracked pottery amid Pompeii’s storied ruins. Dine on authentic, handmade pizza while gentle coastal breezes waft through Sorrento’s aromatic citrus trees.
items.tourOgTitle: Lake Como & Adriatic Romance Cruise Tour

items.title: Mãori Storytellers & French Polynesian Treasures

items.tourMetaDescription: Sail to pristine and uncrowded coves during this exploration of tropical isles and Māori culture throughout French Polynesia. Slip onto your own Waverunner and set a course for remote snorkeling on Raiatea. In the Cook Islands, relax on isolated Rarotonga beaches, then venture into friendly Aitutaki for small town tropical fruit smoothies, tuna poke bowls and fish curry. Take in the Māori culture and language as you interact with Cook Island natives. Sip refreshments on a sunset sailing across Bora Bora's lagoon waters prior to an overnight port stay, or check into romantic bungalows on the beach at an island resorts. Sample fragrant Taha'a vanilla at a plantation or explore stone temples and archaeological sites on Huahine. Then, board an outrigger canoe bound for a remote motu, where you'll learn how to cook up a local lunch with a side of relaxing warm, sandy beachfront.
items.tourOgTitle: Mãori Storytellers & French Polynesian Treasures

items.title: Star Collector: Iconic Italy and Croatia
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 15 Days Aug 18 – Sep 02, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore picturesque ports and ancient ruins during this cruise along Adriatic coastlines, central Mediterranean and the timeless Rivera. Float on the Cetina River, rich in waterfalls, lush forests, with delicious Croatian snacks. Board Zodiac boats in Dubrovnik's Old Town Port and snorkel near the stunning Modra Splja Cave. Cook up Montenegrin lamb and Balkan porridge with a professional Kotor chef. Explore Italy's iconic ports, such as the glamorous Portofino with its luxury yachts, Rome's bustling port of Civitavecchia - the gateway to the Eternal City, Sorrento's charming marina overlooking the Bay of Naples, and Genoa's rich historic maritime heritage, each offering a unique blend of history, beauty, and vibrant coastal culture. Browse Monte Carlo boutiques for one-of-a-kind souvenirs and walk the streets that still host one of the oldest and most famous car races in the world.

items.title: Vatican & Croatian Coastlines Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 10 Days Aug 18 – Aug 28, 2026 10 Days Sep 19 – Sep 29, 2026 10 Days Apr 20 – Apr 30, 2027 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Delve into architectural and epicurean wonders on both sides of the Italian peninsula during this 10-day adventure. An Adriatic and Dalmatian Coast itinerary sails along the Croatian coast, paired with immersive experiences in Italy, including a Vatican tour, Colosseum visit, and foodie market tour in Rome. Listen to the Venetian clock tower bells of Torre dell’Orologio strike the hour as hundreds of pigeons scatter about St. Mark’s Square. Sip crisp and dry Verdicchio paired with octopus salad or garlic-flavored black risotto in delicious Dubrovnik, a highlight of the cruise along Croatia's storied Dalmatian coastline. Drift past the blue domes of Our Lady of the Rocks, a sanctuary for Kotor’s local fishermen for nearly 2,000 years. Sample succulent baked cardoon stalks harvested from Sicilian thistles and dusted with melted aged Parmesan cheese near the precipitous slopes of Mount Etna in Giardini Naxos. Experience an exclusive tour deep into the storied shadows of the Colosseum and the Sistine Chapel.
items.tourOgTitle: Vatican & Croatian Coastlines Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Palates & Palettes of Northern Spain and France
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Lisbon on Star Legend 15 Days Aug 19 – Sep 03, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Impressionist artists like Monet and Renoir spent a lifetime trying to capture the beauty and soul of western France. It took Julia Child just one meal in Normandy to fall in love with French cuisine. Be won over on this sensory journey to Northern Spain and France. Follow the Comino to the cathedral at Santiago de Compostela, a pilgrimage site for a thousand years. Sip cider in Gijon at the heart of “Green Spain,” a place even many Spaniards are unfamiliar with. Treat your palate to Basque cuisine. You’ll see hills covered in vineyards and chateaux in Bordeaux, Monet’s famous water lilies in Giverny, Mont St. Michel abbey perched on a tiny island like a wedding cake ornament, and as many Parisian wonders as you can absorb with a two-night stay in Rouen. Delicious. Moving. Awe-inspiring. This voyage is all that and more.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Palates & Palettes of Northern Spain and France

items.title: Star Collector: French Elegance and Spanish Flair
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Barcelona on Star Legend 23 Days Aug 19 – Sep 11, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Uncover a wealth of treasures on a remarkable voyage from Paris, France to Barcelona, Spain, enriched by multiple overnight port stays. Your journey begins with an overnight stay in Rouen, offering time to explore Paris's iconic landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the charming Montmartre district. From there, sail down the western coast of France, where four days among Bordeaux's vineyards await, providing a perfect opportunity for exploration and wine tasting. In St. Malo, walk along the medieval fortifications, delving into the city's storied maritime past. As the cruise continues through the Iberian Peninsula, experience Bilbao, renowned for its contemporary art and architecture. In Seville, marvel at the grandeur of the Alcázar and soak in the vibrant-historic city. The adventure extends to Tangier, where the exotic charm of Moroccan souks and promise a truly immersive experience.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: French Elegance and Spanish Flair

items.title: James Beard Foundation: French Feast: Normandy, Brittany & Aquitaine
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Bordeaux on Star Legend 7 Days Aug 19 – Aug 26, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This comprehensive exploration of France includes an overnight in Rouen (Paris), and visits the Normandy, Brittany, and Aquitaine regions of France. Treat your palate to fine wines in Bordeaux and cider in Brittany. Taste regional specialties like Cancale oysters and Breton galettes. And feast your eyes on timeless scenery: the abbey on Mont St. Michel, St. Malo’s pink sandstone cliffs, Monet’s garden in Giverny where water lilies still have the power to inspire. See iconic sights like the Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame. And write your own adventures as you hike the unspoiled wild Breton coast.
items.tourOgTitle: James Beard Foundation: French Feast: Normandy, Brittany & Aquitaine

items.title: Star Collector: Mediterranean Masterpieces of Italy & Northern Greece
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Spirit 14 Days Aug 20 – Sep 03, 2026 14 Days Sep 19 – Oct 03, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Step into history on your voyage from Rome to Athens. From Rome, you will set sail for Sorrento, Italy, where you can explore nearby UNESCO archaeological sites, including Pompeii. Messina in Sicily will bring you to Mount Etna, an active volcano and UNESCO site. The quaint fishing town of Gythion — once known as Sparta — is an easy area to wander on foot, and you can join a tour to the Dyros Caves or Mystras Byzantine City. Visit the medieval city of Monemvasia, all built on a giant rock. Don't miss the collection of artifacts at the Acropolis Museum in Athens, or hike to see the famous Pantheon. An overnight in Thessaloniki allows time to discover the best of the city’s nightlife. In Volos, visit the Meteora Byzantine Monasteries near the town of Kalabata. Wrap up your sailing with a day on Skopelos, the charming island best known as the setting for the film Mamma Mia!
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Mediterranean Masterpieces of Italy & Northern Greece

items.title: Alaskan Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Seward, Anchorage, Alaska on Star Seeker 11 Days Aug 22 – Sep 02, 2026 11 Days Aug 21 – Sep 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
"Conde Nast Traveler 2019 Hot List ""As far as Alaskan expeditions go, this itinerary gives passengers more access to so many aspects of the state's culture than any competitor.""  - Conde Nast Traveler 
Witness the grandeur of Alaska’s premier glaciers: Mendenhall in Juneau, Kenai Fjords’ Harding Icefield, Tracy Arm’s twin Sawyer Glaciers. Discover Alaskan Native villages, Russian cathedrals, and Gold Rush history. Thrill as you watch a wild brown bear snatch a struggling salmon from a stream or a humpback whale breach off the bow. Cruise Misty Fjords and Kenai Fjords on your lovely all-suite ship, waters beyond the reach of larger Alaska cruise ships."
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Splendors

items.title: Star Collector: Alaska Discovery & Pacific Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Tokyo on Star Seeker 25 Days Aug 22 – Sep 16, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
"
Discover why Alaska is a top cruise destination as you explore its wildlife, frontier towns, native culture, and fjordland scenery, then unwind during a trans-Pacific crossing to Tokyo. This voyage is tailored to your vacation dreams. Experience Alaska’s beauty with Zodiac trips in Kenai Fjords and Tracy Arm, a ride on the White Pass Railroad, and flightseeing over glaciers. Immerse yourself in native culture with a Master Totem Carver in Ketchikan and a visit to Klukwan. Spot black and brown bears, eagles, whales, sea lions, mountain goats, and more from platforms, float trips, or your balcony. After your Alaska adventure, relax and find your favorite spots onboard as you sail to vibrant Tokyo."

items.title: Star Collector: Alaskan Wonders & Japanese Mysteries
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Kobe / Kyoto on Star Seeker 35 Days Aug 22 – Sep 26, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Vancouver through the rugged wilds of Alaska, sailing to Ketchikan, Juneau, and Sitka, before venturing across the Pacific on a stretch of 11 sea days, the perfect opportunity. Your arrival in Japan marks the beginning of the mystery cruise segment, where ports are revealed just 36 hours in advance, adding a thrilling element of surprise. But it’s not only about where you’re going—it’s about who you’re sailing with, and with Windstar as your trusted guide, every mystery becomes part of a shared adventure. After your mystery cruise segment, discover both hidden gems and iconic destinations such as Osaka, Hiroshima, and Tokyo. Small-ship access allows for immersive exploration of tucked-away harbors like Tomonoura, while still delivering the grandeur of major cities like Osaka and Tokyo.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Alaskan Wonders & Japanese Mysteries

items.title: Alaskan Explorations & Denali Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Seward, Anchorage, Alaska on Star Seeker 15 Days Aug 22 – Sep 06, 2026 15 Days Aug 21 – Sep 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Awaken and inspire your sense of adventure as you sail north through Canada’s Inside Passage, visiting the Alaskan towns of Wrangell and Haines. A journey through stunning landscapes, rich history, and unique wildlife. Admire the glaciated slopes and ice floes of Alaska’s Misty Fjords, Tracy Arm and Kenai Fjords, but keep a weather eye on the horizon for the telltale spray and black fins of orca pods. Disembark in Seward and ride inland to Fairbanks and scenic Denali National Park. Caribou, foxes and Dall sheep observations are nearly certain, but even the locals grow excited about grizzly and wolf pack sightings. A detailed float along the Chena River provides additional opportunities for ursine encounters prior to your transfer to Fairbanks Airport and your reentry into the predictabilities of a less-adventurous modern civilization.
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Explorations & Denali Cruise Tour

items.title: Final Rose & Overwater Bungalows + Air Package from LAX
items.journeyText: Journey from Moorea to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 11 Days Aug 24 – Sep 04, 2026 11 Days Oct 05 – Oct 16, 2026 11 Days Oct 19 – Oct 30, 2026 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Enjoy the perfect Tahitian vacation in paradise. Fly from Los Angeles and overnight in Papeete before heading to the hypnotically beautiful island of Moorea, one of the most romantic destinations in the world. The turquoise lagoon, Rotui Hill’s jagged emerald profile, and the scent of exotic flowers and vanilla in the air cast a spell that grows stronger by the day. Stay for three days and three gorgeous South Sea island sunsets, filling your days with unforgettable experiences. Ride an ATV through lush foliage to the breathtaking Belvedere lookout, and go snorkeling in a technicolor lagoon that dazzles with vibrant marine life.  Then, step aboard your lovely yacht for a week of island nirvana. Explore Tahitian culture and history on the “Sacred Isle” of Raiatea, and feed the sacred blue-eyed eels on less-visited Huahine. Absorb the incredible beauty of Bora Bora during a two-day stay, and don’t miss the Windstar Exclusive Destination Discovery Event—a golden evening featuring a Polynesian feast that lights up the starry night sky with dancers twirling batons of fire.

items.journeyText: Journey from Reykjavik to Boston, Ma on Star Pride 21 Days Aug 24 – Sep 14, 2026 21 Days Aug 26 – Sep 16, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Behold the youngest place on earth as you sail past Surtsey Island, created by an eruption in 1963. Overnight in Seydisfjordur, taking in cascading waterfalls and colorful historic houses imported from Norway. In Akureyri, visit Listagil, ride an Icelandic horse and soak in the sky-blue Myvatn Nature Baths. Take a polar flight to Grimsey Island and stand in the Arctic Circle. Visit Snæfellsjokull National Park in Grundarfjordur — full of glaciers, lava fields, calderas and basalt cliffs. Cruise Prince Christian Sound, a fjord system connecting the Labrador and Irminger Seas. In Greenland, soak in Uunartoq’s 100-degree hot springs, see polar bears in Nanortalik, sail Tasermiut Fjord and hike the trails out of Narsaq. Browse the shops and boulangeries along Quebec City’s Petit Champlain, and make sure to try the unique cuisine of Montreal including poutine, Arctic char and Kamouraska lamb.

Witness the beaches of Sanary-sur-Mer and the Côte d'Azur in Cannes. Taste Galicia’s legendary seafood fresh from the Bay of Biscay, sample port within sight of the Douro River in Porto, share pintxos with new Basque friends, and wine and dine amid French vineyards on the “hill with a thousand chateaux.” When you’re not busy pampering your palate, delve into the fascinating history of this region. items.title: Jewels of the Italian and French Rivieras
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 7 Days Aug 26 – Sep 02, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a journey from Corsica to the French Riviera, Monaco and the Italian Riviera, with late nights in Cannes and Genoa. Enjoy Corsica's Bastia and venture up Cliff Road  for breathtaking views of the Tuscan Archipelago. Then it’s off to Cannes, known for its sandy beaches, high-end boutiques and international film festival. Continue to Monaco and Monte Carlo. In Casino Square, try your luck at the world-famous Grand Casino. In Genoa, Italy, savor local delicacies like Stracchino cheese and pesto-topped pasta. Discover Portofino's charm, hike the promenade of Santa Margherita Ligure or try olive oil tasting and traditional trofie at the world-famous Splendido Hotel. Relax in Porto Ercole's seaside opulence or see the Southern Tuscan countryside on a visit to Antica Fattoria La Parrina, a producer of organic wine, extra-virgin olive oil, and numerous renowned cheeses.

items.title: Overwater Bungalow & Tahitian Paradises Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 10 Days Aug 27 – Sep 06, 2026 10 Days Sep 10 – Sep 20, 2026 10 Days Sep 17 – Sep 27, 2026 SEE ALL 10 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Bliss awaits as you spend magical days in a dreamy overwater bungalow and explore six of Tahiti’s most captivating islands — both must-sees like Papeete and Bora Bora and less-traveled islands like Huahine, Raiatea, and tiny Tahaa. Romance is in the air in Moorea as you watch the aquarium beneath your feet through the glass floor of your overwater bungalow, enjoy a tropical breakfast delivered by outrigger canoe, and dine on the beach at a private table for two lit only by tiki torches and stars. Go swimming or paddleboarding right from your yacht’s Marina Platform as we anchor off white-sand beaches, the air scented with vanilla. Stay overnight in three ports with time to explore Polynesian history and traditions, go drift snorkeling in coral gardens teeming with tropical fish, dive for black pearls, and watch sunsets that turn the sapphire sea all manner of fruit punch colors.
items.tourOgTitle: Overwater Bungalow & Tahitian Paradises Cruise Tour

items.title: Enchanting Meteora, Greece, and Amalfi Coast Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Spirit 10 Days Aug 27 – Sep 06, 2026 10 Days Apr 27 – May 07, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Enjoy the perfect blend of ancient marvels and breathtaking natural beauty on this Greece and Amalfi Cruise Tour. Delve deep into Greek and Roman history as you visit the home of the Oracle at Delphi, Meteora’s mystical monasteries, and the awe-inspiring ruins of Rome and Pompeii. Walk medieval lanes in Mystras and Monemvasia past a surprisingly harmonious mix of Byzantine castles, Norman churches and Moorish palaces. But don’t let the fascinating past overshadow the sheer beauty of the present. Appreciate every pixel of stone buildings covered with jasmine, oleander and bougainvillea. Cruise the dramatic coast of Sorrento and Amalfi, a tapestry of cliffs, grottoes, beaches and picturesque seaside towns. And linger in amazing gems like colorful Ponza with its gelato-colored buildings and tiny harbor – a place only big enough for small ships like ours.
items.tourOgTitle: Enchanting Meteora, Greece, and Amalfi Coast Cruise Tour

items.title: Greenland: North Atlantic Odyssey
items.journeyText: Journey from Reykjavik to Boston, Ma on Star Pride 14 Days Aug 31 – Sep 14, 2026 14 Days Sep 02 – Sep 16, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Float past turquoise-tinged ice floes as you experience Greenland’s remote southern fjords and villages prior to visiting the scenic coasts of Newfoundland, Nova Scotia and New England during this voyage along the North Atlantic’s most pristine and picturesque shorelines. Survey towering icebergs and catch glimpses of fin, killer, and pilot whale pods, along with native seabirds like fulmars, great cormorants and black-legged kittiwakes during your Denmark Strait crossing and subsequent sailing past glacier-etched outcroppings throughout Prince Christian Sound. Embark on an iceberg safari beyond Narsaq. Drift close to towering, picture-perfect ice blocks and calving glaciers in Sermilik Fjord. Sample smoky onion soup, duck filets drenched in wild berry sauce and other authentic French cuisine.
items.tourOgTitle: Greenland: North Atlantic Odyssey

items.title: Star Collector: Greenland Fjords, Canadian Maritimes
items.journeyText: Journey from Reykjavik to Montreal, Qc on Star Pride 25 Days Aug 31 – Sep 25, 2026 25 Days Sep 02 – Sep 27, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Venture into the lesser-known coastlines and communities of Greenland, Canada and New England during this remarkable voyage crossing the North Atlantic. Admire fractured glaciers, ivory ice fields and drifting ice floes on a day of scenic sailing in Greenland’s remote Prince Christian Sound. Sample grilled wolf fish, dried salted cod and tender musk ox meat amid stacked crab pots, fish-drying racks and brightly painted houses in Qaqortoq, Nanortalik and Narsaq in Greenland. Wander the grounds of a 1,000-year-old Norse settlement near St. Anthony, and tour sod buildings identical to those that sheltered early settlers from harsh Newfoundland winters centuries ago. Walk among weathered French and British artillery artifacts at National Battlefields Park, or sip your way through Quebec City’s outstanding microbreweries on a delicious walking tour in a thriving downtown community.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Greenland Fjords, Canadian Maritimes

items.title: Vatican & Croatian Coastlines Cruise Tour

items.tourMetaDescription: Delve into architectural and epicurean wonders on both sides of the Italian peninsula during this 10-day adventure. An Adriatic and Dalmatian Coast itinerary sails along the Croatian coast, paired with immersive experiences in Italy, including a Vatican tour, Colosseum visit, and foodie market tour in Rome. Listen to the Venetian clock tower bells of Torre dell’Orologio strike the hour as hundreds of pigeons scatter about St. Mark’s Square. Sip crisp and dry Verdicchio paired with octopus salad or garlic-flavored black risotto in delicious Dubrovnik, a highlight of the cruise along Croatia's storied Dalmatian coastline. Drift past the blue domes of Our Lady of the Rocks, a sanctuary for Kotor’s local fishermen for nearly 2,000 years. Sample succulent baked cardoon stalks harvested from Sicilian thistles and dusted with melted aged Parmesan cheese near the precipitous slopes of Mount Etna in Giardini Naxos. Experience an exclusive tour deep into the storied shadows of the Colosseum and the Sistine Chapel.

Establish your own rhythm in sync with the waves and the arc of the sun and moon overhead. Watch the constellations drift and let your mind shake off all the cobwebs of shore. Feast on the impossible beauty of liquid sunsets, and let your soul dance with the dolphins in the spray off the bow.
items.tourOgTitle: Ocean Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Japan and North Pacific Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Kobe / Kyoto on Star Seeker 24 Days Sep 02 – Sep 26, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Ancient temples and modern marvels await you throughout your transpacific crossing from Alaska to Japan and South Korea. Relax and rejuvenate with extended spa days, onboard entertainment, and award-winning culinary indulgences during your ocean voyage from Anchorage to Tokyo. Stand at the edge of Tokyo's Shibuya Crossing or join the flow of humanity. Pause with pilgrims at the Kumano-Nachi Taisha, a Shinto shrine and UNESCO World Heritage Site, then rest in the shade of a 850-year-old camphor tree planted by a 12th century samurai. Imagine the perils encountered by Japan's warrior class amid gardens and narrow lanes in the Chiran Samurai District near Kagoshima. Master the art of udon noodle making in Takamatsu, the birthplace of delicious udon delights. Dine on fresh fish and tangy seafood delicacies at the Jagalchi Fish Market in Busan — South Korea's largest seafood market.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Japan and North Pacific Crossing

items.title: Classic Italy & Dalmatian Coast
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Surf 8 Days Sep 02 – Sep 10, 2026 8 Days Oct 07 – Oct 15, 2026 8 Days Apr 12 – Apr 20, 2027 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore timeless cities to tiny ports of unmatched beauty on one of the classic cruises from Rome to Venice. Pose in front of the Roman Colosseum and see the ancient city of Pompeii. Sail through the breathtaking Bay of Kotor and explore the famously picturesque towns of the Amalfi Coast. Wander the ancient cobblestone streets of the Sicilian town of Taormina and along the famous fortifications of the medieval city of Dubrovnik, dubbed “paradise on earth.” Your cruise will explore some of the most beautiful coastline in the world, places of legends and heroes, inspiration for writers and poets – and in popular culture, filming locations for the popular HBO TV series “Game of Thrones.” The leisurely pace allows time to swim in crystal clear sea and discover hidden beaches; kayak or tour by Zodiac along untouched coastline; visit bucket list sights; and sip, dine, and otherwise discover local culture in three fascinating countries.
items.tourOgTitle: Classic Italy & Dalmatian Coast

items.title: Star Collector: Wonders of Andalusia, Provence & Tuscany

items.tourMetaDescription: Cruise the Iberian coast from Lisbon to the Moorish marvels of Andalusia and Morocco, then explore the scenic perfection and rich culture along Spain’s Costa del Sol, France’s Cote d’Azur, and Italy’s Ligurian Riviera . See all of this region’s must-sees: Lisbon’s Pina Palace, Seville’s Alcazar, Malaga’s Alhambra, Barcelona’s Sagrada Familia, and Rome’s... everything. Surround yourself in scenic beauty from Morocco’s exotic Blue City to Italy’s Cinque Terre. And enjoy unique small-ship experiences from cruising up the Guadalquivir River to an overnight in Seville, to playing in riviera waters off the Watersports Platform. With several overnights and late evening departures, you can enjoy a flamenco performance and tapas in Seville, learn to make paella in Valencia, watch the lights come on in Monte Carlo, and more.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Wonders of Andalusia, Provence & Tuscany
