items.tourMetaDescription: Experience Seville, the birthplace of Spanish flamenco, with its Gothic cathedral and the Triana Bridge. Take in the "Blue City" of Chefchaouen, with blue-washed buildings tucked into the Rif Mountains. Enjoy Granada’s Alhambra, the 13th century fortress complex. Discover Cartagena, from the Roman Theater and Museum to the architecture of Town Hall Square. Explore Valencia’s Lladro Art Center, with handcrafted porcelain figurines and sculptures. Bike old Valenica to the Silk Exchange, passing the Turia Gardens. Swim the waters of Palamós. From the beaches of Sanary-sur-Mer to the limestone cliffs of Cassis and the countryside of Aix-en-Provence. Spot celebrities at the Festival Palace in Cannes and the Monte Carlo Casino. Hike cliff paths in Portofino. Explore ancient treasures of Rome. Explore the craters and lava flows of Mount Etna and the tiny cobblestone streets of Monemvasia.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Magnificent Mediterranean

items.title: Moroccan Markets & Iberian Icons

items.tourMetaDescription: Traverse the Mediterranean to Tangier, Malaga, Seville, and Lisbon and enjoy contrasting customs, cuisine, and cultures that influence life throughout Europe and North Africa. Visit a hacienda outside Cartagena and graze on regional cheeses and dried hams as you watch an equestrian performance. Master paella cooking with a local chef on a picturesque Andalusian patio. Sail to Tangier, Morocco and wander the ancient Roman ruins of Lixus - a site only excavated within the last 100 years - before browsing handcrafted wares in tiny shops on Azilah's narrow streets. Stay overnight in Seville for a Flamenco show paired with a delicious and delightful Spanish dinner. Sip robust port wines during your overnight stay in Lisbon, and then venture to the village of Sintra and its majestic Pena Palace, the favored summer home of Portuguese royalty for over six centuries.
items.tourOgTitle: Moroccan Markets & Iberian Icons

items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 12 Days Sep 07 – Sep 19, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: The magnificent ports of the Rivieras each have their own distinctive allure. In Madrid, you’ll have four nights to immerse yourself in its vibrant culture. Beat the crowds to the Prado Museum, to revel in Spanish masterpieces. Learn to cook tapas at a boutique cooking school. Enjoy a flamenco show and a three-course Michelin star dinner. Spend a day in Segovia, a medieval city (also UNESCO World Heritage site) featuring an ancient Roman aqueduct that winds around the edge of town. Get a guided tour through the city’s Gothic-style Cathedral, stopping at the iconic Alcázar castle. Indulge in a wine tasting at the Cavas Cordoniu cellars in the wine region of Catalonia, where you’ll learn the art of wine tasting. Your travel between Barcelona and Madrid will be in Comfort Class via high-speed train. Windstar picks up your luggage so it will be waiting for you at your hotel.
items.tourOgTitle: Yachtsman’s Mediterranean Rivieras & Madrid Cruise Tour

items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the Rivera’s most iconic destinations, Italy's picturesque coastline and ancient Greek temples during this Mediterranean cruise. Lace up your shoes for a hike among elegant Italian villas, olive groves, and Medieval ruins high above the cliffs surrounding Portofino. Wander Pompeii's silent baths, theaters and temples in the shadow of Mt. Vesuvius. Take to the skies on a helicopter tour above Messina and the summit of Mount Etna - Europe's highest volcano. Drift into the underground caves of Vlyhada and Alepotrypa during a boat tour of the Dyros Caves outside Gythion. Tour the hidden medieval city of Monemvasia and sample local olive oils drizzled on fresh-baked bread in a shaded olive grove.

Spot Arab and Norman influences in Messina, reflected in the horseshoe arches and decorative stonework of the town’s famous 12th century cathedral. Tour the ancient wonders around Gythion with the austere “Spartan” Greek design.  Marvel in the Acropolis, with breathtaking monuments to Mythical deities like Zeus, Athena, and Poseidon. Tour Thessalonik's wealth of archaeological highlights including the iconic White Tower and Aristotelous Square. Live out your Mama Mia dream on the island of Skoplos, where many of the Hollywood films’ scenes were filmed.

Discover the Roman Colosseum through the eyes of gladiators on an exclusive visit to Rome’s most recognizable landmark. Savor fresh handmade pasta dishes and rich Chianti wines amidst the warm ambiance and sincere hospitality of a neighborhood Italian restaurant. Your cruise features unforgettable opportunities to experience the scenic Portoferraio Biosphere Reserve and explore the historic vineyards of Elba, set along the storied Italian Riviera. Watch beachcombers from white-linen sidewalk cafés or sunbathe on romantic sandy beaches in Cannes. Inhale seafood aromas and herbal fragrances in a Barcelonan open market.

Take in the brilliance of New England’s fall colors and the historic sites of Boston, one of America’s oldest cities.

Sip green tea in the peaceful shade of the scenic Ritsurin Garden in Takamatsu, or participate in a formal tea ceremony. Examine Kyoto’s storied Nijo Castle in detail as part of an inland stay, or explore the Zen temple Todai-ji in Nara. This is a perfect journey for those who love Japan, and adventurous travelers who want to go further inland to explore the culture and history of Kyoto.

items.tourMetaDescription: Find romance in paradise, as you create memories you’ll cherish for years to come. Travel from Los Angeles and overnight in Papeete before a short flight to legendary Bora Bora. With two nights in an overwater villa, you can snorkel the aquamarine lagoon, or soak in the lush rainforest palette. Take an ATV tour in Moorea, spend a day at a beach barbecue on a private motu off Tahaa, and return to Bora Bora for a night that includes a Windstar Destination Discovery Event with dazzling fire dancers. A Windstar yacht is the perfect way to experience Bora Bora, especially one with a Marina Platform, where you can swim, kayak or paddleboard right from the ship. Join us for a journey that celebrates love, adventure, and the beauty of Tahiti, 180 degrees from ordinary!

items.title: Star Collector: Eternal Greece
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Istanbul on Star Legend 16 Days Oct 03 – Oct 19, 2026 16 Days Aug 31 – Sep 16, 2027 16 Days Sep 24 – Oct 10, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark through Greece and Turkey, exploring less visited ports and experiencing the beauty of the Greek Isles. Sail to Kusadasi, home of the ancient Greek city of Ephesus. Continue through the Aegean Sea to Kavala, known for beaches, local cuisine, and historic sites. In Thessaloniki, explore the city’s landmarks or visit the Museum of the Royal Tombs, a UNESCO site. In Volos, take an excursion to the Meteora Byzantine Monasteries. On Skopelos, see filming sites from "Mamma Mia!" before heading to the Corinth Canal and Delphi. Visit Santorini's Oia for its iconic, white-washed buildings with blue domes. In Bodrum, explore the Castle, the ancient Mausoleum of Halicarnassus, and the Museum of Underwater Archaeology. Conclude your journey at the Greek islands of Mykonos and Lemnos, then end in Istanbul with tours of the Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, or a guided food tour through the markets.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Eternal Greece

items.tourMetaDescription: Immerse yourself in Japan’s unique culture — celebrate a respect of order, harmony, and self-development as you embrace new technologies and celebrate ancient traditions. Admire Tokyo’s sparkling skyline bathed in glowing pastel neon lights. items.title: Lake Como & Adriatic Romance Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Surf 11 Days Oct 07 – Oct 18, 2026 11 Days Apr 12 – Apr 23, 2027 11 Days Sep 23 – Oct 04, 2027 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge in rustic Italian cuisine, Roman relics and Baroque masterworks on a 11-day odyssey that combines a picturesque overland exploration of Lake Como and Venice with an extensive cruise through the Adriatic and along Italy’s West Coast. Delve into the depths of delectable Northeast Italian wine vintages and savor Amarone’s cherry and cinnamon nuances in a cool, underground Valpolicella winery. Overnight provides time to float past Venice’s romantic arched bridges and ancient alleyways on a gondola ride. Dip a kayak blade in the clear waters near old harbor walls outside Dubrovnik. Sample homemade cheeses and sausages in a family-run olive grove near Kotor. Wander between restored mosaics, broken columns and cracked pottery amid Pompeii’s storied ruins. Dine on authentic, handmade pizza while gentle coastal breezes waft through Sorrento’s aromatic citrus trees.
items.tourOgTitle: Lake Como & Adriatic Romance Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Extended Tahiti & Tuamotu Adventures
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 14 Days Oct 08 – Oct 22, 2026 14 Days Oct 15 – Oct 29, 2026 14 Days Jan 28 – Feb 11, 2027 SEE ALL 8 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Go beyond a typical Tahiti cruise during this island odyssey throughout French Polynesia and the remote Marquesas Islands. Follow in the creative footsteps of Symbolist artist Paul Gauguin as you explore his former home on Hiva Oa, then run your fingers along the hand-hewn surfaces of the largest Tiki sculptures found anywhere in the Pacific. Journey to Fakarava’s lagoon, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve teeming with seabirds and tropical fish. Admire coral gardens from your glass-bottom boat near Tiputa on Rangiroa. Swim with playful manta rays and docile black-tipped reef sharks in Bora Bora’s Blue Lagoon prior to a romantic starlit overnight port stay. Trek along Moorea’s rolling Opunohu Valley trail past fruit plantations and through an exotic hardwood forest on your way to majestic views of Mount Mouaroa, Mount Rotu and Mount Tohiea — three of the highest summits in the Society Islands.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Extended Tahiti & Tuamotu Adventures

items.title: Southeast Canadian Explorations
items.journeyText: Journey from Montreal, Qc to Boston, Ma on Star Pride 11 Days Oct 09 – Oct 20, 2026 11 Days Oct 11 – Oct 22, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Quebec’s French-flavored history, the fusion of Acadian and Scottish cultures in Nova Scotia — each province distills its own blend of Old World and New, bucolic and urbane. Overnight in Quebec City and browse the shops and boulangeries along picturesque Petit Champlain, the oldest street in North America. Take in the brilliance of New England’s fall colors and the historic sites of Boston, one of America’s oldest cities.
items.tourOgTitle: Southeast Canadian Explorations

items.title: Star Collector: Fall Leaves & Caribbean Breezes
items.journeyText: Journey from Montreal, Qc to San Juan on Star Pride 19 Days Oct 09 – Oct 28, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark in Montreal, City of a Hundred Steeples, and overnight in Quebec City, with its UNESCO World Heritage Old Town, to find 400-year-old ramparts filled with history. Enjoy the breathtaking seascapes of Gaspé, waves crashing against limestone cliffs, and watch sugar maples and birch trees flout their fall colors. Retrace the battles for North America in the Fortress of Louisbourg, the UNESCO town of Lunenburg, the Citadel in Halifax, and Boston — where the Freedom Trail leads you to Paul Revere’s house. Then, trade in your autumn palette for Bermuda’s spring colors — blushing pink beaches and turquoise waters. Wander historic forts and UNESCO sites in Bermuda, St. Kitts and San Juan before sailing on to chic St. Bart. Granite boulders form The Baths on Virgin Gorda, perfect for a soak or snorkel. Colorful Old San Juan will keep you busy as you await your flight home.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Fall Leaves & Caribbean Breezes

items.title: Istanbul Icons & Aegean Artifacts Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Istanbul on Star Legend 11 Days Oct 11 – Oct 22, 2026 11 Days Apr 09 – Apr 20, 2027 11 Days Apr 25 – May 06, 2027 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: With four days to explore glorious Istanbul and another eight to discover what lies beyond the Golden Horn, you don’t need an oracle to tell you this is one auspicious voyage. Everywhere you look in Istanbul you’ll find some fascinating remnant of days gone by – places where chariots raced, sultans ruled and architects’ greatest aspirations were realized. After you’ve oohed and aahed over the world-renowned mosques, palaces and bazaars, board your yacht to see more jewels of the Aegean. Islands glowing with whitewashed houses and blue-domed churches; origin stories of gods, oracles, and Atlantis; a canal so narrow you’ll only share it with small mail boats, private yachts and paddleboarders. Plus, enjoy a complimentary Destination Discovery Event – dinner and a concert in the moonlight in ancient Ephesus.
items.tourOgTitle: Istanbul Icons & Aegean Artifacts Cruise Tour

items.title: Cappadocia & Aegean Rhapsody Cruise Tour via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Istanbul on Star Legend 11 Days Oct 11 – Oct 22, 2026 11 Days Apr 09 – Apr 20, 2027 11 Days Apr 25 – May 06, 2027 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Hand painted Iznik tiles in deep lapis lazuli, turquoise, emerald and coral. Fairy chimneys of taupe and burnt umber. The white, charcoal, and Aegean blue palette of Santorini. On this journey through Turkey and Greece you will expand your list of favorite new places, and even add new favorite colors, aromas and flavors. Istanbul is your portal to this sensory world, with its Ottoman mosques, sultans’ palaces, Grand Bazaar and Spice Bazaar. Cappadocia’s weird landscape of rock pillars and subterranean homes is next, followed the string of pearls of the sparkling Aegean isles, the marble ruins of Ephesus and an ancient oracle. And while larger ships must go around, you cut straight through the narrow Corinth Canal to Athens, one of the world’s oldest cities, and some say one of the finest.
items.tourOgTitle: Cappadocia & Aegean Rhapsody Cruise Tour via the Corinth Canal

items.title: Kyoto & the Zen of Japan Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Osaka, Kyoto to Tokyo on Star Seeker 12 Days Oct 14 – Oct 26, 2026 12 Days Mar 09 – Mar 21, 2027 12 Days May 08 – May 20, 2027 SEE ALL 8 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: From the tranquil Zen beauty of Kinkaku-ji Temple to the neon plasma screens and incessant press of pedestrians throughout Tokyo’s Shibuya Station, this tour throughout Japan combines pristine natural beauty with cosmopolitan contrasts. Nibble on the freshest of fish paired with soy sauce and wasabi in the famous Shimizu Fish Market. Meander among East Asian relics and prehistoric stone tools in Busan’s museums, and royal tombs in Gyeongju, one of South Korea’s most famous UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Sip green tea in the peaceful shade of the scenic Ritsurin Garden in Takamatsu, or participate in a formal tea ceremony. Examine Kyoto’s storied Nijo Castle in detail as part of an inland stay, or explore the Zen temple Todai-ji in Nara. This is a perfect journey for those who love Japan, and adventurous travelers who want to go further inland to explore the culture and history of Kyoto.
items.tourOgTitle: Kyoto & the Zen of Japan Cruise Tour

items.title: Tantalizing Tuamotu Islands & Beautiful Bora Bora
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 7 Days Oct 15 – Oct 22, 2026 7 Days Jan 14 – Jan 21, 2027 7 Days Apr 15 – Apr 22, 2027 SEE ALL 6 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This iconic French Polynesian sailing is a shorter version of our Tahiti & the Tuamotu Islands itinerary for those who have a week to escape. Immerse yourself in the pristine surroundings of Fakarava Beach, a UNESCO Biosphere rich in colorful coral and tropical fish — and the perfect sanctuary for divers and snorkelers. Learn the art of grafting black pearls and shop for precious keepsakes at a family pearl farm, or seek out savory swordfish kebabs, fried fish, and other local foods next to Rangiroa's sky-blue waters. Master drift snorkeling at scenic Tiputa Pass with an experienced guide. Roll out on a 4x4 exploration of Bora Bora beaches, weathered World War II guns, and dense tropical jungles, or spend hours in iconic azure lagoon waters swimming in the company of harmless black-tipped reef sharks and curious stingrays prior to an overnight stay in Bora Bora.
items.tourOgTitle: Tantalizing Tuamotu Islands & Beautiful Bora Bora

items.title: Classic Italy & Dalmatian Coast
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 10 Days Oct 15 – Oct 25, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore timeless cities to tiny ports of unmatched beauty on one of the classic cruises from Rome to Venice. Pose in front of the Roman Colosseum and see the ancient city of Pompeii. Sail through the breathtaking Bay of Kotor and explore the famously picturesque towns of the Amalfi Coast. Wander the ancient cobblestone streets of the Sicilian town of Taormina and along the famous fortifications of the medieval city of Dubrovnik, dubbed “paradise on earth.” Your cruise will explore some of the most beautiful coastline in the world, places of legends and heroes, inspiration for writers and poets – and in popular culture, filming locations for the popular HBO TV series “Game of Thrones.” The leisurely pace allows time to swim in crystal clear sea and discover hidden beaches; kayak or tour by Zodiac along untouched coastline; visit bucket list sights; and sip, dine, and otherwise discover local culture in three fascinating countries.
items.tourOgTitle: Classic Italy & Dalmatian Coast

items.title: Star Collector: Italian Trio
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Barcelona on Wind Surf 15 Days Oct 15 – Oct 30, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the culture, history and cuisine on both sides of the Italian peninsula during this 15-day cruise of the Adriatic, Ionian, Ligurian and Tyrrhenian seas. This back-to-back cruise is ideal for optimizing shore excursion time in Italy, Croatia, Montenegro, Monaco, France and Spain. Stroll through Roman ruins in Rovinj, Croatia, sample olives and smoked hams at a centuries-old family farm in Montenegro, or savor an unforgettably romantic evening dinner at Château Eza in Èze 1,400 feet above the beaches of the French Riviera.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Italian Trio

items.title: Star Collector: Riviera Rhapsody
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Lisbon on Wind Surf 23 Days Oct 15 – Nov 07, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Oohs and ahhs over the sublime scenery alternate with oohs and ahhs over magnificent manmade creations on this voyage along the Dalmatian Coast, Ligurian Riviera, Côte d’Azur, and Costa del Sol. This is a stretch where Blue Flag beaches jostle for elbow space and castles, palaces and cathedrals take every form known to man. This is where the imaginations of Cezanne, Monet, Matisse and Picasso were ignited. Here is where great romances blossomed: Richard Burton and Elizabeth Taylor in Portofino; Princess Grace and Prince Rainier in Monte Carlo. Sail through waters where the legendary sirens are said to live, play a game of picign with gregarious Croatians. Our yachts take you to less-visited ports like Sanary-sur-Mer, and get you closer to town than the big ships can get in places like Dubrovnik, Venice, Barcelona and Málaga.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Riviera Rhapsody

items.title: Vatican & Croatian Coastlines Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Surf 12 Days Oct 15 – Oct 27, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Delve into architectural and epicurean wonders on both sides of the Italian peninsula during this 10-day adventure. An Adriatic and Dalmatian Coast itinerary sails along the Croatian coast, paired with immersive experiences in Italy, including a Vatican tour, Colosseum visit, and foodie market tour in Rome. Listen to the Venetian clock tower bells of Torre dell’Orologio strike the hour as hundreds of pigeons scatter about St. Mark’s Square. Sip crisp and dry Verdicchio paired with octopus salad or garlic-flavored black risotto in delicious Dubrovnik, a highlight of the cruise along Croatia's storied Dalmatian coastline. Drift past the blue domes of Our Lady of the Rocks, a sanctuary for Kotor’s local fishermen for nearly 2,000 years. Sample succulent baked cardoon stalks harvested from Sicilian thistles and dusted with melted aged Parmesan cheese near the precipitous slopes of Mount Etna in Giardini Naxos. Experience an exclusive tour deep into the storied shadows of the Colosseum and the Sistine Chapel.
items.tourOgTitle: Vatican & Croatian Coastlines Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Ancient to Avant-Garde Mediterranean
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Barcelona on Wind Star 14 Days Oct 17 – Oct 31, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: A perfect blend of antiquity and artistry, this cruise sails from the ancient ruins of Athens and makes a dozen port stops in Greece, Italy and France before disembarking among the contemporary architecture and gleaming, cosmopolitan wonders of Barcelona, Spain. Stroll the narrow streets inside the concealed medieval walls of Monemvasia, Greece and take an exhilarating tour of Corsica’s narrow winding coastal roads outside Calvi, France. From the Greek and Roman funerary steles – ancient marble reliefs depicting venerable people engaged in everyday life – to the vibrant and radiant impressionist paintings and dizzying mosaics of Antoni Gaudí’s Barcelona architecture, this is an ideal journey for passionate historians, art lovers and all seeking unforgettable cultural immersion.

items.title: Mind, Body and Spirit Collection: Bermuda Bliss
items.journeyText: Journey from Boston, Ma to San Juan on Star Pride 8 Days Oct 20 – Oct 28, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a wellness voyage with Debbie Dixon, a yoga teacher, life coach and inspirational speaker. Sail from the iconic skyline of Manhattan, absorbing the grandeur of the Statue of Liberty. Once at sea, you’ll have daily chances to rejuvenate your being with meditation, breathwork and yoga — and engage in transformational talks focused on mental, physical and spiritual health, designed to deepen your personal growth. Ashore in Bermuda, you’ll stroll the UNESCO site of St. George’s, as a palette of pastel-colored buildings and azure waters evoke a sense of serenity. Immerse yourself in history, from the imposing silhouette of St. Peter's Church to the architectural marvel of the Town Hall. Refresh yourself with specially crafted elixirs to enhance your wellness journey, or enjoy the juice cleanse and healthy food options available to restart your health through nutritious meals.
items.tourOgTitle: Mind, Body and Spirit Collection: Bermuda Bliss

items.title: Vatican & Italian Riviera Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Wind Surf 7 Days Oct 23 – Oct 30, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge your sense of wonder during this journey that combines a multi-day inland exploration to Rome with an Italian Riviera cruise and a scenic sailing along the steep and majestic Italian and French Rivieras. Sidestep the ordinary Vatican crowds during a tour of the Sistine Chapel and some sectors of the Vatican Museums. Discover the Roman Colosseum through the eyes of gladiators on an exclusive visit to Rome’s most recognizable landmark. Savor fresh handmade pasta dishes and rich Chianti wines amidst the warm ambiance and sincere hospitality of a neighborhood Italian restaurant. Your cruise features unforgettable opportunities to experience the scenic Portoferraio Biosphere Reserve and explore the historic vineyards of Elba, set along the storied Italian Riviera. Watch beachcombers from white-linen sidewalk cafés or sunbathe on romantic sandy beaches in Cannes. Inhale seafood aromas and herbal fragrances in a Barcelonan open market.

Kayak along the stunning coastline of Mallorca and bike from Portoferraio to Enfola, Elba in Italy.

items.title: Mediterranean Island Mosaic
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Wind Star 7 Days Oct 24 – Oct 31, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Hidden harbors. Legendary landmarks. Everything that makes the Mediterranean magical. This voyage has it all. The colorful kaleidoscopes of Rome and Barcelona invite you to celebrate their high-spirited energy, while the seductive scent of oranges and olives that perfumes the enchanting islands of Elba, Corsica, Mallorca, and Menorca entices you to explore their seductive secrets. From the wild green mountains of Mallorca to the striking white pebble beaches of Portoferraio – let us delight your senses and ignite your imagination.
items.tourOgTitle: Mediterranean Island Mosaic

items.title: Star Collector: Enchantment of the Western Med
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Lisbon on Wind Surf 13 Days Oct 25 – Nov 07, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the best Western Mediterranean ports in detail during this cruise through Italy, Monaco, France, Spain, Gibraltar, and Portugal. Stroll among opulent casinos, high-end boutiques, and historic Formula One landmarks in Monte Carlo. Sip wormwood-based absinthe in the French village of Antibes outside of Cannes. Or meander among the dusky walls and long shadows in Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, taking in the aromas, sights and sounds of the Catalonian heart of Spain.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Enchantment of the Western Med

items.title: Quick Getaways: Yachtsman's Harbors of the Rivieras
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Wind Surf 5 Days Oct 25 – Oct 30, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Follow in the footsteps of artists and writers — and the world’s fanciest yachts, too — as you immerse yourself in the intoxicating atmosphere of the Italian Rivera and France’s Côte d’Azur. You’ll explore delightful resort towns and small villages where Matisse, Picasso, Van Gogh and others found inspiration. Admire the architecture of Gaudí in Barcelona. Try your luck at the Grand Casino in Monte Carlo. Visit Michelangelo’s astonishing Sistine Chapel, and the Roman Colosseum. Along the way, admire castles and ancient ruins, with access to many UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The leisurely pace of your voyage allows time to swim and sail, directly from your yacht’s Marina Platform. As you explore idyllic coastal scenes, you’ll quickly understand why the Rivieras are among the most treasured yachting destinations in the world.
items.tourOgTitle: Quick Getaways: Yachtsman's Harbors of the Rivieras

items.title: Yachtsman’s Mediterranean Rivieras & Madrid Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Wind Surf 9 Days Oct 25 – Nov 03, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: The magnificent ports of the Rivieras each have their own distinctive allure. In Madrid, you’ll have four nights to immerse yourself in its vibrant culture. Beat the crowds to the Prado Museum, to revel in Spanish masterpieces. Learn to cook tapas at a boutique cooking school. Enjoy a flamenco show and a three-course Michelin star dinner. Spend a day in Segovia, a medieval city (also UNESCO World Heritage site) featuring an ancient Roman aqueduct that winds around the edge of town. Get a guided tour through the city’s Gothic-style Cathedral, stopping at the iconic Alcázar castle. Indulge in a wine tasting at the Cavas Cordoniu cellars in the wine region of Catalonia, where you’ll learn the art of wine tasting. Your travel between Barcelona and Madrid will be in Comfort Class via high-speed train. Windstar picks up your luggage so it will be waiting for you at your hotel.
items.tourOgTitle: Yachtsman’s Mediterranean Rivieras & Madrid Cruise Tour

This voyage remains one of the most highly personalized and authentic explorations of Japan’s iconic islands at the edge of the Far East.
items.tourOgTitle: Grand Japan

items.title: Star Collector: Island Jewels of Japan
items.journeyText: Journey from Tokyo to Halong Bay, Hanoi on Star Seeker 20 Days Oct 26 – Nov 15, 2026 20 Days Oct 25 – Nov 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience Tokyo with its neon lights, Ginza shopping, and more Michelin-starred restaurants than any city in the world. Wrap yourself in natural beauty as you gaze at the perfect symmetry of Mt. Fuji, go “sand bathing” at a hot spring, and hike trails past waterfalls, shrines, and massive evergreens. You’ll find echoes of the past, from Osaka’s and Kyoto’s cultural and historical treasures to the peace parks of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. After exploring Japan’s main islands, head to the Ryukyu Islands. As part of the Ryukyu Kingdom the culture has infused with foreign influences. See hints of China in Okinawa’s 14th-century Shuri Castle, and notice how everything from the cuisine to the language include Chinese, Korean and Southeast Asian influences. Revel the “Amami blue” waters and a peacock array of palm trees, unspoiled beaches, and coral reefs.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Island Jewels of Japan

items.title: Star Collector: Japan & Vietnam In-Depth
items.journeyText: Journey from Tokyo to Bangkok / Klong Toei on Star Seeker 30 Days Oct 26 – Nov 25, 2026 30 Days Oct 25 – Nov 24, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Gorgeous landscapes, complex pasts and delicious cuisines are yours as you explore 22 different ports throughout Japan and Vietnam. See classic icons in mainland Japan with its feudal castles, ancient capitals, forested mountains, and steaming hot springs. Travel south to subtropical Okinawa, with beaches, mangroves, withs its own distinct culture due to its past as part of the Ryukyu Kingdom. You’ll find a similar dichotomy in Vietnam as you travel from the north’s more temperate landscape to the tropical south. Feast your eyes on the karst landscape of Halong Bay, Da Nang’s amazing beaches and Marble Mountains, and historic sites from My Son Sanctuary and Hue to Hoi An, with an optional overland to Angkor Wat. Stops in Taipei, Taiwan, Busan, South Korea, Phnom Penh, Cambodia, and one of Thailand’s most spectacular islands add to an already incredible journey.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Japan & Vietnam In-Depth

items.title: Star Collector: Grand Asia Explorer
items.journeyText: Journey from Tokyo to Phuket on Star Seeker 41 Days Oct 26 – Dec 06, 2026 41 Days Oct 25 – Dec 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Visit destinations unlike anything else, all set against a backdrop of unforgettable cuisines, history, and adventures. With overnight stays in four of Asia’s most dynamic cities – feel their frenetic energy, immerse yourself in their cultures, savor world-famous street food, and explore rich traditions and history. Cruise shallow waterways like the Saigon River and Chao Phraya River and moor right into cities like Ho Chi Minh City and Bangkoke. You’ll also discover less-visited ports and islands, with small-group excursions that immerse you in local culture. Explore perfectly preserved samurai villages, secretive cu chi tunnels, and bustling floating markets in Malaysia. Drink in the emerald and turquoise beauty of Halong Bay from the decks of a traditional junk. Learn to fish from a sampan on the Mekong Delta, slurp udon like a native in Takamatsu, and cook pad thai in Thailand.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Grand Asia Explorer

items.title: Kyoto & the Zen of Japan Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Tokyo to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker 12 Days Oct 26 – Nov 07, 2026 12 Days Mar 21 – Apr 02, 2027 12 Days Mar 17 – Mar 29, 2028 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: From the tranquil Zen beauty of Kinkaku-ji Temple to the neon plasma screens and incessant press of pedestrians throughout Tokyo’s Shibuya Station, this tour throughout Japan combines pristine natural beauty with cosmopolitan contrasts. Nibble on the freshest of fish paired with soy sauce and wasabi in the famous Shimizu Fish Market. Meander among East Asian relics and prehistoric stone tools in Busan’s museums, and royal tombs in Gyeongju, one of South Korea’s most famous UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Sip green tea in the peaceful shade of the scenic Ritsurin Garden in Takamatsu, or participate in a formal tea ceremony. Examine Kyoto’s storied Nijo Castle in detail as part of an inland stay, or explore the Zen temple Todai-ji in Nara. This is a perfect journey for those who love Japan, and adventurous travelers who want to go further inland to explore the culture and history of Kyoto.
items.tourOgTitle: Kyoto & the Zen of Japan Cruise Tour

items.title: Next Stop Madrid: Spanish Treasures Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Lisbon on Wind Spirit 14 Days Oct 26 – Nov 09, 2026 14 Days Oct 27 – Nov 10, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Delight in the discovery of Spain’s historic treasures and dazzle your senses on a journey that takes you deep into the local cultures of Madrid, Segovia and Barcelona, with stops at legendary ports in Southern Spain, Morocco and Portugal. Stroll the Gran Via (the “Spanish Broadway”) finding keepsakes and enjoying tapas in local restaurants. Enjoy a fiery flamenco show at Madrid’s “Cathedral of Flamenco” while enjoying a three-course gourmet meal. Spend a day in Segovia, a medieval city featuring an ancient Roman aqueduct. In Barcelona, dine on authentic Catalan cuisine and be whisked away to the Cavas Cordoniu cellars in the Penedés Region. This cruise to Southern Spain and Morocco will take your breath away at every turn. Sitting at a café in Tangier’s medina sipping mint tea and watching old men play backgammon, you’ll know this is a dream come true.
items.tourOgTitle: Next Stop Madrid: Spanish Treasures Cruise Tour

Immerse yourself in Almeria’s Moorish heritage, Costa del Sol’s “white villages,” and Mallorca’s stunning beaches, with plenty of time to enjoy Lisbon’s charming cobblestone streets and Barcelona’s bold Gaudi architecture. Traveling by high-speed train, you’ll spend four nights at a five-star hotel in Madrid, immersing yourself in the capital’s vibrant culture. Highlights of this Madrid cruise experience include early entry to the renowned Prado Museum and an exclusive flamenco dinner show at Spain’s only Michelin-starred tablao. You’ll take a daytrip to admire medieval Segovia’s first-century Roman aqueduct and iconic Alcázar Castle, and spend a night in Barcelona, where you’ll be whisked away to a beautiful 450-year-old winery in the Penedés region.

items.title: Star Collector: Southern Spain & Canary Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Santa Cruz De Tenerife on Wind Spirit 18 Days Oct 30 – Nov 17, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Soak up the sun, savor the beaches, and explore Spanish and Portuguese cultures on this homage to Iberia and the Canary Islands. This cruise offers all the best things rolled into one — Spanish rivieras; the Mediterranean paradise of Palma de Mallorca; iconic cities like Barcelona, Tangier and Lisbon; marvelous Madeira; and a chain of Canary Islands bursting with exotic landscapes, colonial history, and their own distinct brand of Berber-infused culture. Discover marvels like the Alhambra, Gaudí’s Nouveau-Gothic Sagrada Familia, Lisbon’s feast of monuments and azulejo tiles. Learn to cook authentic paella at a Valencian farmhouse, dine on delicious Portuguese bacalhau, and taste Canarian wines born in the shadow of a simmering volcano. You’ll come home filled with wonder at how diverse and delightful Iberia can be.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Southern Spain & Canary Islands

items.title: Spanish Symphony
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Lisbon on Wind Surf 8 Days Oct 30 – Nov 07, 2026 8 Days Oct 28 – Nov 05, 2027 8 Days Nov 12 – Nov 20, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Poised as if to kiss the continent of Africa, Andalusia hugs the southern coast of Spain and embraces cultural influences from both sides of the strait. This is the birthplace of Don Juan and Carmen, evening paseos by women in lace mantillas, cape-twirling matadors. In short, it is quintessential Spain. The beaches of the Costa del Sol are legendary. And behind lie equally magnificent mountain ranges sheltering picturesque “white villages.” Here you won’t find cookie-cutter castles, but amazing cultural amalgams like the Alhambra and Alcázar. On your elegant ship, you will cruise past larger ships right to the heart of old towns and to the steps of friendly bodegas.
items.tourOgTitle: Spanish Symphony

items.title: Portuguese Passages & Spanish Shorelines Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Lisbon on Wind Surf 12 Days Oct 30 – Nov 11, 2026 12 Days Oct 28 – Nov 09, 2027 12 Days Nov 12 – Nov 24, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Combine a culturally immersive inland journey throughout Portugal with a scenic tracing of Spain’s iconic coastlines during this remarkable 12-day combination cruise and land tour. The experience features coastal sailing from Barcelona to Lisbon, Portugal, complemented by a scenic Douro River cruise in Pinhão as part of the inland experience. Inhale intermingled aromas of seafood and spicy bean soup on Porto’s glowing twilight streets as melancholic fado lyrics and guitarra strings reverberate across stone walls. Light a candle amid prayerful pilgrims in the silence of Fátima’s most sacred sites. Peer into the spiraling, moss-lined columns of the Initiation Well near the misty Sintra Forest. Bask in the Douro Valley’s unique sunlit glow as you stand among the rocky contours of steep terraced vineyards. Master the art of tapas cooking under the direction of an Andalusian chef near Málaga. Sip sherries and wander among old barrels in Cadiz wine cellars. Kayak between scenic caletas, or quays, in Mallorca’s clear coastal waters.
items.tourOgTitle: Portuguese Passages & Spanish Shorelines Cruise Tour

Sip port wines in Lisbon, Portugal, browse wares in the bustling Grand Souk in Tangier, Morocco, and wander the medieval cobbled streets of Tarragona, Spain.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Classic Crossing to Spain & More

items.title: Kyoto & East Asia Dreams Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Osaka, Kyoto to Halong Bay, Hanoi on Star Seeker 12 Days Nov 03 – Nov 15, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This unforgettable voyage across East Asia promises to make your dreams come true. Unlock the secrets and ancient beauty of Kyoto with two nights at a 5-star hotel. Discover iconic landmarks, from the Golden Pavilion to the historic Gion district. Spend a day in Nara, a city rich in crafts and cuisine, and home to eight UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Marvel at the awe-inspiring Todai-ji Temple, housing the world’s largest Buddha statue; view Kasuga Shrine, lined with thousands of lanterns; and stroll Nara Park, where sacred deer freely roam. Pass by Osaka Castle before you board your yacht for the sparkling Japanese islands of Amami and Okinawa. Explore Taipei’s temples and enjoy an overnight stay in Hong Kong. Visit breathtaking Halong Bay, where you can tour the captivating scenery aboard a traditional fishing junk, before heading to Hanoi, Vietnam's cultural heart.
items.tourOgTitle: Kyoto & East Asia Dreams Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Spanish Mystery & Atlantic Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Bridgetown, Barbados on Star Legend 23 Days Nov 04 – Nov 27, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin in Barcelona and set out along Spain’s coast with an element of surprise, as each port of call is announced just 36 hours before arrival. The route favors smaller harbors and new-to-Windstar destinations, ending in Málaga after days shaped by shared discovery. From there, the journey stretches westward, stopping in Tangier, Casablanca and Madeira, before committing to the Atlantic. Long sea days create time to settle into life onboard, turning distance into part of the experience and arriving in Barbados with a real sense of passage.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Spanish Mystery & Atlantic Crossing

items.title: 2026 Spanish Mystery Cruise
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Malaga on Star Legend 8 Days Nov 04 – Nov 12, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin in Barcelona, a city of Gaudí masterpieces and Mediterranean vibrance, before setting off into mystery along Spain’s storied coast. Each port is announced 36 hours before arrival, heightening the sense of anticipation and discovery. Some destinations will be brand-new to Windstar, ensuring fresh adventures even for seasoned travelers. No matter where the journey leads, you can trust Windstar to make every moment spectacular—enhanced by the shared excitement of discovering each new port together. You’ll also enjoy a memorable Destination Discovery Event designed to immerse you in Spain’s culture. Your voyage concludes in Málaga, where sun-drenched plazas, Andalusian flavors, and a touch of Moorish history bid you farewell.
items.tourOgTitle: 2026 Spanish Mystery Cruise

items.title: Star Collector: The Best of the Marquesas & French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 18 Days Nov 05 – Nov 23, 2026 18 Days Apr 02 – Apr 20, 2028 18 Days Oct 15 – Nov 02, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Beyond Tahiti lies an even more remote paradise—discover the Marquesas and the Tuamotu Islands, where only the lucky few ever venture. Grab your camera and join a marine biologist on a search for spinner dolphins, pilot whales, and rough-tooth dolphins off Moorea's coast. Enjoy a Windstar exclusive complimentary Destination Discovery Event in Bora Bora. Snorkel above manta rays or dive deep into cobalt-hued coral grottos on a guided SCUBA excursion off Fakarava's UNESCO biosphere reserve. Board an SUV and roll through tranquil Taipivai Valley, novelist Herman Melville's former refuge after he deserted his ship and was held captive by Nuku Hiva natives nearly 200 years ago. Beachcomb and sip coconut refreshments at the edge of Rangiroa's Green Lagoon, where there is plenty of time to swim on your own or shop for unique keepsakes.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: The Best of the Marquesas & French Polynesia

items.title: East Asian Legends
items.journeyText: Journey from Osaka, Kyoto to Halong Bay, Hanoi on Star Seeker 10 Days Nov 05 – Nov 15, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the diversity of East Asian cultures as you make your way from traditional rural villages to subtropical beaches. On Japan’s Amami Island, instead of sake, you’ll drink kokuto shochu made of brown sugar. And instead of kimonos in vivid colors, you’ll find complex patterns in earth tones made with a mud-dyed technique that’s been in use for 1,300 years. Shop for distinctive and colorful Ryukyu glass in Okinawa, once made from the old bottles discarded by U.S. troops. Explore Ishigaki’s Yaima Village, an open-air museum of preserved Ryukyu-style houses. In Taiwan’s capital, Taipei, browse the National Palace Museum’s massive collection of Chinese art treasures, or head to the old-town market where you’ll find Chinese medicine apothecaries, traditional handicrafts and more. Listen for the noon-day gun on Garden Road, a tradition established by the British in the 1860s.
items.tourOgTitle: East Asian Legends

items.title: Star Collector: Okinawa Days & Mekong Ways
items.journeyText: Journey from Osaka, Kyoto to Bangkok / Klong Toei on Star Seeker 20 Days Nov 05 – Nov 25, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discoveries await on this in-depth sailing visiting 13 different ports. Explore Southern Japan, once the realm of Ryukyu kings, and currently where mainlanders go for their tropical beach vacations. Ride a water buffalo carriage past walls made of coral in a beautifully preserved Ryukyu village just off the coast of Ishigaki, and dive into local cuisine at Okinawa’s Kokusai Dori food street, where flavors are influenced by Ryukyu kings as well as American GIs. Overnight in three dynamic cities and stay late in others, with time to pursue your interests or let your curiosity lead you — to the Mekong Delta, My Son Sanctuary, Cu Chi Tunnels or a Vietnamese cooking class. Revisit Vietnam’s distant past in Hoi An’s Ancient Town and the Imperial City of Hue, and feel awe in the presence of Angkor Wat — the 12th century complex that’s more than four times the size of Vatican City.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Okinawa Days & Mekong Ways

items.title: Star Collector: Wonders of Southern Japan & Southeast Asia
items.journeyText: Journey from Osaka, Kyoto to Phuket on Star Seeker 31 Days Nov 05 – Dec 06, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: This month-long voyage will create a lifetime of memories, from pristine rural locales to glimmering neon cities. Step into a watercolor scene: longtail boats cruising the serene waters and karst pillars of Halong Bay, water buffalo tilling verdant rice paddies, vermilion torii guarding Shinto shrines, and magical Thai islands we’ve hand-selected from over 1,400 choices. Expand your culinary horizons with Peranakan fusion food in Malaysia and Singapore, Khmer noodles in Cambodia and Ishigaki’s melt-in-your-mouth beef. Browse the famous night markets during overnight stays in Hong Kong, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City and Singapore. Anchor it all with a better understanding of the past as you visit the National Palace Museum in Taipei, with one of the largest collections of Chinese art in the world, or Hoi An’s Ancient Town, with its beautifully preserved 18th-century merchant houses.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Wonders of Southern Japan & Southeast Asia

items.title: Heart of Hanoi & East Asia Legends Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Osaka, Kyoto to Halong Bay, Hanoi on Star Seeker 13 Days Nov 05 – Nov 18, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a captivating journey from Japan to Vietnam, where each stop reveals a new world of culture and beauty. Sail from Osaka to the lush shores of Amami and Okinawa, known for their subtropical landscapes and pristine beaches. Stay over in Hong Kong, where the Symphony of Lights illuminates the harbor skyline. Revel in the natural beauty and welcoming tranquility of Vietnam’s Halong Bay. Your adventure culminates in Hanoi, where a 5-star hotel provides your luxurious home base to explore the wonders of the city on foot or traditional cyclo. Start your day with a Tai Chi lesson. Savor a tasting tour of world-famous Vietnamese street food. Take in the Old Quarter’s storied past and vibrant night market. Immerse yourself in Vietnam’s artistic heritage with a traditional water puppet show and a visit to Bat Trang Pottery Village to see centuries-old craftsmanship in action.
items.tourOgTitle: Heart of Hanoi & East Asia Legends Cruise Tour

items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to San Juan on Star Pride 14 Days Nov 08 – Nov 22, 2026 14 Days Nov 15 – Nov 29, 2026 14 Days Nov 22 – Dec 06, 2026 SEE ALL 23 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Whether you’re passionate about swimming among undersea wildlife or the intricate cultures and intertwined European histories of the Leeward Islands, this 2-week cruise offers the best combinations of charm, island heritage and natural beauty. Shop unique designer apparel in St. Barts, where you’ll discover a fashionable confluence of high-end brands. Stare in wonder at the glow from miniscule bioluminescent organisms stirred by your kayak paddle during a tour of the Fajardo Bio Bay nature reserve near San Juan. Master the art of cooking with distinct spices like nutmeg, cloves and allspice in authentic Caribbean cuisine while taking direction from a highly-skilled native chef in Philipsburg. This Caribbean getaway is the perfect duration for lovers of island life and those who want to spend more time exploring the Windward Islands overlooked by other cruise lines.

Swim among sea turtles and glide above dazzling coral reefs with a highly skilled diving guide off the coast of Les Saintes’ volcanic shoreline. Vacation time is always well spent among the Windward Islands, but nothing makes it more perfect than the personalized attention and unique excursion opportunities offered by Windstar.

items.title: The Colorful Canary Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Santa Cruz De Tenerife on Wind Spirit 8 Days Nov 09 – Nov 17, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Volcanoes have left their mark everywhere here — on snow-capped Mount Teide, on black sand beaches, in rich soils and natural sea pools — yet each island is unique. Palms, pines, vineyards and banana plantations each offer their own shade of green. On some islands you’ll see terraced farms clinging to valley walls. On others, trails trace the cliffs and reward hikers with breathtaking ocean views. And there’s always something new to do. Explore historic colonial towns, national parks, and nature reserves. Discover cuisines that reflect both mainland traditions and the islands’ distinctive culture and abundance. Shop for colorful pottery and jewelry made from lava. Listen to Canarian musicians coax beautiful folk tunes from the tiny guitar known as a timple. Surround yourself with sunshine, sand, and the soul of a place that works its way into your heart and never lets go.
items.tourOgTitle: The Colorful Canary Islands

items.title: Knot Your Average Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Bridgetown, Barbados on Wind Star 14 Days Nov 10 – Nov 24, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Set sail on an unforgettable ocean crossing aboard one of our majestic sailing ships, where you’ll immerse yourself in the timeless art of seafaring. This voyage features a guest speaker offering fascinating talks on navigation history, legendary explorers, and even swashbuckling pirates. You’ll learn to read charts, tie sailor’s knots, and even navigate the vessel on the Flying Bridge alongside our Officers. Enjoy stargazing and star mapping sessions, and hear navigational insights directly from the Captain himself. Throughout the journey, hands-on workshops and immersive activities will deepen your connection to the sea — and for a final splash of fun, join our lively "Pirates of the Atlantic” themed party, so don’t forget to pack your nautical outfits!.
items.tourOgTitle: Knot Your Average Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Southern Caribbean Thanksgiving Jubilee
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Colon on Wind Star 25 Days Nov 10 – Dec 05, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: This is a voyage for those who want to see and do things out of the ordinary. Cross the Atlantic and arrive in the Southern Caribbean, the last part of the Caribbean that cruisers explore. Because these tend to be smaller and less developed Caribbean islands, they’re meant for the savvy traveler to discover. On arid Aruba, find divi-divi trees that always point southwest, the direction of the trade winds. In the Grenadines and Grenada, discover rainforests, mountains  and waterfalls. And the privacy and seclusion of places like beautiful Mayreau with a population of less than 300. Go snorkeling in the clear waters of Grenada to find an eerie undersea sculpture garden being modified by sea creatures. See flocks of pink flamingos on Bonaire. Spend time in the UNESCO towns of St. George’s, Bridgetown and Cartagena where gingerbread, forts and Georgian architecture unravel a complex past.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Southern Caribbean Thanksgiving Jubilee

items.title: Far Flung French Polynesia and Marquesas Magic
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 11 Days Nov 12 – Nov 23, 2026 11 Days Dec 17 – Dec 28, 2026 11 Days Mar 28 – Apr 08, 2027 SEE ALL 6 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the best of French Polynesia's Tuamotus, Marquesas, and Society Islands in a range of remote, romantic, and unspoiled tropical settings. Seek out seabirds and snorkel among harmless black tipped reef sharks in Fakarava's famous blue lagoon, a UNESCO biosphere reserve. Learn firsthand about Polynesian life and cultural traditions in the remote village of Omoa on Fatu-Hiva — a settlement recognized as one of the most isolated travel destinations in the world. Take a SUV tour of the remote Taipivai Valley on Nuku Hiva and explore Herman Melville's former refuge and setting for his novel, Typee. Go with the flow as you learn drift snorkeling with Tiputa Pass experts, or float aimlessly above coral formations and colorful fish in Rangiroa's coral garden. Create the perfect romantic moment during an overnight port stay in Bora Bora at an iconic South Pacific beachside resort.
items.tourOgTitle: Far Flung French Polynesia and Marquesas Magic

items.title: Star Collector: Comprehensive Tahiti & Marquesas Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 21 Days Nov 12 – Dec 03, 2026 21 Days Dec 17 – Jan 07, 2026-2027 21 Days Jan 21 – Feb 11, 2027 SEE ALL 13 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Wake to visions of Bali Hai, turquoise lagoons eagerly waiting for the Marina Platform to open. Snorkel off private motus while your alfresco lunch is prepared. Watch fire dancers twirl their flaming batons during an unforgettable Destination Discovery Event. Every day is magical and no matter how many times you dive into the fascinating world of French Polynesia, there’s always something new. Legendary islands live up to all the hype with their intoxicating beauty, and adventures to the rarely visited islands of the Marquesas reveal Polynesia as it used to be, with small villages, traditional handicrafts, and a culture that’s true to the ways of the past. Tropical fish dart in and out of coral reefs like the pareo-clad women in the marketplace. Ancient maraes cloaked in banyans mysteriously appear in the jungle. With each port you visit, you’ll fall deeper in love with French Polynesia.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Comprehensive Tahiti & Marquesas Adventure

items.title: Ocean Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Malaga to Bridgetown, Barbados on Star Legend 15 Days Nov 12 – Nov 27, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge yourself in leisurely, unscheduled days where time suspends in the magic of the sea. Sleep late. Dine early. Establish your own rhythm in sync with the waves and the arc of the sun and moon overhead. Watch the constellations drift and let your mind shake off all the cobwebs of shore. Feast on the impossible beauty of liquid sunsets, and let your soul dance with the dolphins in the spray off the bow.
items.tourOgTitle: Ocean Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Caribbean Beats & Transatlantic Treats
items.journeyText: Journey from Malaga to Bridgetown, Barbados on Star Legend 22 Days Nov 12 – Dec 04, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Unwind during this pleasant transatlantic crossing that offers the perfect opportunity to find true relaxation, visiting Caribbean islands before sailing to Portugal. In Basseterre, go for a zipline through the rainforest, or join a snorkel safari taking you to reefs teeming with tropical fish and coral life. Kayak through the pristine turquoise waters of Les Saintes. In Roseau, snorkel through Champagne Reef, where a stream of bubbles rising from a volcanic vent in the sea floor creates the feeling of swimming in a glass of champagne. Take a spirited tour of a rum distillery or visit a traditional Creole village in Anse Mitan. After dining on Barbados delights in Bridgetown, plan out consecutive spa days and delicious indulgences from Windstar's award-winning menu, including dishes created by James Beard Foundation award-winning chefs, during your Atlantic voyage bound for Portugal.

items.title: Cambodia, Vietnam & the Heart of Hanoi Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Halong Bay, Hanoi to Bangkok / Klong Toei on Star Seeker 13 Days Nov 12 – Nov 25, 2026 13 Days Dec 24 – Jan 06, 2026-2027 13 Days Nov 11 – Nov 24, 2027 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: From Hanoi’s storied streets to Southeast Asia’s stunning coastlines, this in-depth Vietnam journey blends culture, history and natural beauty. Spend three unforgettable nights at a 5-star hotel in Hanoi. Delve into the past with a tour of the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and Hoa Lo Prison (“The Hanoi “Hilton”). Sip authentic Vietnamese coffee in the Old Quarter. Savor the flavors of Hanoi with a street food tour. Immerse yourself in Vietnam’s artistic heritage with a chance to see a water puppet show and visiting Bat Trang Pottery Village’s centuries-old ceramic craftsmanship. Your voyage by yacht takes you through Halong Bay’s jade-green waters. Visit the lantern-lit charm of Hoi An from Da Nang, and drift along the Saigon River. Experience Cambodia’s serene Mekong River and relax on the pristine beaches of Ko Kood. A scenic cruise along Bangkok’s Chao Phraya River, creates a perfect finale.

items.tourMetaDescription: Journey into the heart of Southeast Asia on the ultimate land and sea journey. You'll have three nights at a 5-star hotel in Hanoi, starting your day like the locals with Tai Chi lessons and a serene lake walk. Savor Vietnamese coffee, pho and banh mi on a guided tour, explore the Old Quarter, and enjoy a water puppet performance. Before embarking on your voyage, visit Bat Trang Pottery Village to see traditional craftsmanship in action. Sail past limestone karsts in Halong Bay, wander Hoi An’s lantern-lit streets from Da Nang and explore Hue’s imperial grandeur. Travel Cambodia’s Mekong River to Phnom Penh and relax on Ko Kood’s pristine shores. You’ll go inland to experience Siem Reap, witness a sunrise at awe-inspiring Angkor Wat, tour Ta Prohm temple before the crowds, and cruise Tonle Sap Lake’s stilted fishing villages. It’s one wonder after another.

items.tourMetaDescription: Begin and end your journey where Old World meets New, in historic San Juan, littered with more than 400 restored Spanish colonial buildings. As you continue on this bewitching Caribbean cruise through the Virgin Islands, no two days are alike. One day, you’re shopping chic French boutiques for the latest fashions from Paris. On another, snorkeling a secluded cove known only to lucky yachtsmen — like you. Skip more common and commercial ports like St. Thomas in favor of less-visited destinations like Montserrat. Bypass the major cruise terminals in favor of marinas and anchorages exclusive to small yachts on this Caribbean cruise. And as guests on larger cruise ships take an excursion from Tortola to reach tiny Jost Van Dyke, your elegant yacht is already there.

items.tourMetaDescription: Uncover surprising discoveries through Vietnam, where you’ll travel thousands of miles of breathtaking landscapes. Beginning or ending your cruise in Hanoi, allows in-depth exploration of Vietnam's capital. Visit the limestone rock formations during an overnight in Halong Bay. Explore Hanoi’s colonial architecture before sailing to Da Nang, with its coastal beauty. Nearby is the UNESCO site, Hoi An, a 16th century trading town. Delve into Vietnam’s recent past in Ho Chi Minh City, where temples stand side-by-side with Vietnam War artifacts. An overnight stay here lets you get to know the Mekong Delta, and see the Cu Chi Tunnels a crucial tool in the Viet Cong's victory. You can also explore Cambodia, including a visit to Pnomh Penh or a 2-night tour to Angkor Wat. This cruise starts or ends in Bangkok, giving an opportunity to experience one of Asia’s most vibrant cities.

items.title: Star Collector: Captivating Vietnam & Thailand
items.journeyText: Journey from Halong Bay, Hanoi to Phuket on Star Seeker 21 Days Nov 15 – Dec 06, 2026 21 Days Dec 27 – Jan 17, 2026-2027 21 Days Nov 14 – Dec 05, 2027 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Artists, historians, foodies, beach lovers and shopaholics will all find their nirvana on this 15 port grand tour of Vietnam, Cambodia, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand. Frame a hundred perfect pictures as you cruise Halong Bay, a UNESCO site and one of the New Seven Wonders of Nature. Watch water buffalo tilling emerald rice paddies and floating markets buzzing with energy. Explore how trade brought about the unique Peranakan culture in Ancient Hoi An and Penang, then try some of the cuisine that’s become such a phenomena that there are now 27 Michelin star restaurants in Penang’s George Town. Find a spot in Angkor Wat to have a one-on-one with a bas-relief face hewn from stone some 900 years ago, and watch giant trees perform a captivating light and music show in Singapore as the sun sets. End your voyage with a string of glittering Thai islands, each one more beautiful than the last.

items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the beauty of Vietnam and Cambodia on a journey through enchanting-vibrant cities, with the legendary Angkor Wat as the crown jewel of your adventure. Explore Hanoi and its centuries-old streets before boarding your yacht and sailing on Halong Bay’s jade waters. From Da Nang, wander the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An and visit Hue’s imperial treasures. Sail along the Saigon River to Ho Chi Minh City, where French colonial charm meets modern skyscrapers. Glide along Bangkok’s Chao Phraya River, lined with golden temples. Journey inland to Cambodia, where the majestic Angkor Wat Temple awaits. Discover the heart of Cambodia with a tuk-tuk tour of Siem Reap. You’ll also explore Phnom Penh, where Khmer culture comes alive through gilded palaces.  This enriching journey, which spans both sea and land, is an exceptional in-depth exploration of Vietnam and Cambodia.

Delve deeper inland to Cambodia, with two unforgettable nights at a luxurious 5-star hotel in Siem Reap, your gateway to the awe-inspiring Angkor Wat. Additionally, spend two nights of comfort and culture at a 5-star hotel in Bangkok with a tasting tour of  Damnoen Saduak Floating Market, leaving you with memories that’ll last a lifetime.

items.title: Legendary Temples: Chiang Mai & Angkor Wat Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Bangkok / Klong Toei to Phuket on Star Seeker 18 Days Nov 21 – Dec 09, 2026 18 Days Jan 02 – Jan 20, 2027 18 Days Jan 24 – Feb 11, 2027 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience Southeast Asia’s coastal gems paired with deep expeditions into Thailand and Cambodia for a spectacular land and sea journey. Delve deeper inland to enchanting Chiang Mai, nestled in the mountains of Northern Thailand, where you’ll spend three nights at a 5-star hotel exploring the city. Visit Wat Phra That Doi Suthep for stunning views, savor the region’s flavors on a walking food tour, and enjoy the region’s famous Khao Soy soup. You’ll visit an elephant sanctuary, helping feed and bathe them, and learn about their significance to the Thai culture. Sail through the turquoise waters of Phang Nga Bay and the Thai coast, discovering Penang’s local delicacies. Enjoy an overnight in Singapore, one of Asia’s hotspots. Iconic cities like Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Phuket partner with deliciously low-key Thai islands to give you the best of both worlds. Venture inland to Siem Reap on a fully guided tour. Witness the sunrise at the majestic Angkor Wat, explore the vine-draped wonder of Ta Prohm temple before the crowds, and visit Tonlé Sap Lake to see stilted fishing villages. A tuk-tuk tour of Siem Reap and a visit to Victory Gate complete a true Cambodian experience.

items.title: Colombian & Southern Caribbean Coastlines
items.journeyText: Journey from Bridgetown, Barbados to Colon on Wind Star 11 Days Nov 24 – Dec 05, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Colombia to the quiet solitude of the Caribbean. Explore a restored Spanish colonial house and master the art of professional Colombian coffee tasting during a delicious tour near Cartagena’s Old City. Ride mountain bikes along centuries-old Aruban donkey trails near Oranjestad. Feed ostriches, cradle massive ostrich eggs, or trace your fingers along ancient coral walls inside the Hato Caves near Willemstad on Curaçao. Search for pelicans, blue herons and pink flamingos among the mangroves in Lac Bay National Park near Kralendijk on Bonaire. Dive among schools of reef fish in turquoise waters off the coast of Grenada or dine on local Creole shellfish with plantain-rich mangú, spicy rice and island lager in St. George’s. Sail away to remote, white-sand beaches or shop among locals in Union Island’s authentic fruit market near Bequia on St. Vincent & the Grenadines.

items.title: Star Collector: Reefs & Rainforests: The Caribbean, Colombia, Panama & Costa Rica via the Panama Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Bridgetown, Barbados to Puerto Caldera, San Jose' on Wind Star 18 Days Nov 24 – Dec 12, 2026 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Volcanic peaks, remote reefs, verdant rainforests and colorfully painted Caribbean ports abound throughout this remarkable 18-day cruise with stops in the Caribbean, Colombia, Panama and Costa Rica. Dive or snorkel amid schools of reef fish near Port Bequia on St. Vincent & the Grenadines. Stroll worn-cobbled streets in the historic Punda Quarter of Willemstad and shop at the nearby floating market. Ride a horse-drawn carriage through the narrow lane streets of Cartagena’s walled Old Town, rolling past regal colonial mansions. Experience a fully guided daylight transit of the Panama Canal, and uncover the deadly obstacles faced by French and American engineers prior to its 1914 completion. Trek beneath the shady overgrowth of centuries-old trees while scanning the high canopy for reclusive monkeys, brightly colored tropical birds and sloths in Costa Rica’s Manuel Antonio National Park.

items.title: Tantalizing Thailand & Sparkling Singapore
items.journeyText: Journey from Bangkok / Klong Toei to Phuket on Star Seeker 11 Days Nov 25 – Dec 06, 2026 11 Days Jan 06 – Jan 17, 2027 11 Days Jan 28 – Feb 08, 2027 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Bangkok offers a mixture of skyscrapers, ornate temples, and floating markets. Few ships can dock close to the city center, but your Windstar can  cruise the Chao Phraya River, giving you a front-row seat to Bangkok’s skyline and the daily life of riverfront communities. Discover Peranakan culture in Singapore and Penang, a unique blend of Chinese and Malay that influence everything from architecture and language to world-famous street food. An overnight in Singapore also gives you time to watch the Supertree light show at Gardens by the Bay, check out the nightlife at Clarke Quay, or try as many dishes as you can at the famous hawker stalls. Swim with free-roaming pigs at Piggy Island near Ko Samui, or head to the emerald lagoons and limestone cliffs of Ang Thong National Marine Park for kayaking and snorkeling. Relax with a unique spa day at Jungle Hot Springs in Krabi.
items.tourOgTitle: Tantalizing Thailand & Sparkling Singapore

items.title: Star Collector: Captivating Caribbean
items.journeyText: Journey from Bridgetown, Barbados to Oranjestad, Aruba on Star Legend 15 Days Nov 27 – Dec 12, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin in Barbados with a visit to Harrison’s Cave before setting sail for the French-Caribbean splendor of Martinique, where Empress Josephine spent her childhood. In St. Lucia, enjoy the bustling capital of Castries, and an overnight stay on Pigeon Island with a visit to the majestic Pitons. Follow your nose through the aromatic open-air markets of beautiful St. George’s on the “Isle of Spice.” Enjoy the exclusive Signature Beach Party on Mayreau, and walk up Mount Pleasant to witness the amazing view from Fort Hamilton on Bequia. Swim with sea turtles in Tobago Cays Marine Park, and bring binoculars for birdwatching in Bonaire. Savor the pastel colors of Old Town Willemstad and explore the limestone formations and ancient petroglyphs of Hato Caves. Complete your voyage in Aruba, where you can relax and take in some of the Caribbean’s best beaches or play dominoes with locals.

items.title: Star Collector: Windward Islands & Spanish New World
items.journeyText: Journey from Bridgetown, Barbados to Fuerte Amador, Panama City on Star Legend 16 Days Dec 04 – Dec 20, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Your journey begins in Bridgetown, a city with Jolly Ole England flavor and two UNESCO sites. Save your appetite for the exclusive Signature Beach Party on Mayreau and feel the heart and soul of St. Lucia in Soufriere. Savor a day at sea before bird watching for flamingos and parrots in Bonaire. Delight in the pastel colors of UNESCO site Old Town Willemstad and explore the limestone formations and petroglyphs of Hato Caves. In Aruba, laze on some of the Caribbean’s best beaches or play dominos with the locals. Romantic Santa Marta boasts coastal mountain beauty and museums full of pre-Columbian gold and jewelry. Relax at sea en route to the multicultural, multicolored town of Bocas del Toro, Panama where Columbus visited in 1502. Head to the jungle to meet Embera Indians; take an aerial tram ride; or experience daylight transit through the impressive Panama Canal.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Windward Islands & Spanish New World

items.title: Windward Ways & Tobago Cays
items.journeyText: Journey from Bridgetown, Barbados to Oranjestad, Aruba on Star Legend 8 Days Dec 04 – Dec 12, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Dive, snorkel and swim with fish and sea turtles in Tobago Cays Marine Park, Bonaire National Marine Park and the proposed Speyside Marine Protected Area. Swim in a picture-perfect waterfall pool surrounded by the oldest protected rainforest in the Western Hemisphere, the Main Ridge Forest Reserve. Take in the volcanic beauty of the Pitons on St. Lucia, where rainforest meets some of the healthiest coral reefs in the Caribbean. And discover Bonaire, with its stunning desert-palette motifs like pink flamingos on white salt pans. Those who are looking for the classic Caribbean will find it in Mayreau — fewer than 300 inhabitants, and just 1.5 square miles, making it a port exclusive to yachts. And those who love colonial harbors will enjoy British Bridgetown as well as the triple Dutch treat of Kralendijk, Willemstad and Oranjestad.
items.tourOgTitle: Windward Ways & Tobago Cays

items.title: Costa Rica & Panama Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Colon to Puerto Caldera, San Jose' on Wind Star 7 Days Dec 05 – Dec 12, 2026 7 Days Dec 19 – Dec 26, 2026 7 Days Jan 02 – Jan 09, 2027 SEE ALL 12 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Come find the natural and man-made wonders on this exotic voyage full of bucket list places and activities. Learn about the rare flora and fauna of Central America from a local Naturalist on board, then take a Zodiac ashore and find rare experiences for yourself. Hike through Manuel Antonio National Park in search of its lovely beaches and abundant animal life. Soar high above the Quepos jungle floor as you zip line searching for such wildlife residents as monkeys, sloths and toucans. Then explore Golfo Dulce with some of the most intense rainforest landscapes in the world. Take a daylight transit through the massive Panama Canal, one of the world's most stunning feats of engineering on a yacht that lets you see it all.
items.tourOgTitle: Costa Rica & Panama Canal

items.title: Monteverde Cloud Forest & Arenal Volcano Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Colon to Puerto Caldera, San Jose' on Wind Star 11 Days Dec 05 – Dec 16, 2026 11 Days Dec 19 – Dec 30, 2026 11 Days Jan 02 – Jan 13, 2027 SEE ALL 11 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: An unparalleled exploration of Costa Rica and Panama when you pair a cruise featuring a daylight transit of the Panama Canal with an inland tour of lush cloud forests and Costa Rica’s most prominent volcano is the best way to maximize your time in this region. Whether you choose to hike, kayak or snorkel at pristine destinations like Panama’s Isla Parida, you’ll have an onboard naturalist available to provide insights. Venture inland to trek through Costa Rica’s Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Reserve and then experience the unique magic of a nighttime walk among nocturnal animals the private Curi-Cancha Reserve. You’ll also spend an unforgettable day around the steep slopes of Arenal, Costa Rica’s active stratovolcano, where you can choose between a heart-pounding zipline ride among the high treetops, or a more leisurely hanging bridge walk featuring breathtaking rainforest views.

Discover Costa Rica’s stunning Pacific coast with stops in Playa Flamingo, Punta Leona, wildlife-rich Quepos, and Puerto Jimenez. Enjoy beach barbecues on Panama’s secluded Isla Parida and the pristine sands of Isla Aroma in the San Blas Islands. items.title: Panama Canal, Cartagena, San Blas Islands & More
items.journeyText: Journey from Oranjestad, Aruba to Fuerte Amador, Panama City on Star Legend 8 Days Dec 12 – Dec 20, 2026 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: It’s something of an insider secret: cruises that many Panama Canal travelers overlook when exploring the extreme southern edge of the Caribbean. But those who explore beyond the traditional islands know that this is where you find the epicenter of colonial history and amazing biodiversity. This is the heart of the Spanish Main, where untold wealth boarded galleons bound for Europe and colonial forts thwarted off pirate attacks. It’s the narrow isthmus that holds the Panama Canal, an epic engineering feat. And it’s the home of indigenous tribes like the Kogi, the Ngobe-Buglé and the Kuna, who have managed to maintain their traditional ways of life. These shores are also some of the most beautiful and biodiverse on earth, home to marine-rich coral reefs and subterranean bat caves.You don’t have to go far to find untouched islands or jungle-shrouded channels. All this in seven days, on a ship perfectly designed for adventure.
items.tourOgTitle: Panama Canal, Cartagena, San Blas Islands & More

Glide along Bangkok’s Chao Phraya River, lined with golden temples. Journey inland to Cambodia, where the majestic Angkor Wat Temple awaits. Discover the heart of Cambodia with a tuk-tuk tour of Siem Reap. You’ll also explore Phnom Penh, where Khmer culture comes alive through gilded palaces.  This enriching journey, which spans both sea and land, is an exceptional in-depth exploration of Vietnam and Cambodia.

items.title: Costa Rica, Panama & Machu Picchu Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to Colon on Star Legend 13 Days Dec 28 – Jan 10, 2026-2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
Trek through misty Costa Rican rainforests, immerse yourself in Panama's Embera native traditions, and add an inland journey to Machu Picchu’s iconic Incan ruins celebrated among the world’s seven wonders during this cruise tour. Experience a Peruvian adventure to the Machu Picchu citadel and indulge in Andean cuisine during stops at Sacred Valley's aromatic Urubamba market and Lima's vibrant and eclectic Barranco artist district. Glide past engineering marvels and bustling global shipping during a fully guided daylight transit of the Panama Canal. Take part in a ceviche workshop at a boutique hotel in the bohemian neighborhood of Barranco, learning to prepare this iconic Peruvian dish that has gained worldwide fame. Cast a line for feisty roosterfish off Isla Parida's emerald coast. Seek out bright-beaked toucans and skittering capuchin monkeys atop Costa Rica's rainforest canopies.

Please note that activity schedules may be adjusted due to weather, holidays, and other unforeseen circumstances.

items.tourMetaDescription: If you can’t get enough of Tahiti, this itinerary is for you—offering twice the port visits and the chance to return to Bora Bora, Taha’a, and Papeete.  Venture beyond to the remote Tuamotu Islands, where Rangiroa and Fakarava’s UNESCO-listed biosphere reserves offer some of the world’s most pristine coral reefs and marine ecosystems. Swim alongside vibrant marine life in Rangiroa’s vast lagoon, the world’s second-largest coral atoll. Get a glimpse into the fascinating world of pearl farming at the Anapa Pearl Farm on Taha'a. Spend four unforgettable days in Bora Bora, where you can relax on pristine white-sand beaches, snorkel in crystal-clear lagoons teeming with marine life, and soak in breathtaking views of Mount Otemanu. This Tahitian escape offers twice the excitement, and a chance to revisit some of the most popular ports, ensuring you get to do it all!
