On others, trails trace the cliffs and reward hikers with breathtaking ocean views. And there’s always something new to do. Explore historic colonial towns, national parks, and nature reserves. Discover cuisines that reflect both mainland traditions and the islands’ distinctive culture and abundance. Shop for colorful pottery and jewelry made from lava. Listen to Canarian musicians coax beautiful folk tunes from the tiny guitar known as a timple. Surround yourself with sunshine, sand, and the soul of a place that works its way into your heart and never lets go.

items.tourMetaDescription: Explore the Mediterranean shores during the quiet season for a different perspective. Sail along both sides of the Adriatic and trace the French Riviera and Spanish coasts during this 15-day journey with overnight port stays in Dubrovnik, Livorno (Florence) and Barcelona. Wander St. Mark's Square as you choose your favorite Venetian cafe table. Immerse yourself in Dubrovnik's highly acclaimed Red Museum exhibits and learn about Yugoslavian daily life. Meander through Pompeii's restored villas and lanes without crowds or stifling summer humidity. Discover the perfect balance of tart, Tuscan wine acidity paired with decadent pasta dishes in Florence and Capri. Delve into the abstraction of modern art and Matisse's intense colors as you stroll through Nice's elegant contemporary art museums and visit tiny shops. Indulge in tapas tastings and cocktails along Barcelona's las Ramblas.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Winter in Europe's Rivieras & Croatia

items.title: Star Collector: Winter Mediterranean Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Barcelona on Star Explorer 24 Days Jan 30 – Feb 23, 2027 24 Days Dec 20 – Jan 13, 2027-2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a quiet-season adventure along the Mediterranean's southern shores as you sail through the Adriatic to Gibraltar. Sail between Venice’s Grand Canal to Barcelona's hallmark baroque and gothic architecture. Take in the beauty of Croatia in the winter and enjoy stunning landscapes dusted with snow, seasonal markets, and authentic tranquil old towns. Hone your pizza-making skills in Naples or head inland for ancient artwork in Pompeii's ghostly ruins. Partake in wine tastings and stand close to Roman and Florentine artifacts like Michelangelo’s David. Browse Nice artisan shops rich in handcrafted carvings and fine clothing, then enjoy lunches at trendy French restaurants.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Winter Mediterranean Adventure

items.title: Carnival of Venice: Winter Italy and the Dalmatian Coast
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Explorer 8 Days Jan 30 – Feb 07, 2027 8 Days Mar 19 – Mar 27, 2027 8 Days Dec 20 – Dec 28, 2027 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Leave the crowds behind and experience Italy and the Adriatic from a different perspective on this unique off-season voyage. Overnighting in the heart of Venice during Carnival reveals a side of the city that daytime visitors never see, when the maze of bridges and canals glows softly under lantern light and masked Venetians drift through the night in quiet celebration. Staying after dark lets you feel the true soul of Carnevale—intimate, theatrical, and irresistibly romantic—an experience that lingers long after you leave. See popular attractions like the Sistine Chapel, St. Mark’s Square, and Pompeii with fewer people, giving you time to absorb the talent of Michelangelo, the ravishing beauty of Venice, and the tragedy of Pompeii. You’ll find more intimate and meaningful experiences everywhere you go as locals take the place of visitors. Walk the legendary walls of Dubrovnik’s Old Town and take your time looking over the red roofs of the medieval city during an overnight stay. Hike in tranquil Dalmatian parks, dine in family homes in small villages, and learn to cook authentic pizza in a Sicilian kitchen.
items.tourOgTitle: Carnival of Venice: Winter Italy and the Dalmatian Coast

items.title: Star Collector: Panama Canal Ocean Crossing to Tahitian Dreams
items.journeyText: Journey from Colon to Papeete, Tahiti on Wind Star 29 Days Jan 31 – Mar 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
Begin your journey in Colón, Panama, with an unforgettable transit through the legendary Panama Canal. Enjoy overnight stays in Balboa before discovering Costa Rica’s stunning Pacific coast with calls to Isla Parida, Golfito, Puerto Jimenez, Quepos, and Punta Leona. Then, set sail on an epic 20-day transpacific crossing with blissful days at sea to unwind and savor gourmet dining, spa treatments, and breathtaking sunsets. Connect with the crew, bond with fellow travelers, and rediscover your inner self amid the peaceful rhythm of life at sea. 
Finally, arrive in the dreamy paradise of Papeete, Tahiti, where lush mountains meet turquoise lagoons. This voyage offers an extraordinary blend of vibrant Latin American ports and serene oceanic adventure.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Panama Canal Ocean Crossing to Tahitian Dreams

items.title: Star Collector: Pacific Horizons from Panama to Tahiti
items.journeyText: Journey from Colon to Papeete, Tahiti on Wind Star 36 Days Jan 31 – Mar 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from the rainforests of Central America to the dreamy islands of French Polynesia on this epic journey across the Pacific. Begin in Colón with a Panama Canal transit, then explore Panama and Costa Rica’s wild Pacific coast—home to scarlet macaws, mangroves, and golden beaches. Settle into life at sea during an extraordinary 20-day transoceanic crossing, where you’ll have time to unwind, enjoy gourmet dining, spa treatments, and finish passion projects. Arrive in Tahiti to island-hop through paradise: snorkel in Bora Bora’s lagoon, explore sacred sites in Raiatea, and relax on Moorea. In many ports, Windstar’s Marina lets you kayak, swim, or paddleboard right from the ship.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Pacific Horizons from Panama to Tahiti

items.title: Costa Rica & Panama Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Colon to Puerto Caldera, San Jose' on Wind Star 8 Days Jan 31 – Feb 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Come find the natural and man-made wonders on this exotic voyage full of bucket list places and activities. Learn about the rare flora and fauna of Central America from a local Naturalist on board, then take a Zodiac ashore and find rare experiences for yourself. Hike through Manuel Antonio National Park in search of its lovely beaches and abundant animal life. Soar high above the Quepos jungle floor as you zip line searching for such wildlife residents as monkeys, sloths and toucans. Then explore Golfo Dulce with some of the most intense rainforest landscapes in the world. Take a daylight transit through the massive Panama Canal, one of the world's most stunning feats of engineering on a yacht that lets you see it all.
items.tourOgTitle: Costa Rica & Panama Canal

items.title: Monteverde Cloud Forest & Arenal Volcano Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Colon to Puerto Caldera, San Jose' on Wind Star 12 Days Jan 31 – Feb 12, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: An unparalleled exploration of Costa Rica and Panama when you pair a cruise featuring a daylight transit of the Panama Canal with an inland tour of lush cloud forests and Costa Rica’s most prominent volcano is the best way to maximize your time in this region. Whether you choose to hike, kayak or snorkel at pristine destinations like Panama’s Isla Parida, you’ll have an onboard naturalist available to provide insights. Venture inland to trek through Costa Rica’s Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Reserve and then experience the unique magic of a nighttime walk among nocturnal animals the private Curi-Cancha Reserve. You’ll also spend an unforgettable day around the steep slopes of Arenal, Costa Rica’s active stratovolcano, where you can choose between a heart-pounding zipline ride among the high treetops, or a more leisurely hanging bridge walk featuring breathtaking rainforest views.
items.tourOgTitle: Monteverde Cloud Forest & Arenal Volcano Cruise Tour

items.title: Treasures Of Thailand & Chiang Mai Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Phuket to Bangkok / Klong Toei on Star Seeker 14 Days Feb 05 – Feb 19, 2027 14 Days Dec 02 – Dec 16, 2027 14 Days Feb 02 – Feb 16, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Enjoy Chiang Mai, nestled in the mountains of Northern Thailand with three luxurious nights at a 5-star hotel. Visit Wat Phra That Doi Suthep, a Buddhist temple with stunning views of the city. Savor Chiang Mai’s flavors on a walking food tour through Old Town and the lively Chiang Mai Night Market. Spend time at an elephant sanctuary, where you’ll help feed and bathe them. Enjoy lunch at an open-air orchid farm. In Bangkok, cruise the Chao Phraya River for stunning views of the skyline and floating markets, while Singapore and Penang offer a rich blend of Chinese and Malay cultures, with vibrant street food and unique architecture. Enjoy off-the-beaten-path islands like Piggy Island and Ang Thong National Marine Park for outdoor adventures and unwind with a spa day in Krabi.
items.tourOgTitle: Treasures Of Thailand & Chiang Mai Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Winter in Spain and the Rivieras
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Explorer 16 Days Feb 07 – Feb 23, 2027 16 Days Nov 10 – Nov 26, 2027 16 Days Dec 28 – Jan 13, 2027-2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience unhurried destinations rich in breathtaking architecture, romantic solitude and authentic hospitality on this off-season sailing, with overnight port stays throughout Italy, France and Spain. Enjoy an unobstructed view of Michelangelo's David in Florence, and take advantage of your overnight to indulge in Tuscan wines, Pisa tower perspectives and tasty truffle hunts. In Nice's Old Town, savor gourmet coffees and mouthwatering croissants at local cafes for a leisurely afternoon break. Catch a glimpse of Spain's contested Holy Grail chalice amid cavernous vaulted ceilings in Valencia Cathedral. Discover the magic of Málaga — Europe's warmest winter destination — as you explore Caliph castles and sample delightful tapas. Tour Palma de Mallorca’s historic Palma Cathedral and stroll the Old Town, while in Cartagena, visit the Roman Theatre, which at one time held 7,000 spectators.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Winter in Spain and the Rivieras

items.title: Europe's Winter Riviera
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Explorer 7 Days Feb 07 – Feb 14, 2027 7 Days Nov 05 – Nov 12, 2027 7 Days Dec 28 – Jan 04, 2027-2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Leisurely enjoy Italy, southern France, and Spain. Stretch your stay at Livorno into an exploration of uncrowded iconic landmarks, intimate cafes, and inviting artisan shops in Florence, Pisa, Siena, and San Gimignano. Enjoy this rare opportunity to view artistic works by Renaissance masters. Discover Genoa’s rich maritime heritage, stunning architecture, or shop in Milan. Wander Baroque architectural edifices in Marseille prior to a wine and cheese pairing in an ancient cellar. Take in the expansive city views from Barcelona's iconic Montjuic Hill, and stroll the imposing Gothic Quarter's cavernous cathedral and Santa Maria del Mar Basilica. Take advantage of a two-day port stay in the Catalonian capital to browse shops on La Ramblas, ponder the vibrant local art scene, and graze on tasty tapas, seafood paella, decadent sangrias, and jamón, or savory Spanish ham.
items.tourOgTitle: Europe's Winter Riviera

items.title: Winter Riviera & Madrid Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Explorer 11 Days Feb 07 – Feb 18, 2027 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Docking in some of world’s most iconic coastal cities – Rome, Nice, Florence, and Barcelona – you’ll have the rare opportunity to explore landmarks such as the Roman Coliseum, the Piazzale Michelangelo and the Sagrada Familia unfettered by crowds, while enjoying quiet moments in intimate cafés, trendy eateries, artisan shops, and galleries tucked away on cobblestone streets. Traveling Comfort Class via high-speed train between Barcelona and Madrid, you’ll have two full days and four nights to take in the capital’s vibrant culture and rich history, with a gorgeous 5-star hotel as your home base. Exclusive experiences such as early entry to the renowned Prado Museum, a flamenco dinner show at Spain’s only Michelin-starred tablao restaurant, and daytrips including a 450-year-old winery in the beautiful Penedés region complete this unforgettable journey.
items.tourOgTitle: Winter Riviera & Madrid Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Captivating Vietnam & Thailand
items.journeyText: Journey from Phuket to Halong Bay, Hanoi on Star Seeker 21 Days Feb 08 – Mar 01, 2027 21 Days Dec 05 – Dec 26, 2027 21 Days Feb 05 – Feb 26, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Artists, historians, foodies, beach lovers and shopaholics will all find their nirvana on this 15 port grand tour of Vietnam, Cambodia, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand. Frame a hundred perfect pictures as you cruise Halong Bay, a UNESCO site and one of the New Seven Wonders of Nature. Watch water buffalo tilling emerald rice paddies and floating markets buzzing with energy. Explore how trade brought about the unique Peranakan culture in Ancient Hoi An and Penang, then try some of the cuisine that’s become such a phenomena that there are now 27 Michelin star restaurants in Penang’s George Town. Find a spot in Angkor Wat to have a one-on-one with a bas-relief face hewn from stone some 900 years ago, and watch giant trees perform a captivating light and music show in Singapore as the sun sets. End your voyage with a string of glittering Thai islands, each one more beautiful than the last.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Captivating Vietnam & Thailand

items.title: Star Collector: Wonders of Southern Japan & Southeast Asia
items.journeyText: Journey from Phuket to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker 31 Days Feb 08 – Mar 11, 2027 31 Days Feb 05 – Mar 07, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This month-long voyage will create a lifetime of memories, from pristine rural locales to glimmering neon cities. Step into a watercolor scene: longtail boats cruising the serene waters and karst pillars of Halong Bay, water buffalo tilling verdant rice paddies, vermilion torii guarding Shinto shrines, and magical Thai islands we’ve hand-selected from over 1,400 choices. Expand your culinary horizons with Peranakan fusion food in Malaysia and Singapore, Khmer noodles in Cambodia and Ishigaki’s melt-in-your-mouth beef. Browse the famous night markets during overnight stays in Hong Kong, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City and Singapore. Anchor it all with a better understanding of the past as you visit the National Palace Museum in Taipei, with one of the largest collections of Chinese art in the world, or Hoi An’s Ancient Town, with its beautifully preserved 18th-century merchant houses.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Wonders of Southern Japan & Southeast Asia

items.title: Star Collector: Grand Asia Explorer
items.journeyText: Journey from Phuket to Tokyo on Star Seeker 41 Days Feb 08 – Mar 21, 2027 41 Days Feb 05 – Mar 17, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Visit destinations unlike anything else, all set against a backdrop of unforgettable cuisines, history, and adventures. With overnight stays in four of Asia’s most dynamic cities – feel their frenetic energy, immerse yourself in their cultures, savor world-famous street food, and explore rich traditions and history. Cruise shallow waterways like the Saigon River and Chao Phraya River and moor right into cities like Ho Chi Minh City and Bangkoke. You’ll also discover less-visited ports and islands, with small-group excursions that immerse you in local culture. Explore perfectly preserved samurai villages, secretive cu chi tunnels, and bustling floating markets in Malaysia. Drink in the emerald and turquoise beauty of Halong Bay from the decks of a traditional junk. Learn to fish from a sampan on the Mekong Delta, slurp udon like a native in Takamatsu, and cook pad thai in Thailand.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Grand Asia Explorer

items.title: Ocean Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to Papeete, Tahiti on Wind Star 21 Days Feb 08 – Mar 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge yourself in leisurely, unscheduled days where time suspends in the magic of the sea. Sleep late. Dine early. Establish your own rhythm in sync with the waves and the arc of the sun and moon overhead. Watch the constellations drift and let your mind shake off all the cobwebs of shore. Feast on the impossible beauty of liquid sunsets, and let your soul dance with the dolphins in the spray off the bow.
items.tourOgTitle: Ocean Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Passage to French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to Papeete, Tahiti on Wind Star 28 Days Feb 08 – Mar 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from the lush Pacific coast of Costa Rica to the turquoise lagoons of French Polynesia on this 30-night transoceanic adventure. Begin in Puerto Caldera and enjoy 20 relaxing sea days perfect for recharging, learning new hobbies, or savoring dishes created by James Beard Foundation chefs. After crossing the Pacific, arrive in Tahiti to discover French Polynesia’s most enchanting islands. Swim in Bora Bora’s blue lagoon and enjoy Windstar’s exclusive Destination Discovery Event: Polynesian Feast & Fire on a private motu. Visit a fragrant vanilla plantation in Taha’a and explore the sacred sites and lush jungle of Huahine. In many ports, Windstar’s water access Marina lets you kayak, paddleboard, relax and swim right from the ship.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Passage to French Polynesia

items.title: Latin America Explorer
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to Oranjestad, Aruba on Star Legend 13 Days Feb 09 – Feb 22, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail between Costa Rica and Aruba on an unforgettable journey showcasing the best of Latin America. Discover Costa Rica’s stunning Pacific coast with stops in Playa Flamingo, Punta Leona, wildlife-rich Quepos, and Puerto Jimenez. Enjoy beach barbecues on Panama’s secluded Isla Parida and the pristine sands of Isla Aroma in the San Blas Islands. Experience the marvel of the Panama Canal transit and explore Panama’s vibrant Bocas del Toro. Savor an overnight stay in Cartagena, Colombia, where you can wander its colorful colonial streets. This voyage combines the best of Costa Rica, Colombia and Panama for a true Latin America exploration.
items.tourOgTitle: Latin America Explorer

items.title: Naturally Costa Rica
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to Fuerte Amador, Panama City on Star Legend 7 Days Feb 09 – Feb 16, 2027 7 Days Feb 21 – Feb 28, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Lush, full of life, kissed by the sun and blessed with a breathtaking shoreline, the “rich coast” is just what it claims to be.  History, flora and fauna are highlighted by local Naturalists. Enjoy breathtaking views in Playas del Coco before visiting Quepos for rainforest adventures and searching for redbacked squirrel monkeys in Manuel Antonio National Park. Relax on one of Corinto’s white-sand beaches and swim in the inviting clear blue water.
items.tourOgTitle: Naturally Costa Rica

Fly from Los Angeles (LAX) and in just nine hours you’ll check in at the open-beamed lobby of the Intercontinental Resort in Tahiti. This package includes hotel stays prior to and after your sailing, allowing ample time to relax in the landmark hotel lagoon and shop in nearby Papeete. Your transfers between the airport, hotel and yacht are overseen by staff, so you focus on experiencing the sights and sounds unique to Tahitian island life.

items.title: Star Collector: Windward Islands & Spanish New World
items.journeyText: Journey from Fuerte Amador, Panama City to Bridgetown, Barbados on Star Legend 14 Days Feb 16 – Mar 02, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Your journey begins in Bridgetown, a city with Jolly Ole England flavor and two UNESCO sites. Save your appetite for the exclusive Signature Beach Party on Mayreau and feel the heart and soul of St. Lucia in Soufriere. Savor a day at sea before bird watching for flamingos and parrots in Bonaire. Delight in the pastel colors of UNESCO site Old Town Willemstad and explore the limestone formations and petroglyphs of Hato Caves. In Aruba, laze on some of the Caribbean’s best beaches or play dominos with the locals. Romantic Santa Marta boasts coastal mountain beauty and museums full of pre-Columbian gold and jewelry. Relax at sea en route to the multicultural, multicolored town of Bocas del Toro, Panama where Columbus visited in 1502. Head to the jungle to meet Embera Indians; take an aerial tram ride; or experience daylight transit through the impressive Panama Canal.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Windward Islands & Spanish New World

items.title: Panama Canal, Cartagena, San Blas Islands & More
items.journeyText: Journey from Fuerte Amador, Panama City to Oranjestad, Aruba on Star Legend 6 Days Feb 16 – Feb 22, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: It’s something of an insider secret: cruises that many Panama Canal travelers overlook when exploring the extreme southern edge of the Caribbean. But those who explore beyond the traditional islands know that this is where you find the epicenter of colonial history and amazing biodiversity. This is the heart of the Spanish Main, where untold wealth boarded galleons bound for Europe and colonial forts thwarted off pirate attacks. It’s the narrow isthmus that holds the Panama Canal, an epic engineering feat. And it’s the home of indigenous tribes like the Kogi, the Ngobe-Buglé and the Kuna, who have managed to maintain their traditional ways of life. These shores are also some of the most beautiful and biodiverse on earth, home to marine-rich coral reefs and subterranean bat caves.You don’t have to go far to find untouched islands or jungle-shrouded channels. All this in seven days, on a ship perfectly designed for adventure.
items.tourOgTitle: Panama Canal, Cartagena, San Blas Islands & More

items.title: Star Collector: Okinawa Days & Mekong Ways
items.journeyText: Journey from Bangkok / Klong Toei to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker 20 Days Feb 19 – Mar 11, 2027 20 Days Feb 16 – Mar 07, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discoveries await on this in-depth sailing visiting 13 different ports. Explore Southern Japan, once the realm of Ryukyu kings, and currently where mainlanders go for their tropical beach vacations. Ride a water buffalo carriage past walls made of coral in a beautifully preserved Ryukyu village just off the coast of Ishigaki, and dive into local cuisine at Okinawa’s Kokusai Dori food street, where flavors are influenced by Ryukyu kings as well as American GIs. Overnight in three dynamic cities and stay late in others, with time to pursue your interests or let your curiosity lead you — to the Mekong Delta, My Son Sanctuary, Cu Chi Tunnels or a Vietnamese cooking class. Revisit Vietnam’s distant past in Hoi An’s Ancient Town and the Imperial City of Hue, and feel awe in the presence of Angkor Wat — the 12th century complex that’s more than four times the size of Vatican City.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Okinawa Days & Mekong Ways

items.title: Star Collector: Japan & Vietnam In-Depth
items.journeyText: Journey from Bangkok / Klong Toei to Tokyo on Star Seeker 30 Days Feb 19 – Mar 21, 2027 30 Days Feb 16 – Mar 17, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Gorgeous landscapes, complex pasts and delicious cuisines are yours as you explore 22 different ports throughout Japan and Vietnam. See classic icons in mainland Japan with its feudal castles, ancient capitals, forested mountains, and steaming hot springs. Travel south to subtropical Okinawa, with beaches, mangroves, withs its own distinct culture due to its past as part of the Ryukyu Kingdom. You’ll find a similar dichotomy in Vietnam as you travel from the north’s more temperate landscape to the tropical south. Feast your eyes on the karst landscape of Halong Bay, Da Nang’s amazing beaches and Marble Mountains, and historic sites from My Son Sanctuary and Hue to Hoi An, with an optional overland to Angkor Wat. Stops in Taipei, Taiwan, Busan, South Korea, Phnom Penh, Cambodia, and one of Thailand’s most spectacular islands add to an already incredible journey.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Japan & Vietnam In-Depth

items.title: Windward Ways & Tobago Cays
items.journeyText: Journey from Oranjestad, Aruba to Bridgetown, Barbados on Star Legend 8 Days Feb 22 – Mar 02, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Dive, snorkel and swim with fish and sea turtles in Tobago Cays Marine Park, Bonaire National Marine Park and the proposed Speyside Marine Protected Area. Swim in a picture-perfect waterfall pool surrounded by the oldest protected rainforest in the Western Hemisphere, the Main Ridge Forest Reserve. Take in the volcanic beauty of the Pitons on St. Lucia, where rainforest meets some of the healthiest coral reefs in the Caribbean. And discover Bonaire, with its stunning desert-palette motifs like pink flamingos on white salt pans. Those who are looking for the classic Caribbean will find it in Mayreau — fewer than 300 inhabitants, and just 1.5 square miles, making it a port exclusive to yachts. And those who love colonial harbors will enjoy British Bridgetown as well as the triple Dutch treat of Kralendijk, Willemstad and Oranjestad.
items.tourOgTitle: Windward Ways & Tobago Cays

items.title: Heart of Hanoi & East Asia Legends Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Halong Bay, Hanoi to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker 13 Days Feb 26 – Mar 11, 2027 13 Days Feb 23 – Mar 07, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a captivating journey from Japan to Vietnam, where each stop reveals a new world of culture and beauty. Sail from Osaka to the lush shores of Amami and Okinawa, known for their subtropical landscapes and pristine beaches. Stay over in Hong Kong, where the Symphony of Lights illuminates the harbor skyline. Revel in the natural beauty and welcoming tranquility of Vietnam’s Halong Bay. Your adventure culminates in Hanoi, where a 5-star hotel provides your luxurious home base to explore the wonders of the city on foot or traditional cyclo. Start your day with a Tai Chi lesson. Savor a tasting tour of world-famous Vietnamese street food. Take in the Old Quarter’s storied past and vibrant night market. Immerse yourself in Vietnam’s artistic heritage with a traditional water puppet show and a visit to Bat Trang Pottery Village to see centuries-old craftsmanship in action.
items.tourOgTitle: Heart of Hanoi & East Asia Legends Cruise Tour

items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Wind Star 10 Days Feb 26 – Mar 08, 2027 10 Days Mar 08 – Mar 18, 2027 10 Days Mar 19 – Mar 29, 2027 SEE ALL 113 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Enjoy the perfect Tahitian vacation in paradise. Overnight in Papeete before heading to the hypnotically beautiful island of Moorea, where you’ll stay in a luxurious overwater bungalow. With turquoise lagoons, jagged emerald peaks, and the scent of exotic flowers and vanilla in the air, Moorea is a dreamscape you’ll never forget. Spend two nights soaking in its natural beauty, snorkeling vibrant reefs, and unwinding in true island style. Then ferry back to Papeete and step aboard your elegant yacht for a week of South Pacific discovery—exploring the sacred culture of Raiatea, meeting the blue-eyed eels of Huahine, and reveling in Bora Bora’s legendary beauty. Don’t miss Windstar’s Exclusive Destination Discovery Event: Polynesian Feast & Fire,  a dazzling Polynesian feast beneath the stars, complete with fire dancers and island music.

items.title: East Asian Legends
items.journeyText: Journey from Halong Bay, Hanoi to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker 10 Days Mar 01 – Mar 11, 2027 10 Days Feb 26 – Mar 07, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the diversity of East Asian cultures as you make your way from traditional rural villages to subtropical beaches. On Japan’s Amami Island, instead of sake, you’ll drink kokuto shochu made of brown sugar. And instead of kimonos in vivid colors, you’ll find complex patterns in earth tones made with a mud-dyed technique that’s been in use for 1,300 years. Shop for distinctive and colorful Ryukyu glass in Okinawa, once made from the old bottles discarded by U.S. troops. Explore Ishigaki’s Yaima Village, an open-air museum of preserved Ryukyu-style houses. In Taiwan’s capital, Taipei, browse the National Palace Museum’s massive collection of Chinese art treasures, or head to the old-town market where you’ll find Chinese medicine apothecaries, traditional handicrafts and more. Listen for the noon-day gun on Garden Road, a tradition established by the British in the 1860s.
items.tourOgTitle: East Asian Legends

items.title: Star Collector: Island Jewels of Japan
items.journeyText: Journey from Halong Bay, Hanoi to Tokyo on Star Seeker 20 Days Mar 01 – Mar 21, 2027 20 Days Feb 26 – Mar 17, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience Tokyo with its neon lights, Ginza shopping, and more Michelin-starred restaurants than any city in the world. Wrap yourself in natural beauty as you gaze at the perfect symmetry of Mt. Fuji, go “sand bathing” at a hot spring, and hike trails past waterfalls, shrines, and massive evergreens. You’ll find echoes of the past, from Osaka’s and Kyoto’s cultural and historical treasures to the peace parks of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. After exploring Japan’s main islands, head to the Ryukyu Islands. As part of the Ryukyu Kingdom the culture has infused with foreign influences. See hints of China in Okinawa’s 14th-century Shuri Castle, and notice how everything from the cuisine to the language include Chinese, Korean and Southeast Asian influences. Revel the “Amami blue” waters and a peacock array of palm trees, unspoiled beaches, and coral reefs.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Island Jewels of Japan

items.title: Kyoto & East Asia Dreams Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Halong Bay, Hanoi to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker 12 Days Mar 01 – Mar 13, 2027 12 Days Feb 26 – Mar 09, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This unforgettable voyage across East Asia promises to make your dreams come true. Unlock the secrets and ancient beauty of Kyoto with two nights at a 5-star hotel. Discover iconic landmarks, from the Golden Pavilion to the historic Gion district. Spend a day in Nara, a city rich in crafts and cuisine, and home to eight UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Marvel at the awe-inspiring Todai-ji Temple, housing the world’s largest Buddha statue; view Kasuga Shrine, lined with thousands of lanterns; and stroll Nara Park, where sacred deer freely roam. Pass by Osaka Castle before you board your yacht for the sparkling Japanese islands of Amami and Okinawa. Explore Taipei’s temples and enjoy an overnight stay in Hong Kong. Visit breathtaking Halong Bay, where you can tour the captivating scenery aboard a traditional fishing junk, before heading to Hanoi, Vietnam's cultural heart.
items.tourOgTitle: Kyoto & East Asia Dreams Cruise Tour

items.title: Knot Your Average Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Bridgetown, Barbados to Lisbon on Star Legend 15 Days Mar 02 – Mar 17, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Step aboard an extraordinary wellness cruise with Debbie Dixon, renowned author, life coach, and wellness expert. This transformative journey is designed to nurture your mind, body, and spirit. Offering an immersive experience that combines daily yoga, meditation, and breathwork sessions to help restore balance and inner peace, adding the space to reconnect with yourself, others, and your dreams. Along the way, you’ll indulge in gourmet meals that are both nourishing and indulgent, enjoy decadent spa treatments, and unwind at a specialized Elixir Bar Pop-Up offering mind-body elixirs that rejuvenate and restore. Every moment, from sunrise to sunset, is yours to enjoy, whether you choose to spend it reflecting in solitude or connecting with new friends. Simply step on board, and we’ll take it from there – your dream getaway awaits.
items.tourOgTitle: Knot Your Average Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Spanish Shores Transatlantic Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Bridgetown, Barbados to Barcelona on Star Legend 23 Days Mar 02 – Mar 25, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Cross the Atlantic on an unforgettable journey between the Caribbean and Spain. After days of open-sea serenity, the dramatic landscapes of Madeira and Porto Santo reveal lush gardens, volcanic peaks, and golden beaches. Continue on to Lisbon to explore tiled streets, historic trams, and a lively waterfront. Next, discover Spain’s vibrant south, with ports that range from Andalusian charm in Cádiz and Málaga to the Moorish legacy of Almería and Cartagena. The voyage is capped off with the beauty of Mallorca’s coastlines and time in Barcelona, a city alive with Gaudí’s masterpieces and Mediterranean energy.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Spanish Shores Transatlantic Crossing

items.title: Portuguese Passages & Spanish Shorelines Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Barcelona on Star Legend 12 Days Mar 13 – Mar 25, 2027 12 Days Apr 07 – Apr 19, 2027 12 Days Jun 12 – Jun 24, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Combine a culturally immersive inland journey throughout Portugal with a scenic tracing of Spain’s iconic coastlines during this remarkable 12-day combination cruise and land tour. The experience features coastal sailing from Barcelona to Lisbon, Portugal, complemented by a scenic Douro River cruise in Pinhão as part of the inland experience. Inhale intermingled aromas of seafood and spicy bean soup on Porto’s glowing twilight streets as melancholic fado lyrics and guitarra strings reverberate across stone walls. Light a candle amid prayerful pilgrims in the silence of Fátima’s most sacred sites. Peer into the spiraling, moss-lined columns of the Initiation Well near the misty Sintra Forest. Bask in the Douro Valley’s unique sunlit glow as you stand among the rocky contours of steep terraced vineyards. Master the art of tapas cooking under the direction of an Andalusian chef near Málaga. Sip sherries and wander among old barrels in Cadiz wine cellars. Kayak between scenic caletas, or quays, in Mallorca’s clear coastal waters.
items.tourOgTitle: Portuguese Passages & Spanish Shorelines Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Iberian Soul & Italian Style
items.journeyText: Journey from Malaga to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 15 Days Mar 14 – Mar 29, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin with an overnight in Málaga, where Andalusian flair shines in Moorish palaces. Cross to Tangier, Morocco, a gateway between continents with sweeping coastal views. Continue through Spain in-depth: discover Cartagena’s Roman theater, Valencia’s blend of Gothic and modern design, Palma de Mallorca’s seaside beauty, and the lesser-known Catalonian gem, Tarragona. Stay overnight in both Barcelona and Livorno, giving you time to explore Catalonia’s  capital and Tuscany’s Renaissance heartlands. In Nice, stroll the elegant Promenade des Anglais, wander the flower-filled markets of the Old Town, or journey to the hilltop villages of Provence. In Genova, uncover the city’s maritime heritage in its atmospheric old quarter or join a hands-on excursion to craft traditional Ligurian pesto. Conclude in Rome, where history comes alive with visits to the Colosseum, the Vatican, and timeless piazzas.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Iberian Soul & Italian Style

items.title: Treasures of Southern Spain & Morocco
items.journeyText: Journey from Malaga to Barcelona on Wind Spirit 8 Days Mar 14 – Mar 22, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Dazzle your senses with Spanish treasure — golden Costa del Sol beaches, Picasso’s genius in Málaga, the Roman ruins of Cartagena and Tarragona. Sit at a café in Tangier’s medina sipping mint tea and watching old men play backgammon. Celebrate a dream come true.
items.tourOgTitle: Treasures of Southern Spain & Morocco

items.title: Star Collector: Winter in Europe's Rivieras & Croatia
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Venice on Wind Spirit 17 Days Mar 22 – Apr 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore the Mediterranean shores during the quiet season for a different perspective. Sail along both sides of the Adriatic and trace the French Riviera and Spanish coasts during this 15-day journey with overnight port stays in Dubrovnik, Livorno (Florence) and Barcelona. Wander St. Mark's Square as you choose your favorite Venetian cafe table. Immerse yourself in Dubrovnik's highly acclaimed Red Museum exhibits and learn about Yugoslavian daily life. Meander through Pompeii's restored villas and lanes without crowds or stifling summer humidity. Discover the perfect balance of tart, Tuscan wine acidity paired with decadent pasta dishes in Florence and Capri. Delve into the abstraction of modern art and Matisse's intense colors as you stroll through Nice's elegant contemporary art museums and visit tiny shops. Indulge in tapas tastings and cocktails along Barcelona's las Ramblas.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Winter in Europe's Rivieras & Croatia

items.title: Star Collector: Europe’s Southern Coasts & the Adriatic
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Venice on Wind Spirit 25 Days Mar 22 – Apr 16, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail a carefully paced route that links the French and Italian Rivieras with the historic ports of the Adriatic, allowing the Mediterranean to unfold gradually over time. Begin with two full days in Barcelona, ideal for exploring neighborhoods, markets, and evening dining before heading east. Along the Riviera, walk ashore in Nice and Genoa, then linger overnight in Livorno with time for Florence and Pisa. Calls in Rome, Naples, and Messina trace Italy’s cultural spine, with an overnight in Naples opening access to Pompeii, Capri, and the city after dark. The voyage then shifts into the Adriatic, featuring extended stays in Dubrovnik and Zadar, followed by overnights in Venice that frame both arrival and departure through the lagoon. Between regions, leisurely sea days offer time to enjoy onboard dining, open decks, and the relaxed pace of small-ship sailing.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Europe’s Southern Coasts & the Adriatic

items.title: Star Collector: Riviera Nights, Aegean Sunsets via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Piraeus, Athens on Star Legend 15 Days Mar 25 – Apr 09, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the Rivera’s most iconic destinations, Italy's picturesque coastline and ancient Greek temples during this Mediterranean cruise. Seek out Cézanne's artistic inspirations amid lush gardens, Roman walls, and stunning St. Sauveur Cathedral in Aix en Provence. Test your luck during a late-night port stay in Monte Carlo. Lace up your shoes for a hike among elegant Italian villas, olive groves, and Medieval ruins high above the cliffs surrounding Portofino. Wander Pompeii's silent baths, theaters and temples in the shadow of Mt. Vesuvius. Take to the skies on a helicopter tour above Messina and the summit of Mount Etna - Europe's highest volcano. Drift into the underground caves of Vlyhada and Alepotrypa during a boat tour of the Dyros Caves outside Gythion. Tour the hidden medieval city of Monemvasia and sample local olive oils drizzled on fresh-baked bread in a shaded olive grove.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Riviera Nights, Aegean Sunsets via the Corinth Canal

items.title: Ocean Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Philipsburg, St
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge yourself in leisurely, unscheduled days where time suspends in the magic of the sea. Sleep late. Dine early. Establish your own rhythm in sync with the waves and the arc of the sun and moon overhead. Watch the constellations drift and let your mind shake off all the cobwebs of shore. Feast on the impossible beauty of liquid sunsets, and let your soul dance with the dolphins in the spray off the bow.
items.tourOgTitle: Ocean Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: The Best of the Marquesas & French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 18 Days Mar 28 – Apr 15, 2027 18 Days Oct 03 – Oct 21, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Beyond Tahiti lies an even more remote paradise—discover the Marquesas and the Tuamotu Islands, where only the lucky few ever venture. Grab your camera and join a marine biologist on a search for spinner dolphins, pilot whales, and rough-tooth dolphins off Moorea's coast. Enjoy a Windstar exclusive complimentary Destination Discovery Event in Bora Bora. Snorkel above manta rays or dive deep into cobalt-hued coral grottos on a guided SCUBA excursion off Fakarava's UNESCO biosphere reserve. Board an SUV and roll through tranquil Taipivai Valley, novelist Herman Melville's former refuge after he deserted his ship and was held captive by Nuku Hiva natives nearly 200 years ago. Beachcomb and sip coconut refreshments at the edge of Rangiroa's Green Lagoon, where there is plenty of time to swim on your own or shop for unique keepsakes.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: The Best of the Marquesas & French Polynesia

items.title: Winter Italy and the Dalmatian Coast
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Spirit 10 Days Mar 29 – Apr 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Leave the crowds behind and experience Italy and the Adriatic from a different perspective on this unique off-season voyage. See popular attractions like the Sistine Chapel, St. Mark’s Square, and Pompeii with fewer people, giving you time to absorb the talent of Michelangelo, the ravishing beauty of Venice, and the tragedy of Pompeii. You’ll find more intimate and meaningful experiences everywhere you go as locals take the place of visitors. Walk the legendary walls of Dubrovnik’s Old Town and take your time looking over the red roofs of the medieval city during an overnight stay. Hike in tranquil Dalmatian parks, dine in family homes in small villages, and learn to cook authentic pizza in a Sicilian kitchen.
items.tourOgTitle: Winter Italy and the Dalmatian Coast

items.title: Star Collector: Adriatic Nights & Venetian Dreams
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Spirit 18 Days Mar 29 – Apr 16, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Rome to Venice on a journey rich with history, beauty, and Adriatic charm. Begin with an overnight in Naples, where Mount Vesuvius looms over ancient Pompeii and the Amalfi Coast shimmers nearby. Cross to Croatia for overnight stays in Dubrovnik’s marble-clad Old Town and Zadar, where Roman ruins meet dramatic sunsets along the Adriatic Sea. Three days in Venice allow ample time to glide through canals, admire Byzantine mosaics, and savor Venetian cicchetti in hidden wine bars. Along the way, discover smaller gems including medieval Opatija, Croatia’s Sibenik with its UNESCO-listed cathedral, and Slovenia’s seaside jewel of Piran.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Adriatic Nights & Venetian Dreams

items.title: Voyage Detail Page - Star Collector: Wonders of Southern Italy, Greece & Türkiye via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Istanbul on Star Legend 16 Days Apr 01 – Apr 17, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Stroll the ancient streets of Pompeii, the cobblestones under your feet rutted by centuries of chariot wheels. Be amazed by the beauty of Delphi, the tranquil atmosphere ideal for contemplation and prophesy. Climb the foot-smoothed steps to the Parthenon, standing beneath columns where famous philosophers once stood. And follow the marble streets of Ephesus, the setting for an unforgettable Windstar Destination Discovery Event complete with a five-course meal and live music under the stars. Discover strange round-roofed trulli houses in Puglia, white windmills in Mykonos, bronze warriors in Reggio Calabria, the golden-sand beaches of Gallipoli, and the beautiful village of Fiskardo, its pastel-painted 18th-century Venetian houses. Beauty surrounds you, with every shade of blue on the horizon: dazzling blue grottos, electric “Santorini blue” cupolas, the azure Aegean. Come see them all.
items.tourOgTitle: Voyage Detail Page - Star Collector: Wonders of Southern Italy, Greece & Türkiye via the Corinth Canal

items.title: Moments in Southern Italy & Greece via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Piraeus, Athens on Star Legend 8 Days Apr 01 – Apr 09, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Savor extra time to soak up sun-kissed Italian beaches, stroll through charming vineyards, and savor local cuisine with a shortcut through the Corinth Canal—a passage reserved for small ships like ours. Wander the imposing fortifications and archeological revelations of the 15th century Castello Aragonese, then explore countless ancient Greek and Roman relics at a Taranto museum. Drift silently on a small boat into the turquoise glow of Sicily's famous Blue Grotto. Taste rich red wines adjacent to flourishing vineyards growing on the slopes of Mount Etna above Giardini Naxos. Check cruise dates for additional days, stops, and excursions, including the Temple of Apollo in the ruins of Delphi, a speedboat getaway from Fiskardo to remote Kephalonia beaches, and a stop at the walled town of Italy's Gallipoli, where you can master fine dining details of Puglia's cuisine from an expert chef.
items.tourOgTitle: Moments in Southern Italy & Greece via the Corinth Canal

items.title: Legends of the Northern Adriatic
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Venice on Wind Spirit 8 Days Apr 08 – Apr 16, 2027 8 Days Apr 16 – Apr 24, 2027 8 Days Apr 24 – May 02, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore the Adriatic's northern coastal reaches, scenic small ports, and historic cities in Italy, Slovenia, and Croatia on an eight-night voyage. Sip espresso as you follow the literary footsteps of novelist James Joyce through Trieste cafes, museums, and inspirational waterfront vistas. Admire colorful Roman mosaics and Byzantine era architecture in Ravenna, then nibble on warm Piadina--a local flatbread made since the Middle Ages--paired with golden Albana wine. Escort happy hounds into the Motoven Forest on a truffle hunt outside Opatija. Browse Sibenik shops in search of smoked meats, tart cheeses, Croatian wood carvings, and handcrafted jewelry. Dip into the soothing salt spa therapy pools in the Secovlje Salina Nature Park outside Piran, or venture inland to the historic capital of Ljubjana, where you can visit manicured 18th century park lanes, ornate cathedrals, and a regal castle.
items.tourOgTitle: Legends of the Northern Adriatic

items.title: 2027 Northern Europe Mystery Cruise
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to Amsterdam on Star Pride 7 Days Apr 15 – Apr 22, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin in London with a spectacular sail under Tower Bridge, gliding down the Thames to the open sea. Your journey unfolds as a true mystery, with Northern European calls announced 36 hours before arrival to heighten the sense of discovery. Several destinations will be new to Windstar, giving you bragging rights to be among the first to experience them. Expect a mix of cultural capitals, coastal treasures, and intimate harbors that larger ships can’t reach. Conclude in Amsterdam, perfectly timed for the city’s enchanting tulip season. It’s not just about where you’re going—it’s about who you’re sailing with. Trust Windstar to guide you on a voyage of surprise and connection, where every reveal feels like an adventure shared among friends
items.tourOgTitle: 2027 Northern Europe Mystery Cruise

items.title: Vatican & Italian Riviera Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Explorer 9 Days Apr 26 – May 05, 2027 9 Days Oct 19 – Oct 28, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge your sense of wonder during this journey that combines a multi-day inland exploration to Rome with an Italian Riviera cruise and a scenic sailing along the steep and majestic Italian and French Rivieras. Sidestep the ordinary Vatican crowds during a tour of the Sistine Chapel and some sectors of the Vatican Museums. Discover the Roman Colosseum through the eyes of gladiators on an exclusive visit to Rome’s most recognizable landmark. Savor fresh handmade pasta dishes and rich Chianti wines amidst the warm ambiance and sincere hospitality of a neighborhood Italian restaurant. Your cruise features unforgettable opportunities to experience the scenic Portoferraio Biosphere Reserve and explore the historic vineyards of Elba, set along the storied Italian Riviera. Watch beachcombers from white-linen sidewalk cafés or sunbathe on romantic sandy beaches in Cannes. Inhale seafood aromas and herbal fragrances in a Barcelonan open market.
items.tourOgTitle: Vatican & Italian Riviera Cruise Tour

items.title: Yachtsman's Harbors of the Rivieras
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Explorer 7 Days Apr 28 – May 05, 2027 7 Days Oct 21 – Oct 28, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Follow in the footsteps of artists and writers — and the world’s fanciest yachts, too — as you immerse yourself in the intoxicating atmosphere of the Italian Rivera and France’s Côte d’Azur. You’ll explore delightful resort towns and small villages where Matisse, Picasso, Van Gogh and others found inspiration. Admire the architecture of Gaudí in Barcelona. Try your luck at the Grand Casino in Monte Carlo. Visit Michelangelo’s astonishing Sistine Chapel, and the Roman Colosseum. Along the way, admire castles and ancient ruins, with access to many UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The leisurely pace of your voyage allows time to swim and sail, directly from your yacht’s Marina Platform. As you explore idyllic coastal scenes, you’ll quickly understand why the Rivieras are among the most treasured yachting destinations in the world.
items.tourOgTitle: Yachtsman's Harbors of the Rivieras

items.title: Tulip Season in Holland & Belgium
items.journeyText: Journey from Amsterdam to London / Hms Belfast on Star Pride 8 Days Apr 29 – May 07, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Visit Holland at the height of tulip season on this Northern Europe cruise, when the country’s fields explode in vibrant swaths of every imaginable color. Wander through the enchanting Keukenhof Gardens, home to millions of blooms. Then, set off on a coastal voyage to small countryside cities. Explore the quaint streets of Harlingen — a small-ship exclusive — and wander along its old canals, merchant houses and charming little alleys. Rotterdam offers a mix of modernity and history, with its bustling seaport and the timeless beauty of The Hague. Enjoy an overnight in Antwerp, whose exclusive seaport accepts only one ship per day, and explore the city’s rich artistic heritage — and the world’s largest Diamond District. From the culinary delights of Bruges to the architectural wonders of Ghent, each call is a chapter in a story of discovery and delight.
items.tourOgTitle: Tulip Season in Holland & Belgium

items.title: Star Collector: Adriatic Odyssey
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Venice on Wind Spirit 14 Days May 02 – May 16, 2027 14 Days Jun 18 – Jul 02, 2027 14 Days Jul 02 – Jul 16, 2027 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Spend your summer exploring charming Old Towns and idyllic islands in the Adriatic, from small ship-only ports to the stunning natural beauty of the Dalmatian Riviera. Search for “Lions of St. Mark’s” in towns like Rovinj and Trogir, where Venetian bas-reliefs still watch from stone gates and clock towers. Admire dazzling Byzantine mosaics in Ravenna, a treasure trove of art and history with eight UNESCO World Heritage sites. Don’t miss the jewel-box Mausoleum of Galla Placidia, famous for its deep blue ceiling of golden stars. Cruise past lush pine forests, hidden waterfalls, and limestone cliffs as we sail the Croatian coast. Marvel at Kotor’s dramatic fjord and approach Dubrovnik’s towering walls. Taste Dalmatian prosciutto, handmade pastas, Istria’s truffles, and Slovenia’s nutty potica in unforgettable settings.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Adriatic Odyssey

items.title: Venetian Majesty & Spectacular Croatia: The Northern Adriatic
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Dubrovnik on Wind Spirit 7 Days May 02 – May 09, 2027 7 Days Jun 18 – Jun 25, 2027 7 Days Jul 02 – Jul 09, 2027 SEE ALL 5 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Summer is perfect for Adriatic vacation escapes to Italy, Slovenia, and Croatia. This seven-day cruise offers ample opportunities for relaxing on beaches and exploring shady Medieval-era lanes. Browse wine and local treats at a bustling farmers market in a small village outside Piran. Crane your neck skyward to admire saints and ceilings inside Ravenna's Basilica of San Vitale--one small part of a larger UNESCO World Heritage Site. Wander between Roman gates and a Byzantine chapel in Pula prior to sampling acclaimed olive oils and Croatian bread outside Rovinj. Explore vineyards and pastures as you visit a traditional family farmhouse and taste artisan foods outside Zadar. Board a small inflatable boat bound for a secluded beach and quiet bliss beyond the 13th-century cathedral and old town of Trogir. Peruse small shops in Dubrovnik's oldest quarter for unique gifts and family keepsakes.
items.tourOgTitle: Venetian Majesty & Spectacular Croatia: The Northern Adriatic

items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Bordeaux on Star Explorer 16 Days May 05 – May 21, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin your voyage in Bordeaux, France, visiting picturesque destinations on your way to Barcelona, Spain.  An overnight stay in Bordeaux allows you to savor world-renowned wines. Sail on to Bilbao, Spain, and enjoy another overnight. Continue to Gijon, Spain, known for its maritime heritage, before heading to Vigo, Spain. Discover the charm of Porto, Portugal, with its riverside vistas. In Lisbon, Portugal, experience an overnight stay that lets you wander through the narrow streets of Alfama. Next, sail to Seville, Spain, where an overnight stay allows time to explore the grand Seville Cathedral. Cross over to Tangier, Morocco, where the vibrant souks offer a taste of Moroccan charm. Continue to Malaga, Spain, birthplace of Picasso. In Cartagena, uncover Roman ruins. Valencia, with its futuristic City of Arts and Sciences, is the next stop before concluding your journey in Barcelona.

items.title: Star Collector: Vintage Croatia & Timeless Italy
items.journeyText: Journey from Dubrovnik to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 16 Days May 09 – May 25, 2027 16 Days Jul 09 – Jul 25, 2027 16 Days Sep 28 – Oct 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore the Croatian coastlines—taking time to soak in the scent of lemon trees, skip stones on pristine pebble beaches, and browse for lavender ice cream in storybook medieval towns. From popular ports like Dubrovnik and Split to tiny, small-ship-only Pomena, Balkan hospitality shines. You'll also experience a rich tapestry of Italian regions, from the canals of Venice to the southern charms of Puglia and Sicily. Enjoy an overnight in Sorrento, where you can explore the remains of Pompeii. UNESCO treasures abound, including Diocletian’s Palace in Split, the time capsule city of Dubrovnik, the gnome-like trulli huts of Alberobello near Monopoli, and Mount Etna near Messina. Nature lovers will revel in the lush terraced waterfalls at Plitvice Lakes or Krka National Park, while the Bay of Kotor delivers a dramatic finale with deep blue waters and a walled Old Town.

items.title: Off the Beaten Path Adriatic
items.journeyText: Journey from Dubrovnik to Venice on Wind Spirit 7 Days May 09 – May 16, 2027 7 Days Jun 25 – Jul 02, 2027 7 Days Jul 09 – Jul 16, 2027 SEE ALL 7 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail aboard the intimate Wind Spirit and discover the Adriatic’s most enchanting ports, from UNESCO-listed Dubrovnik to the romance of Venice. Explore Montenegro’s dramatic Bay of Kotor, wander through the charming streets of Monopoli in Italy, and uncover Croatia’s island treasures in Pomena and Korcula—with a late-night stay in Korcula giving you time to enjoy its vibrant evening café culture. Experience Sibenik’s medieval charm, then linger late in Opatija, where elegant seaside promenades sparkle under the stars, both small ship exclusive ports. Another late-night stay in Porec invites you to savor its old town’s golden-hour glow and lively waterfront before your final sail into Venice’s iconic lagoon, a small ship exclusive.
