items.title: Quick Getaways: Seaside Charms & Dutch Waterways
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to Amsterdam on Star Pride 3 Days May 10 – May 13, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin your journey in the center of London with the unforgettable small-ship experience of sailing beneath the iconic Tower Bridge. Cross the North Sea to Bruges, where canals, medieval squares, and chocolate shops make every street feel like a postcard. Continue to Harlingen, a true Dutch harbor town that blends maritime tradition with authentic local charm. Your voyage concludes in Amsterdam, famous for its winding canals, world-class museums, and lively café culture. This shorter itinerary offers the perfect taste of Northern Europe, combining iconic destinations with rare small-ship exclusives.
items.tourOgTitle: Quick Getaways: Seaside Charms & Dutch Waterways

items.title: Maritime Capitals of Northern Europe
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to London / Hms Belfast on Star Pride 8 Days May 10 – May 18, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Travel from London to Amsterdam and back again on a thoughtfully paced Northern Europe itinerary shaped by river access and overnight stays. Small-ship sailing allows passage beneath Tower Bridge and docking in city centers, with extended time in London for museums, markets, and historic neighborhoods, and overnights in Antwerp to explore Flemish art, fashion, diamonds, and dining after dark. Along the way, Bruges offers medieval streets, canals, and chocolate traditions; Harlingen reveals a working Dutch harbor with deep maritime roots; and Honfleur invites strolls along its old basin of half-timbered houses and access to Normandy’s coast.
items.tourOgTitle: Maritime Capitals of Northern Europe

items.title: Star Collector: Japan and North Pacific Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Osaka, Kyoto to Seward, Anchorage, Alaska on Star Seeker 21 Days May 10 – May 31, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Ancient temples and modern marvels await you throughout your transpacific crossing from Alaska to Japan and South Korea. Relax and rejuvenate with extended spa days, onboard entertainment, and award-winning culinary indulgences during your ocean voyage from Anchorage to Tokyo. Stand at the edge of Tokyo's Shibuya Crossing or join the flow of humanity. Pause with pilgrims at the Kumano-Nachi Taisha, a Shinto shrine and UNESCO World Heritage Site, then rest in the shade of a 850-year-old camphor tree planted by a 12th century samurai. Imagine the perils encountered by Japan's warrior class amid gardens and narrow lanes in the Chiran Samurai District near Kagoshima. Master the art of udon noodle making in Takamatsu, the birthplace of delicious udon delights. Dine on fresh fish and tangy seafood delicacies at the Jagalchi Fish Market in Busan — South Korea's largest seafood market.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Japan and North Pacific Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Alaskan Wonders & Japanese Mysteries
items.journeyText: Journey from Osaka, Kyoto to Vancouver, Bc on Star Seeker 33 Days May 10 – Jun 12, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Vancouver through the rugged wilds of Alaska, sailing to Ketchikan, Juneau, and Sitka, before venturing across the Pacific on a stretch of 11 sea days, the perfect opportunity. Your arrival in Japan marks the beginning of the mystery cruise segment, where ports are revealed just 36 hours in advance, adding a thrilling element of surprise. But it’s not only about where you’re going—it’s about who you’re sailing with, and with Windstar as your trusted guide, every mystery becomes part of a shared adventure. After your mystery cruise segment, discover both hidden gems and iconic destinations such as Osaka, Hiroshima, and Tokyo. Small-ship access allows for immersive exploration of tucked-away harbors like Tomonoura, while still delivering the grandeur of major cities like Osaka and Tokyo.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Alaskan Wonders & Japanese Mysteries

items.title: Star Collector: Songs of Sicily & Southern Italy via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 18 Days May 11 – May 29, 2027 18 Days Oct 18 – Nov 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Circle Sicily and browse stunning Italian coastlines, authentic Puglian towns, enchanting Greek islands, and iconic ruins. Cross the Corinth Canal, a historic channel only wide enough for small ships like ours. Encounter restless volcanoes from Mt. Vesuvius to Mt. Etna to nighttime cruising past Stromboli, tears of glowing lava often streaming down its face. Walk in the footsteps of the past at Pompeii, the Oracle’s shrine in Delphi, the Valley of the Temples in Porto Empedocle, and Valetta’s cathedral. Discover Puglia’s Greek heritage in relaxed, authentic ports like Gallipoli and Reggio Calabria, and gaze in awe at the giant Greek theater in ancient Syracuse, a venue the size of the Hollywood Bowl hewn by hand from the pale limestone. From street food to wine tastings, Greek ruins to Rome’s incredible wealth of antiquities, this voyage makes every day one to savor.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Songs of Sicily & Southern Italy via the Corinth Canal

items.title: Moments in Southern Italy & Greece via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 8 Days May 11 – May 19, 2027 8 Days Oct 18 – Oct 26, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Savor extra time to soak up sun-kissed Italian beaches, stroll through charming vineyards, and savor local cuisine with a shortcut through the Corinth Canal—a passage reserved for small ships like ours. Wander the imposing fortifications and archeological revelations of the 15th century Castello Aragonese, then explore countless ancient Greek and Roman relics at a Taranto museum. Drift silently on a small boat into the turquoise glow of Sicily's famous Blue Grotto. Taste rich red wines adjacent to flourishing vineyards growing on the slopes of Mount Etna above Giardini Naxos. Check cruise dates for additional days, stops, and excursions, including the Temple of Apollo in the ruins of Delphi, a speedboat getaway from Fiskardo to remote Kephalonia beaches, and a stop at the walled town of Italy's Gallipoli, where you can master fine dining details of Puglia's cuisine from an expert chef.
items.tourOgTitle: Moments in Southern Italy & Greece via the Corinth Canal

items.title: Star Collector: The Flavors of France
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to London / Hms Belfast on Star Explorer 18 Days May 13 – May 31, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Lisbon to London on an extraordinary journey weaving through Portugal, Spain, France, and the UK. Explore Portugal’s coastal gems in Lisbon and Porto before tracing Spain’s northern shores from Vigo to the culinary capital of San Sebastián. In France, linger overnight in St. Jean de Luz and St. Malo and spend two nights in Bordeaux, savoring seaside elegance. Cruise the Seine to Rouen for an overnight, with Paris within easy reach. From the City of Light you can admire the Gothic grandeur of Notre-Dame, stroll the Champs-Élysées to the Arc de Triomphe, stand beneath the Eiffel Tower, or wander the Louvre’s vast galleries. Conclude in true small-ship style, sailing under Tower Bridge to berth beside HMS Belfast in the very heart of London.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: The Flavors of France

items.title: Quick Getaways: Timeless Maritime Powerhouses of Northern Europe
items.journeyText: Journey from Amsterdam to London / Hms Belfast on Star Pride 5 Days May 13 – May 18, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin your voyage in Amsterdam, where iconic canals and world-class museums set the stage. Sail to Antwerp for a two-night stay, giving you time to savor Belgium’s chocolate, diamonds, and rich history. Continue to Honfleur, a picture-perfect French harbor that has inspired generations of artists and is your gateway to the Normandy landing beaches, such as Omaha Beach and Pointe du Hoc. Your journey culminates in London with an overnight in the very heart of the city. Experience the rare and unforgettable thrill of sailing beneath Tower Bridge, a privilege reserved for small ships.
items.tourOgTitle: Quick Getaways: Timeless Maritime Powerhouses of Northern Europe

items.title: Lake Como & Adriatic Romance Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 12 Days May 13 – May 25, 2027 12 Days Jul 13 – Jul 25, 2027 12 Days Oct 02 – Oct 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge in rustic Italian cuisine, Roman relics and Baroque masterworks on a 11-day odyssey that combines a picturesque overland exploration of Lake Como and Venice with an extensive cruise through the Adriatic and along Italy’s West Coast. Delve into the depths of delectable Northeast Italian wine vintages and savor Amarone’s cherry and cinnamon nuances in a cool, underground Valpolicella winery. Overnight provides time to float past Venice’s romantic arched bridges and ancient alleyways on a gondola ride. Dip a kayak blade in the clear waters near old harbor walls outside Dubrovnik. Sample homemade cheeses and sausages in a family-run olive grove near Kotor. Wander between restored mosaics, broken columns and cracked pottery amid Pompeii’s storied ruins. Dine on authentic, handmade pizza while gentle coastal breezes waft through Sorrento’s aromatic citrus trees.
items.tourOgTitle: Lake Como & Adriatic Romance Cruise Tour

stops.port: MILAN-MALPENSA AIRPORT TO LAKE COMO CRUISE TOUR HOTEL

items.title: Classic Italy & Dalmatian Coast
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 9 Days May 16 – May 25, 2027 9 Days Jul 16 – Jul 25, 2027 9 Days Oct 05 – Oct 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore timeless cities to tiny ports of unmatched beauty on one of the classic cruises from Rome to Venice. Pose in front of the Roman Colosseum and see the ancient city of Pompeii. Sail through the breathtaking Bay of Kotor and explore the famously picturesque towns of the Amalfi Coast. Wander the ancient cobblestone streets of the Sicilian town of Taormina and along the famous fortifications of the medieval city of Dubrovnik, dubbed “paradise on earth.” Your cruise will explore some of the most beautiful coastline in the world, places of legends and heroes, inspiration for writers and poets – and in popular culture, filming locations for the popular HBO TV series “Game of Thrones.” The leisurely pace allows time to swim in crystal clear sea and discover hidden beaches; kayak or tour by Zodiac along untouched coastline; visit bucket list sights; and sip, dine, and otherwise discover local culture in three fascinating countries.
items.tourOgTitle: Classic Italy & Dalmatian Coast

items.title: Vatican & Croatian Coastlines Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 11 Days May 16 – May 27, 2027 11 Days Jul 16 – Jul 27, 2027 11 Days Oct 05 – Oct 16, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge your sense of wonder during this journey that combines a multi-day inland exploration to Rome with an Italian Riviera cruise and a scenic sailing along the steep and majestic Italian and French Rivieras. Sidestep the ordinary Vatican crowds during a tour of the Sistine Chapel and some sectors of the Vatican Museums. Discover the Roman Colosseum through the eyes of gladiators on an exclusive visit to Rome’s most recognizable landmark. Savor fresh handmade pasta dishes and rich Chianti wines amidst the warm ambiance and sincere hospitality of a neighborhood Italian restaurant. Your cruise features unforgettable opportunities to experience the scenic Portoferraio Biosphere Reserve and explore the historic vineyards of Elba, set along the storied Italian Riviera. Watch beachcombers from white-linen sidewalk cafés or sunbathe on romantic sandy beaches in Cannes. Inhale seafood aromas and herbal fragrances in a Barcelonan open market.
items.tourOgTitle: Vatican & Croatian Coastlines Cruise Tour

items.title: Sicilian Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 10 Days May 19 – May 29, 2027 10 Days Jul 05 – Jul 15, 2027 10 Days Oct 26 – Nov 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Encircle the Isle of Sicily and discover sparkling resorts favored by emperors, towns frozen in time by legendary volcanoes, Maltese palaces where knights and Grand Masters once gathered … this itinerary has them all. Watch the stunning Amalfi Coast pass by from the deck of your intimate ship and raise a glass of limoncello to another blissful day in the warm Mediterranean sunshine.
items.tourOgTitle: Sicilian Splendors

items.title: Star Collector: Sicilian & Corsican Escape
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 13 Days May 19 – Jun 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Rome on a journey that fully circumnavigates the storied island of Sicily, uncovering the places Italians cherish for their own getaways. Cruise past the fiery silhouette of Stromboli before exploring the laid-back Aeolian charm of Lipari and the vibrant traditions of Palermo. Pause in Sicily’s western gems of Trapani and Porto Empedocle, beloved for their local markets and seaside cafés, then continue to Malta’s capital of Valletta, a favorite island escape. Trace ancient footsteps in Syracuse and soak up the relaxed beach-town atmosphere of Giardini Naxos, gateway to Taormina. Round out your journey with a taste of la dolce vita in Sorrento, before venturing north to the colorful harbor of Portovenere and the dramatic, cliffside retreat of Bonifacio in Corsica.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Sicilian & Corsican Escape

items.title: Ocean Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Tokyo to Seward, Anchorage, Alaska on Star Seeker 11 Days May 20 – May 31, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge yourself in leisurely, unscheduled days where time suspends in the magic of the sea. Sleep late. Dine early. Establish your own rhythm in sync with the waves and the arc of the sun and moon overhead. Watch the constellations drift and let your mind shake off all the cobwebs of shore. Feast on the impossible beauty of liquid sunsets, and let your soul dance with the dolphins in the spray off the bow.
items.tourOgTitle: Ocean Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Alaska Discovery & Pacific Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Tokyo to Vancouver, Bc on Star Seeker 23 Days May 20 – Jun 12, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
"
Discover why Alaska is a top cruise destination as you explore its wildlife, frontier towns, native culture, and fjordland scenery, then unwind during a trans-Pacific crossing to Tokyo. This voyage is tailored to your vacation dreams. Experience Alaska’s beauty with Zodiac trips in Kenai Fjords and Tracy Arm, a ride on the White Pass Railroad, and flightseeing over glaciers. Immerse yourself in native culture with a Master Totem Carver in Ketchikan and a visit to Klukwan. Spot black and brown bears, eagles, whales, sea lions, mountain goats, and more from platforms, float trips, or your balcony. After your Alaska adventure, relax and find your favorite spots onboard as you sail to vibrant Tokyo."
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Alaska Discovery & Pacific Crossing

items.title: Impressionist France
items.journeyText: Journey from Bordeaux to London / Hms Belfast on Star Explorer 10 Days May 21 – May 31, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Glimpse into fairytale magic – the breathtaking Mont St. Michel, St. Malo, the Ville Close of Concarneau with its romantic drawbridges. Stunning La Rochelle built of luminous white limestone, Quimper’s gargoyle-embellished cathedral, Monet’s fabulous Japanese garden in Giverny, and Versailles, its gardens as magnificent as its gilded interior. Bone up on the Norman Conquest in the threads of the 11th century Bayeux Tapestry. Uncover the hearts and souls of medieval prisoners in the graffiti of La Rochelle’s Old Port towers. Relive the battle before the battle of D-Day in the bullet holes on Pegasus Bridge. Wander gardens and flower markets, quaint Old Towns and the shops of Rue de Rennes in Paris. And with overnight stays and smaller ports of call that are closer to the sights than big ships get, you can spend more time in the places you want to see most.
items.tourOgTitle: Impressionist France

items.title: Endless Days In Norway
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to Copenhagen on Star Pride 11 Days May 22 – Jun 02, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: More than a thousand fjords lace the west coast of Norway, carved by glaciers and filled by the Norwegian Sea. One of the world’s natural wonders, Geirangerfjord and Sognefjord are stunning from every angle — from the top of Lysefjord’s anvil-shaped Pulpit Rock, from the Flam Railway as it winds through the mountains and past waterfalls high above Aurlandsfjord, and from the fjords themselves as you cruise on your boutique ship. Tiny hill farms, half-timbered houses, and stave churches pass by, leading the way to the Art Nouveau architecture of Alesund, the colorful Hanseatic pier in Bergen, and sights too beautiful to imagine.
items.tourOgTitle: Endless Days In Norway

items.title: Star Collector: Scandinavian and Baltic Delights
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to Helsinki on Star Pride 19 Days May 22 – Jun 10, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Drift into fjords and past Baltic coastlines on a sailing across Northern Europe. Sip hot kaffe with waffles and relax amid the furnishings of a Norwegian family home . Ride mountain bikes from the crest of Mount Fløyen through an emerald forest to placid lakes and sweeping views of the city of Bergen. Step aboard turn-of-the-century mechanized rides and snack on decadent chocolate treats at Copenhagen's Tivoli Gardens--one of Europe's oldest amusement parks. Glide past Gdansk's thriving waterfront on a guided kayak tour. Indulge in smoked fish and Lithuanian beer with friendly Klaipeda locals. Walk around the ornate Swedish sailing ship Vasa in Stockholm, the oldest fully preserved ship in the world.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Scandinavian and Baltic Delights

items.title: Glitz & Glamour of the Riviera with Monaco's Prix du Monde
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Legend 10 Days May 29 – Jun 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Relax, dine, and revel at the Riviera's most picturesque settings prior to joining royalty and Europe's elite for a weekend of world-class racing on Monte Carlo's storied streets. Explore wine shops and family-owned cafes in Cinque Terre villages. Wander between watchtowers overlooking Bonifacio's Corsican coast. Spend a day in the cool shade of Rome's Pantheon, the shadowy recesses of the Colosseum, or simply browse hundreds of unique Eternal City shops. This all leads up to a weekend in dazzling Monaco during the Formula One (r) race with reserved seats for qualifying and race day. You'll roll off the starting line at our hallmark race celebration party, and receive a themed gift package that includes ear plugs, commemorative cap, and high-definition binoculars. Our insider presentation gives you the scoop on team strategies and what to look for during this remarkable event.
items.tourOgTitle: Glitz & Glamour of the Riviera with Monaco's Prix du Monde

items.title: Star Collector: The Cook Islands & Forever French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 18 Days May 30 – Jun 17, 2027 18 Days Sep 05 – Sep 23, 2027 18 Days Jun 11 – Jun 29, 2028 SEE ALL 4 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Slip beneath gentle waves to ethereal coral outcroppings teeming with vibrant fish and curious sea turtles while snorkeling and guided diving excursions off Moorea's emerald shores. Wander the pristine shores of Aitutaki, home to one of the world’s most breathtaking lagoons, where turquoise waters lap against powdery white sand. Explore Rarotonga’s lush mountain trails and bustling markets, where Polynesian culture thrives in vibrant dance, music, and crafts. Immerse yourself in the rich seafaring traditions of the Cook Islands, where stories of ancient Polynesian navigation come to life through local history and legend.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: The Cook Islands & Forever French Polynesia

items.title: Alaskan Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Vancouver, Bc on Star Seeker 12 Days May 31 – Jun 12, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
"Conde Nast Traveler 2019 Hot List ""As far as Alaskan expeditions go, this itinerary gives passengers more access to so many aspects of the state's culture than any competitor.""  - Conde Nast Traveler 
Witness the grandeur of Alaska’s premier glaciers: Mendenhall in Juneau, Kenai Fjords’ Harding Icefield, Tracy Arm’s twin Sawyer Glaciers. Discover Alaskan Native villages, Russian cathedrals, and Gold Rush history. Thrill as you watch a wild brown bear snatch a struggling salmon from a stream or a humpback whale breach off the bow. Cruise Misty Fjords and Kenai Fjords on your lovely all-suite ship, waters beyond the reach of larger Alaska cruise ships."
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Splendors

items.title: Star Explorer Christening Sailing: Circumnavigating Ireland
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to Dun Laoghaire, Dublin on Star Explorer 10 Days Jun 01 – Jun 11, 2027 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Uncover the rich experiences awaiting you on this 8-day Ireland and Northern Ireland cruise. Stroll past 400-year-old stone walls and gleaming brass fixtures while inhaling fragrant whiskey aromas at the world's oldest licensed whiskey distillery outside Londonderry, Ireland. Experience the breathtaking Cliffs of Moher as you cruise between Galway and Dingle. Take in the sweeping coastal views 2,000 feet above the waves at the crest of Slieve League Cliffs, one of Europe's highest coastal precipices and a mere giant's boulder toss from the white-walled village of Killybegs. Visit Killary Fjord, the only fjord in Ireland. Tap your toes to Irish flutes and sip tea near stone monuments that make up the Dingle Peninsula's rich archaeological heritage. Kiss the Blarney Stone atop the storied battlements of Blarney Castle. Then, sample Irish coffee with Cork locals at an authentic pub.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Explorer Christening Sailing: Circumnavigating Ireland

items.title: Star Collector: Luck and Legends - Ireland and Scotland
items.journeyText: Journey from London / Hms Belfast to Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland on Star Explorer 18 Days Jun 01 – Jun 19, 2027 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: This Scotland and Ireland cruise inspired the world's best poets, writers, and composers for centuries. Create your own travel opus on this sailing to mysterious stone age monoliths and genial coastal communities. Seek out red squirrels and elusive pine martens on a guided stroll to Rogie Falls on Scotland's Blackwater River near Invergordon. Explore the neolithic circles and the prehistoric settlement of Skara Brae, just beyond the white walls of Orkney's storied Skaill House. Walk on some of the 40,000 coastal basalt stones along the Giant's Causeway beyond Portrush. Indulge in Galway's local fish and chips, or stroll amid megalithic limestone tombs in The Burren--imposing monuments predating Egypt's pyramids. Lean out over the battlements of Blarney Castle and kiss the Blarney Stone for luck, then unwind with smokey whiskey samples at Cork County's storied Jameson Distillery.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Luck and Legends - Ireland and Scotland

items.title: Rome & Prix du Monde of Monaco
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Barcelona on Star Legend 7 Days Jun 01 – Jun 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Surrounded by glitterati on the glistening Wind Surf you fit right in; your insider’s experience at Monaco’s legendary Prix du Monde, the jewel in the crown of this exceptional cruise. Visit some of the unique ports — Portoferraio and Palamos, and iconic cities like Rome and Monte Carlo — strolling famous promenades, shopping elite boutiques, and taking in world-renowned beaches. Then during your overnight in Monte Carlo, enjoy exclusive access to special Windstar private Prix du Monde of Monaco events and two days of world-class Formula One time trials and racing. It’s the ultimate expression of Windstar’s style, and open to only a very limited number of guests.
items.tourOgTitle: Rome & Prix du Monde of Monaco

items.title: Seven Gems of the Baltic
items.journeyText: Journey from Copenhagen to Helsinki on Star Pride 8 Days Jun 02 – Jun 10, 2027 8 Days Jun 29 – Jul 07, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Join Windstar on an unforgettable Baltic voyage across seven countries, exploring the well-preserved medieval streets of Tallinn, Estonia; the modern vibrancy of Helsinki, Finland; and beyond. Enjoy an overnight in Stockholm, Sweden, where you’ll experience the world’s oldest open-air museum and savor the local fare, like kroppkakor (hearty potato dumplings) or kålpudding (cabbage pudding). Discover the medieval charm and stunning architecture of Riga, Latvia and Gdansk, Poland by strolling through their historic Old Towns. Navigate the unspoiled Curonian Spit by kurenkahn, a traditional flat-bottom boat, or kayak along the scenic coastline of Bornholm, Denmark, exploring the tranquil bays. Each destination is carefully curated to offer a blend of historical insights, natural beauty and modern Scandinavian living.
items.tourOgTitle: Seven Gems of the Baltic

items.title: Star Collector: Prix du Monde of Monaco: A Mediterranean Circuit
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Venice on Wind Spirit 16 Days Jun 02 – Jun 18, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This Star Collector voyage combines exclusive access to the Prix du Monde of Monaco with an in-depth Mediterranean route from Barcelona to Venice.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Prix du Monde of Monaco: A Mediterranean Circuit

items.title: Race Day & Riviera Charm: Prix du Monde of Monaco
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 7 Days Jun 02 – Jun 09, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on an unforgettable Mediterranean voyage that blends glamour, culture, and the iconic Monaco Grand Prix. From Barcelona’s lively boulevards to the pastel-hued streets of Collioure and the sun-kissed beaches of St. Tropez, every stop offers its own charm In Nice, enjoy an overnight stay with included tickets to both Saturday’s qualifying and Sunday’s race, with transportation to and from Monte Carlo arranged, while still leaving time to savor the city’s cobblestone lanes and seaside cafés. Cruise onward to Portofino, a postcard-perfect fishing village where colorful houses cluster around a sparkling cove, and Porto Santo Stefano, a hidden gem of Tuscany offering access to pristine beaches and rolling vineyards. Your journey concludes in Rome, surrounded by history, art, and timeless Italian beauty.
items.tourOgTitle: Race Day & Riviera Charm: Prix du Monde of Monaco

items.title: Star Collector: Summering in Southern Italy & Croatia
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Dubrovnik on Wind Spirit 16 Days Jun 09 – Jun 25, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: See Italy and the Dalmatian Riviera at their summer best, when tomatoes, basil and eggplant are in season, lavender in Calabria and Hvar is in bloom. The stunning Amalfi Coast is your appetizer, its terraces dotted with citrus fruits, vines and olive trees, and its covered passageways leading to shops selling everything lemon. Calabria holds a wealth of riches from golden beaches and palm-lined promenades. A day in Venice is yours to design, although Ravenna may steal some of its thunder with its mosaics – each colored glass, marble or gold tesserae no bigger than a fingernail and placed with care.. Take in Piran’s Venetian charms in a thin slice of Slovenia sandwiched between Italy and Croatia, then relax and unwind in the Dalmatian Riviera. Listen to Zadar’s sea organ, walk the streets of a living museum town in Trogir, and taste lavender honey on Hvar before ending your voyage in Dubrovnik.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Summering in Southern Italy & Croatia

items.title: Bella Italia - A Southern Italian Romance
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Spirit 9 Days Jun 09 – Jun 18, 2027 9 Days Aug 07 – Aug 16, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Rediscover small-ship cruising's unique advantages and immerse yourself in southern Italy during this sailing to the Calabria and Puglia regions. Follow your Amalfi guide past deep ravines, hidden seabird nests and dramatic Mediterranean vistas on a trek to an Italian hamlet. Cook up your own Calabrian cuisine and dine on salamis, warm crusty breads and fresh cheeses during a cooking class in Vibo Valentia. Admire 2,500-year-old bearded bronze statues of Greek Riace warriors.  Explore the narrow, labyrinth-like lanes of Taranto in Puglia, a spectacular coastal city rich in Greek ruins. Wander through Otranto, a historic coastal town known for its picturesque harbor and the stunning Otranto Cathedral with its famous mosaic floor. Glide through emerald-green seas and seek out soaring terns and darting schools of fish during a placid kayak tour in the waters of Rab, Croatia.
items.tourOgTitle: Bella Italia - A Southern Italian Romance

items.title: Star Collector: Scottish and Viking Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Dun Laoghaire, Dublin to Copenhagen on Star Explorer 18 Days Jun 11 – Jun 29, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Much like the Irish blessing, the road, fjords and emerald scenery rise up to meet you throughout this cruise to historic Northern European ports, emerald-topped cliffs and unspoiled Norwegian fjords during visits throughout Ireland, the Isle of Man, Scotland, Norway, and Denmark. Sip a rich and frothy stout and take in Dublin’s skyline from the Gravity Bar. Float past lonely Scottish castles, serrated coastal cliffs and seemingly endless windswept heaths. Spiral skyward in the hoofsteps of royalty inside Copenhagen’s Rundetaarn, a 17th century observatory built for horses and carriages and host to horseback rulers like Czar Peter the Great.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Scottish and Viking Adventure

items.title: Gaelic Explorers
items.journeyText: Journey from Dun Laoghaire, Dublin to Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland on Star Explorer 8 Days Jun 11 – Jun 19, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: From the pubs of Dublin to the castles of Edinburgh, this immersive cruise to Scotland journeys through hills and highlands, idyllic islands, and lyrical landscapes. Here in the land of good Scotch and great golf, astonishing natural beauty meets refined elegance in beautiful ports and quaint marinas, with ancient sites like Skara Brae offering a glimpse into Scotland's earliest history. Celebrate Scotland's iconic past and lively present – and toast the spirit of the Emerald Isle.
items.tourOgTitle: Gaelic Explorers

items.title: Moorish Legacies & Island Escapes
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Barcelona on Star Legend 12 Days Jun 16 – Jun 28, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Portugal’s Atlantic gateway to the sun-drenched Mediterranean coast, where history and culture meet seaside beauty. Step into Andalusia with a day in Cadiz, known as the oldest city in Western Europe and gateway to Seville. Marvel at the towering Rock of Gibraltar, with its storied tunnels and playful Barbary macaques. In Malaga, explore Moorish fortresses and Picasso’s birthplace, while Almeria reveals desert landscapes and its imposing Alcazaba. Continue to Cartagena, where Roman ruins mingle with modernist architecture. Then slow down to the rhythm of island life among the Balearics—from the Gothic cathedral of Palma de Mallorca to the quiet harbors of Alcudia and Mahon—before ending in vibrant Barcelona and the colorful French fishing port of Port Vendres.
items.tourOgTitle: Moorish Legacies & Island Escapes

items.title: Star Collector: Spanish Spectacular & Riviera Reveries
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 19 Days Jun 16 – Jul 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This sweeping journey begins with an in-depth exploration of Spain, from the Andalusian coast to the Balearic Islands, before continuing along the French and Italian Rivieras for a taste of timeless glamour. Discover Cádiz’s lively tapas scene, the Rock of Gibraltar’s iconic views, and Málaga’s blend of Moorish fortresses and modern boulevards. Wander the whitewashed lanes of Almería, step into history in Cartagena, and soak up the island beauty of Mallorca and Menorca. From France’s hidden harbors like Port Vendres and Sanary-sur-Mer to the glitz of Monte Carlo and Cannes, the Riviera comes alive with local flavor and old-world charm. Conclude your adventure among the Tuscan and Ligurian gems of Portofino and Portoferraio before arriving in Rome’s port of Civitavecchia.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Spanish Spectacular & Riviera Reveries

items.title: Endless Days In Norway
items.journeyText: Journey from Copenhagen to Copenhagen on Star Pride 10 Days Jun 18 – Jun 28, 2027 10 Days Jul 15 – Jul 25, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Scenery lovers and active outdoorsy types will both find plenty to love on these fjord-focused cruises Norway is best known for. Take a cable car to a mountain peak overlooking Andalsnes and the Romsdal Alps, hike back down or go for a scenic train ride through the mountains and across the picturesque stone Kylling Bridge. Visit tiny Olden at the inner end of Nordfjord and hike to a glacier’s face, or take the Skylift to lofty views. Go mountain biking on Mount Fløyen in Bergen, or wander the shops at the colorful Hanseatic wharf. In Trondheim, you can do both – use the city’s free bikes for a ride around town to check out the emerging foodie scene. We’ll follow the fjord all the way to the sea and beyond, to the island of Frøya, where much of the world’s farmed fish is grown and tables are set with fresh crab, scallops, and local cheese. These are the kinds of immersive experiences that define the cruises Norway travelers seek: close encounters with fjords, mountains, and coastal culture.
items.tourOgTitle: Endless Days In Norway

items.title: Star Collector: Norwegian Fjords and Scottish Isles
items.journeyText: Journey from Copenhagen to Reykjavik on Star Pride 20 Days Jun 18 – Jul 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Stroll authentic and Norwegian fishing villages and savor Scotland's traditional flavors and warm hospitality during this unforgettable 20-night journey from Denmark to Iceland. Sail into Norway’s legendary fjords—Geirangerfjord with its plunging waterfalls, Nordfjord with its glaciers, and Hardangerfjord, famed for its orchards. Beyond the natural wonders, discover the heart of Norway in its hidden fishing villages—quaint harbors lined with colorful boathouses, where time moves at a slower pace and warm hospitality greets you at every turn. Board a rigid inflatable boat (RIB) bound for fjords and spectacular waterfalls beyond Hellsylt. Sample single malt whisky at a Kirkwall distillery and ride past windswept meadows and neolithic monoliths to the shadowy recesses of 5,000-year-old Skara Brae.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Norwegian Fjords and Scottish Isles

items.title: Endless Days In Norway
items.journeyText: Journey from Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland to Copenhagen on Star Explorer 10 Days Jun 19 – Jun 29, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: More than a thousand fjords lace the west coast of Norway, carved by glaciers and filled by the Norwegian Sea. One of the world’s natural wonders, Geirangerfjord and Sognefjord are stunning from every angle — from the top of Lysefjord’s anvil-shaped Pulpit Rock, from the Flam Railway as it winds through the mountains and past waterfalls high above Aurlandsfjord, and from the fjords themselves as you cruise on your boutique ship. Tiny hill farms, half-timbered houses, and stave churches pass by, leading the way to the Art Nouveau architecture of Alesund, the colorful Hanseatic pier in Bergen, and sights too beautiful to imagine.
items.tourOgTitle: Endless Days In Norway

items.title: Star Collector: Scandinavian and Baltic Delights
items.journeyText: Journey from Leith, Edinburgh, Scotland to Helsinki on Star Explorer 18 Days Jun 19 – Jul 07, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Drift into fjords and past Baltic coastlines on a sailing across Northern Europe. Sip hot kaffe with waffles and relax amid the furnishings of a Norwegian family home . Ride mountain bikes from the crest of Mount Fløyen through an emerald forest to placid lakes and sweeping views of the city of Bergen. Step aboard turn-of-the-century mechanized rides and snack on decadent chocolate treats at Copenhagen's Tivoli Gardens--one of Europe's oldest amusement parks. Glide past Gdansk's thriving waterfront on a guided kayak tour. Indulge in smoked fish and Lithuanian beer with friendly Klaipeda locals. Walk around the ornate Swedish sailing ship Vasa in Stockholm, the oldest fully preserved ship in the world.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Scandinavian and Baltic Delights

items.title: Yachtsman's Dreams of the Riviera
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 11 Days Jun 24 – Jul 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Spend blissful days and invigorating evenings sailing between small Iberian ports and scenic coves throughout the romantic Riviera during this eleven-day Mediterranean voyage. Dip a kayak blade into Menorca's warm waters, a pristine UNESCO Biosphere Reserve rich in solitude, sea birds, and scenic caves. Admire Fauvist creations by expressionist artists Matisse and Derain in the placid seaside village of Collioure. Sample local wines paired with a farm-to-table lunch at a Spanish estate near Palamos. Take in harbor views above Monte Carlo at the Palace of Monaco or in Sanary-sur-Mer. Venture to Napoleon's former summer home on Elba. Sip hearty Tuscan wines matched to authentic Italian dishes in uncrowded cafes near Portoferraio's weathered Old Port alleys and plazas.
items.tourOgTitle: Yachtsman's Dreams of the Riviera

items.title: Star Collector: Spectacular Spanish & Italian Coastlines Along the Riviera
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 21 Days Jun 24 – Jul 15, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Set out on three unforgettable weeks of discovery across the western Mediterranean, where medieval fortresses, sun-warmed beaches, vibrant markets, and little-known harbors invite you to explore and uncover the stories of each destination. Wander through the 2,000-year-old Roman ruins of Pollentia on Mallorca, then sip sangria along the shoreline. Admire the finishing touches to Gaudí’s ornate Sagrada Familia cathedral in Barcelona before savoring tapas and wine. Experience France’s southern coast, from the pastel harbors of Sanary-sur-Mer to glamorous Cannes and picturesque Port-Vendres, each offering a different glimpse into Provençal life. Along the way, circumnavigate Sicily with calls at four unique ports—Trapani, Porto Empedocle, Syracuse, and Palermo—where Greek temples, Norman cathedrals, lively markets, and rustic trattorias showcase the island’s rich blend of history and culture.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Spectacular Spanish & Italian Coastlines Along the Riviera

items.title: Quick Getaways: Balearic Islands and Port Vendres Escape
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Barcelona on Star Legend 4 Days Jun 24 – Jun 28, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail roundtrip from vibrant Barcelona on a voyage that celebrates the best of Spain and southern France. Explore Alcudia, Mallorca, where golden beaches meet medieval streets steeped in history. Discover Mahón,l Menorca’s laid-back capital with its impressive harbor and lively markets. In France, wander the charming fishing port of Port-Vendres, gateway to Catalan culture, seaside cafés, and coastal walks. You'll enjoy leisurely days ashore and a taste of the intimacy small-ship cruising offers in just a few short days.
items.tourOgTitle: Quick Getaways: Balearic Islands and Port Vendres Escape

items.title: Star Collector: Adriatic Odyssey
items.journeyText: Journey from Dubrovnik to Dubrovnik on Wind Spirit 14 Days Jun 25 – Jul 09, 2027 14 Days Aug 31 – Sep 14, 2027 14 Days Sep 14 – Sep 28, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Spend your summer exploring charming Old Towns and idyllic islands in the Adriatic, from small ship-only ports to the stunning natural beauty of the Dalmatian Riviera. Search for “Lions of St. Mark’s” in towns like Rovinj and Trogir, where Venetian bas-reliefs still watch from stone gates and clock towers. Admire dazzling Byzantine mosaics in Ravenna, a treasure trove of art and history with eight UNESCO World Heritage sites. Don’t miss the jewel-box Mausoleum of Galla Placidia, famous for its deep blue ceiling of golden stars. Cruise past lush pine forests, hidden waterfalls, and limestone cliffs as we sail the Croatian coast. Marvel at Kotor’s dramatic fjord and approach Dubrovnik’s towering walls. Taste Dalmatian prosciutto, handmade pastas, Istria’s truffles, and Slovenia’s nutty potica in unforgettable settings.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Adriatic Odyssey

items.title: Star Collector: Cruising on the Rivieras
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 17 Days Jun 28 – Jul 15, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge in unhurried pleasures among steep coastal cliffs, tiny vineyards and romantic villages throughout the Rivieras and Western Italy during this 17-day cruise. During the fall winemakers are racking fresh wine into barrels, and new olive oils are sampled for the first time. Stroll uncrowded avenues and discover fresh, distinctly nutty porcini mushrooms served fresh on pastas and sautéed into tapas at sidewalk cafés, browse open markets and inhale the fall aromas from ripe apples, plump grapes and early season citrus. Test your luck in a Monte Carlo casino, hike the desolate Crateri Silvestri on the southeast slope of Sicily’s Mount Etna, and learn about Malta’s noble heritage inside the precipitous medieval walls of 4,000-year-old Mdina — The Silent City.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Cruising on the Rivieras

items.title: Lands of the Midnight Sun
items.journeyText: Journey from Copenhagen to Reykjavik on Star Pride 10 Days Jun 28 – Jul 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Cruise beneath the Midnight Sun to sparkling Norwegian fjords, steaming Icelandic geysers, ancient Scottish standing stones, and the bucolic Faroe Islands. Hear the echoes of Old Norse tongues, see lands once lauded in ancient Viking sagas, and witness sights that will stir your soul. As a guest of Windstar, you experience it all from a uniquely thrilling perspective.
items.tourOgTitle: Lands of the Midnight Sun

items.title: Star Collector: Endless Days of the North Sea & Iceland
items.journeyText: Journey from Copenhagen to Reykjavik on Star Pride 17 Days Jun 28 – Jul 15, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Explore the finest small ports in Scotland, Norway, and the Faroe Islands (Denmark) before circumnavigating Iceland on this 17-day summertime adventure. Cover the shorelines of Scotland and Norway, stopping off to see Denmark’s Faroe Islands. Explore Iceland’s majestic fjords, imposing volcanoes and remote rocky reaches. Discover the challenges faced by Iron Age communities near Kirkwall, Scotland, sample almond ring cake and other Norwegian culinary delights at a historic farm near Bergen, Norway, and kayak among sea birds and urban artistry in Alesund, Norway. Iceland excursions include flights above waterfalls and volcanoes on Heimaey Island, detailed archaeological examinations of a medieval farm near Seydisfjordur, and relaxing moments immersed in the natural geothermal waters of the Myvatn Nature Baths outside Akureyri.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Endless Days of the North Sea & Iceland

items.title: Star Collector: Islands of a Mediterranean Summer: Sicily, Sardinia, & Corsica
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 16 Days Jul 05 – Jul 21, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail between Corsican coastlines, Sicilian splendors, and time-honored Sardinian dishes during this 16-night cruise along Italy's western and southern coastlines. Watch glowing lava reflect off volcanic steam during a scenic evening cruise around smoldering Stomboli. Snorkel above colorful fish off the coast of Lipari, the largest of the remote Aeolian Islands. Learn the techniques and key ingredients essential for preparing authentic Sicilian cuisine from a skilled chef near Trapani. Wander quiet, narrow cobbled lanes winding throughout the heights of Bonifacio, a towering walled Medieval town with sweeping seaside views of the Corsican coastline. Venture beyond the ancient outskirts of Alghero and meet a local shepherd who teaches you traditional techniques for transforming sheep's milk into tart and tasty Sardinian pecorino cheese--a revered 5,000-year-old culinary tradition.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Islands of a Mediterranean Summer: Sicily, Sardinia, & Corsica

items.title: Star Collector: Corsica, Sardinia & Amalfi Memories
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 13 Days Jul 15 – Jul 28, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail to Italian islands with unique cultural heritage, and to small resort-style ports popular with well-heeled but laid-back Europeans. Rocky coves and vivid blue waters make these islands worth visiting. Enjoy the view as you approach the tall limestone cliffs supporting the medieval town of Bonifacio on Corsica, cruise past Stromboli Volcano, and call at the mainland port of Amalfi where the coastal scenery is literally legendary. Explore all this beauty with activities ranging from dolphin watching to kayaking to bicycling on the bucolic island of Lipari. You’ll find an abundance of history and culture to boot, from Bronze Age ruins to Napoleon’s Corsican legacy, and artsy seaside towns like Sardinia’s Bosa, where colorful houses catch the eye, and the 12th-century castle is almost an afterthought. Enjoy after-hours treats from illuminated fortresses to artisanal sunsets in Alghero.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Corsica, Sardinia & Amalfi Memories

items.title: Treasure Troves of Corsica & Sardinia
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 6 Days Jul 15 – Jul 21, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Rustic pastas garnished with regional sheep cheeses and hearty red wines enhance the cultural flavors of this seven-day Sardinia cruise. Visit popular Italian vacation spots that are destinations rich in unhurried authenticity. Venture inland from Bastia to the tiny, terraced village of Oletta and sample family-owned Corsican wines in the shade of olive and chestnut groves. Relax in the quiet solitude of an Ajaccio beach or nibble on dried hams, colorful olives, and succulent fruits at the daily morning market at Corsica's coastal capital. Learn about Alghero's Catalan origins and Gothic architecture, then linger late into the evening over plates of decadent Sardinian pasta flavored with local pecorino romano cheeses during an overnight port stay. Shop for handcrafted Sardinian ceramics and leather bags or relax with beachside refreshments among locals in the tiny port of Golfo Aranci.
items.tourOgTitle: Treasure Troves of Corsica & Sardinia

items.title: Adriatic Shores & Italian Coasts
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Civitavecchia, Rome on Wind Spirit 12 Days Jul 16 – Jul 28, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin in Venice and trace the Adriatic south through Croatia and Montenegro, calling on ports rich in history and coastal scenery. Explore Rovinj’s old town, walk through Split within the walls of Diocletian’s Palace, and spend time in Dubrovnik’s historic center before sailing into Montenegro’s Bay of Kotor for scenic cruising and access to hilltop views. The route then turns west to Sicily, with Messina serving as a gateway to Taormina and its ancient theater, followed by the Amalfi Coast and an overnight in Sorrento that allows time for Pompeii, Capri, or evening dining ashore. From Italy, the journey continues to Corsica, where Bonifacio’s clifftop citadel overlooks the sea, and on to Sardinia’s Golfo Aranci for swimming and coastal scenery.
items.tourOgTitle: Adriatic Shores & Italian Coasts

items.title: Italy and the Allure of the Aeolian Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 7 Days Jul 21 – Jul 28, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Scenic vineyards, dizzying Amalfi coastal vistas, timeless village piazzas, and ancient Roman ruins make perfect backdrops for this cruise along Italy's coast to the isles of Corsica and Sardinia. Relax on a sandy beach outside Ponza or escape on a boat tour to the clear turquoise waters and sundrenched shorelines punctuated by shadowy coastal grottos. Sip the sweetness of local Amalfi limoncello and tour the haunting ruins of Pompeii. Cycle past geologic wonders on Lipari - the largest and most storied of the seven Aeolian isles - then pause at an Italian hamlet for liquid refreshments and light bites. Luxuriate along the Emerald Coast near Porto Cervo, Sardinia's luxurious enclave for reclusive yacht owners and Europe's most expensive real estate. Inspect the dramatic vistas of Bonifacio, Corsica's oldest settlement known for its cliffs, medieval citadel, and stunning coastal views.
items.tourOgTitle: Italy and the Allure of the Aeolian Islands

items.title: Alaskan Explorations & Denali Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Vancouver, Bc on Star Seeker 15 Days Jul 23 – Aug 07, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Awaken and inspire your sense of adventure as you sail north through Canada’s Inside Passage, visiting the Alaskan towns of Wrangell and Haines. A journey through stunning landscapes, rich history, and unique wildlife. Admire the glaciated slopes and ice floes of Alaska’s Misty Fjords, Tracy Arm and Kenai Fjords, but keep a weather eye on the horizon for the telltale spray and black fins of orca pods. Disembark in Seward and ride inland to Fairbanks and scenic Denali National Park. Caribou, foxes and Dall sheep observations are nearly certain, but even the locals grow excited about grizzly and wolf pack sightings. A detailed float along the Chena River provides additional opportunities for ursine encounters prior to your transfer to Fairbanks Airport and your reentry into the predictabilities of a less-adventurous modern civilization.
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Explorations & Denali Cruise Tour

items.title: Alaskan Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Vancouver, Bc on Star Seeker 11 Days Jul 27 – Aug 07, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
"Conde Nast Traveler 2019 Hot List ""As far as Alaskan expeditions go, this itinerary gives passengers more access to so many aspects of the state's culture than any competitor.""  - Conde Nast Traveler 
Witness the grandeur of Alaska’s premier glaciers: Mendenhall in Juneau, Kenai Fjords’ Harding Icefield, Tracy Arm’s twin Sawyer Glaciers. Discover Alaskan Native villages, Russian cathedrals, and Gold Rush history. Thrill as you watch a wild brown bear snatch a struggling salmon from a stream or a humpback whale breach off the bow. Cruise Misty Fjords and Kenai Fjords on your lovely all-suite ship, waters beyond the reach of larger Alaska cruise ships."
items.tourOgTitle: Alaskan Splendors

items.title: Total Solar Eclipse from Greece and Malta
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Piraeus, Athens on Wind Surf 9 Days Jul 27 – Aug 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the awe of a total solar eclipse, lasting approximately 3 minutes, from a prime viewing position near Malta—the centerpiece of this extraordinary Mediterranean voyage. Along the way, you’ll uncover hidden gems and smaller ports, from Monemvasia, Greece’s “Gibraltar of the East,” to the Peloponnesian harbor of Gythion. Sail the shores of Sicily with visits to Syracuse and the vibrant western town of Trapani, then continue to Malta for golden Valletta and the quiet charm of Gozo. With convenient roundtrip embarkation and debarkation in Athens, this journey blends rare celestial wonder with authentic local escapes steeped in history and beauty.
items.tourOgTitle: Total Solar Eclipse from Greece and Malta

items.title: Star Collector: Songs of Sicily & Southern Italy via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 15 Days Aug 05 – Aug 20, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Circle Sicily and browse stunning Italian coastlines, authentic Puglian towns, enchanting Greek islands, and iconic ruins. Cross the Corinth Canal, a historic channel only wide enough for small ships like ours. Encounter restless volcanoes from Mt. Vesuvius to Mt. Etna to nighttime cruising past Stromboli, tears of glowing lava often streaming down its face. Walk in the footsteps of the past at Pompeii, the Oracle’s shrine in Delphi, the Valley of the Temples in Porto Empedocle, and Valetta’s cathedral. Discover Puglia’s Greek heritage in relaxed, authentic ports like Gallipoli and Reggio Calabria, and gaze in awe at the giant Greek theater in ancient Syracuse, a venue the size of the Hollywood Bowl hewn by hand from the pale limestone. From street food to wine tastings, Greek ruins to Rome’s incredible wealth of antiquities, this voyage makes every day one to savor.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Songs of Sicily & Southern Italy via the Corinth Canal

items.title: Moments in Southern Italy & Greece via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 6 Days Aug 05 – Aug 11, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Savor extra time to soak up sun-kissed Italian beaches, stroll through charming vineyards, and savor local cuisine with a shortcut through the Corinth Canal—a passage reserved for small ships like ours. Wander the imposing fortifications and archeological revelations of the 15th century Castello Aragonese, then explore countless ancient Greek and Roman relics at a Taranto museum. Drift silently on a small boat into the turquoise glow of Sicily's famous Blue Grotto. Taste rich red wines adjacent to flourishing vineyards growing on the slopes of Mount Etna above Giardini Naxos. Check cruise dates for additional days, stops, and excursions, including the Temple of Apollo in the ruins of Delphi, a speedboat getaway from Fiskardo to remote Kephalonia beaches, and a stop at the walled town of Italy's Gallipoli, where you can master fine dining details of Puglia's cuisine from an expert chef.
items.tourOgTitle: Moments in Southern Italy & Greece via the Corinth Canal

items.title: Star Collector: Captivating Coastlines of Croatia & Italy
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Dubrovnik on Wind Spirit 13 Days Aug 07 – Aug 20, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Beauty surrounds you on this voyage through Southern Italy and the Croatian Adriatic—colorful cliffside villages, enchanting canals, and turquoise waterfalls rushing through pine forests. Sip limoncello in Amalfi, admire Vibo Valentia’s Coast of the Gods, and stand in awe of Reggio Calabria’s ancient bronze warriors. Overnight in Taranto for famous mussels and views of the Aragonese Castle lit at night. In Rovinj, centuries of Venetian rule have blended cultures and flavors. Listen to Zadar’s sea organ echoing the rhythm of the waves, and fall in love with riviera towns and islands that capture your heart.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Captivating Coastlines of Croatia & Italy

items.title: Star Collector: The “Sole” of Italy & Coast of Croatia
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Venice on Wind Spirit 20 Days Aug 07 – Aug 27, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Spend 20 nights exploring the Adriatic and Ionian Seas, soaking in Southern Italy’s charm and Croatia’s breathtaking coastline. Discover Amalfi’s stunning blend of nature and architecture, stroll seafront promenades in laid-back villages, and savor Calabria’s famous Tartufo di Pizzo. Overnight in Taranto, gateway to Baroque Lecce and Alberobello’s whimsical trulli huts. Then sail into Croatia’s magic—historic walled cities, Istrian fishing villages, and Venice’s timeless allure. In Rovinj, find Italian influences in every bite and building. Wander the medieval streets of Šibenik, discover Habsburg-era elegance in Opatija, and explore Roman and Venetian landmarks in charming Poreč. From off the beaten path Croatia to Kotor’s bay, every stop tells a different story.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: The “Sole” of Italy & Coast of Croatia

items.title: Sicilian Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Civitavecchia, Rome on Star Legend 9 Days Aug 11 – Aug 20, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Encircle the Isle of Sicily and discover sparkling resorts favored by emperors, towns frozen in time by legendary volcanoes, Maltese palaces where knights and Grand Masters once gathered … this itinerary has them all. Watch the stunning Amalfi Coast pass by from the deck of your intimate ship and raise a glass of limoncello to another blissful day in the warm Mediterranean sunshine.
items.tourOgTitle: Sicilian Splendors

items.title: Star Collector: Irish Stout to Bordeaux Wine: A Tour of Ireland and France
items.journeyText: Journey from Dun Laoghaire, Dublin to Bordeaux on Star Explorer 18 Days Aug 12 – Aug 30, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Irish dancing, twinkling Parisian lights and sublime French wines enhance your tasteful cultural immersion throughout this sailing around Ireland and along the French coastline. Explore Ireland's Inishowen Peninsula, a natural encapsulation of Emerald Isle habitats, and wander sandy coastal reaches and cobbled village lanes prior to tea and local treats at a village beyond Londonderry. Take a stroll around St. Mary's quay to the formidable Star Castle, a 1593 fortification built to reinforce England. Spend two exceptional days in Paris visiting the Louvre Museum, Versailles and Notre-Dame during your extended port stay at Rouen. Venture inland from the coastal town of Lorient for Breton tea time with the Duchess of Rohan amid Josselin Castle's tasteful elegance. Unwind over exceptional glasses of blended red wines and fine French cuisine during an overnight Bordeaux port stay.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Irish Stout to Bordeaux Wine: A Tour of Ireland and France

items.title: Iconic & Hidden Croatia
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Venice on Wind Spirit 11 Days Aug 16 – Aug 27, 2027 11 Days Aug 27 – Sep 07, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the Croatian coast from tiny fishing villages to medieval marvels like Dubrovnik. This itinerary is ideal for those who enjoy exploring on foot, with an abundance of compact, pedestrian-only old towns and seafront promenades. Follow Roman street layouts past Venetian buildings, find quiet pebble beaches washed by the Adriatic’s turquoise waters, and head to national parks where waterfalls pour over travertine terraces. Check off UNESCO wonders like the history-laden streets of Dubrovnik and Split’s Diocletian’s Palace, savor Dalmatian prosciutto in Sibenik, and cross the Adriatic to Italy’s Puglia region. All this plus two of the most spectacular port approaches you’ll find, sailing directly through the Giudecca Canal to Venice, passing by St. Mark’s Square and the Doge’s Palace (a route exclusively for small ships like ours), and cruising the striking Bay of Kotor.
items.tourOgTitle: Iconic & Hidden Croatia

items.title: Quick Getaways: Croatia Calling
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Dubrovnik on Wind Spirit 4 Days Aug 16 – Aug 20, 2027 4 Days Aug 27 – Aug 31, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on the perfect brief getaway or add an Adriatic exploration to your European vacation plans with this memorable four-day sailing from Venice to the most iconic and romantic ports in Croatia. Roll into the countryside beyond Rovinj on a cycling tour tracing the Parenzana Trail--a former Hapsburg Empire railroad line curving through rustic villages, dense forests, and weathered tunnels. Relax aboard a sailboat outbound from Zadar to the tiny island of Ugljan, where you'll swim, snorkel, sunbathe, and later savor local cheeses, savory meats and fresh local fruits. Admire garden views and the Hvar landscape during an authentic traditional brunch at an Old World family estate. Wander the cobblestone alleys of Dubrovnik's Old Town, or dip a kayak blade into the calm waters off scenic Lokrum Island as you follow your guide to caves and the crumbling remains of a nearly forgotten monastery.
items.tourOgTitle: Quick Getaways: Croatia Calling

items.title: Star Collector: The Cook Islands & Forever French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 17 Days Aug 19 – Sep 05, 2027 17 Days Aug 31 – Sep 17, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Slip beneath gentle waves to ethereal coral outcroppings teeming with vibrant fish and curious sea turtles while snorkeling and guided diving excursions off Moorea's emerald shores. Wander the pristine shores of Aitutaki, home to one of the world’s most breathtaking lagoons, where turquoise waters lap against powdery white sand. Explore Rarotonga’s lush mountain trails and bustling markets, where Polynesian culture thrives in vibrant dance, music, and crafts. Immerse yourself in the rich seafaring traditions of the Cook Islands, where stories of ancient Polynesian navigation come to life through local history and legend.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: The Cook Islands & Forever French Polynesia

items.title: Moments in Southern Italy & Greece via the Corinth Canal
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Piraeus, Athens on Star Legend 11 Days Aug 20 – Aug 31, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Savor extra time to soak up sun-kissed Italian beaches, stroll through charming vineyards, and savor local cuisine with a shortcut through the Corinth Canal—a passage reserved for small ships like ours. Wander the imposing fortifications and archeological revelations of the 15th century Castello Aragonese, then explore countless ancient Greek and Roman relics at a Taranto museum. Drift silently on a small boat into the turquoise glow of Sicily's famous Blue Grotto. Taste rich red wines adjacent to flourishing vineyards growing on the slopes of Mount Etna above Giardini Naxos. Check cruise dates for additional days, stops, and excursions, including the Temple of Apollo in the ruins of Delphi, a speedboat getaway from Fiskardo to remote Kephalonia beaches, and a stop at the walled town of Italy's Gallipoli, where you can master fine dining details of Puglia's cuisine from an expert chef.
items.tourOgTitle: Moments in Southern Italy & Greece via the Corinth Canal

items.title: Star Collector: Southern Italy & Northern Greece Odyssey
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Piraeus, Athens on Star Legend 19 Days Aug 20 – Sep 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Set sail for hidden havens and Western Civilization's ancient epicenters during this 19-night cruise to idyllic small ports and iconic destinations throughout Italy, Greece and Türkiye. Delve into Pompeii's silent ruins beneath brooding Mount Vesuvius. Cook up Maltese meals under the guidance of a skilled professional chef on the outskirts of historic Valetta. Glide in the glowing azure light of the famed Blue Grotto near Giardini Naxos. Visit the Sanctuary of Apollo--the sacred home of the Oracle Pythia and the epicenter of Greece's Golden Age. Walk in the footsteps of Europe's earliest merchant seafarers in Ephesus. Wander Skopelos' narrow village lanes as you ascend to the hilltop ruins of a Venetian castle overlooking this tiny port.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Southern Italy & Northern Greece Odyssey
