items.title: Star Collector: Alaska Discovery & Pacific Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Sapporo / Otaru, Hokkaido on Star Seeker 24 Days Aug 21 – Sep 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription:
"
Discover why Alaska is a top cruise destination as you explore its wildlife, frontier towns, native culture, and fjordland scenery, then unwind during a trans-Pacific crossing to Tokyo. This voyage is tailored to your vacation dreams. Experience Alaska’s beauty with Zodiac trips in Kenai Fjords and Tracy Arm, a ride on the White Pass Railroad, and flightseeing over glaciers. Immerse yourself in native culture with a Master Totem Carver in Ketchikan and a visit to Klukwan. Spot black and brown bears, eagles, whales, sea lions, mountain goats, and more from platforms, float trips, or your balcony. After your Alaska adventure, relax and find your favorite spots onboard as you sail to vibrant Tokyo."
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Alaska Discovery & Pacific Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Alaskan Frontiers & Japan’s Hidden Mysteries
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker 35 Days Aug 21 – Sep 25, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Vancouver through the wilderness of Alaska, visiting ports like Ketchikan, known for its Native heritage, Juneau, gateway to Mendenhall Glacier, and Sitka, where Russian and Tlingit history meet. Cruising highlights include Tracy Arm and Kenai Fjords, where you can venture on Signature Expeditions with Zodiacs launching directly from Star Seeker. Embark on a transpacific crossing that offers 11 unhurried sea days. Your arrival in Japan brings you first to Sapporo, where Hokkaido’s rugged landscapes create a dynamic introduction. From there, the voyage transforms into a mystery cruise, where ports are revealed 36 hours before arrival—reminding you that it’s not only about where you’re going, but who you’re sailing with; let Windstar be your trusted guide as you uncover new-to-Windstar ports and small-ship exclusives before concluding in Osaka, gateway to Kyoto’s timeless temples.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Alaskan Frontiers & Japan’s Hidden Mysteries

items.title: Star Collector: Alaskan Wonders & Japanese Mysteries
items.journeyText: Journey from Vancouver, Bc to Tokyo on Star Seeker 45 Days Aug 21 – Oct 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Vancouver through the rugged wilds of Alaska, sailing to Ketchikan, Juneau, and Sitka, before venturing across the Pacific on a stretch of 11 sea days, the perfect opportunity. Your arrival in Japan marks the beginning of the mystery cruise segment, where ports are revealed just 36 hours in advance, adding a thrilling element of surprise. But it’s not only about where you’re going—it’s about who you’re sailing with, and with Windstar as your trusted guide, every mystery becomes part of a shared adventure. After your mystery cruise segment, discover both hidden gems and iconic destinations such as Osaka, Hiroshima, and Tokyo. Small-ship access allows for immersive exploration of tucked-away harbors like Tomonoura, while still delivering the grandeur of major cities like Osaka and Tokyo.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Alaskan Wonders & Japanese Mysteries

items.title: Star Collector: Palates & Palettes of Northern Spain and France
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Lisbon on Star Explorer 16 Days Aug 22 – Sep 07, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Impressionist artists like Monet and Renoir spent a lifetime trying to capture the beauty and soul of western France. It took Julia Child just one meal in Normandy to fall in love with French cuisine. Be won over on this sensory journey to Northern Spain and France. Follow the Comino to the cathedral at Santiago de Compostela, a pilgrimage site for a thousand years. Sip cider in Gijon at the heart of “Green Spain,” a place even many Spaniards are unfamiliar with. Treat your palate to Basque cuisine. You’ll see hills covered in vineyards and chateaux in Bordeaux, Monet’s famous water lilies in Giverny, Mont St. Michel abbey perched on a tiny island like a wedding cake ornament, and as many Parisian wonders as you can absorb with a two-night stay in Rouen. Delicious. Moving. Awe-inspiring. This voyage is all that and more.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Palates & Palettes of Northern Spain and France

items.title: Star Collector: French Elegance and Spanish Flair
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Barcelona on Star Explorer 24 Days Aug 22 – Sep 15, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Uncover a wealth of treasures on a remarkable voyage from Paris, France to Barcelona, Spain, enriched by multiple overnight port stays. Your journey begins with an overnight stay in Rouen, offering time to explore Paris's iconic landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the charming Montmartre district. From there, sail down the western coast of France, where four days among Bordeaux's vineyards await, providing a perfect opportunity for exploration and wine tasting. In St. Malo, walk along the medieval fortifications, delving into the city's storied maritime past. As the cruise continues through the Iberian Peninsula, experience Bilbao, renowned for its contemporary art and architecture. In Seville, marvel at the grandeur of the Alcázar and soak in the vibrant-historic city. The adventure extends to Tangier, where the exotic charm of Moroccan souks and promise a truly immersive experience.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: French Elegance and Spanish Flair

items.title: French Feast: Normandy, Brittany & Aquitaine
items.journeyText: Journey from Paris/Rouen to Bordeaux on Star Explorer 8 Days Aug 22 – Aug 30, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This comprehensive exploration of France includes an overnight in Rouen (Paris), and visits the Normandy, Brittany, and Aquitaine regions of France. Treat your palate to fine wines in Bordeaux and cider in Brittany. Taste regional specialties like Cancale oysters and Breton galettes. And feast your eyes on timeless scenery: the abbey on Mont St. Michel, St. Malo’s pink sandstone cliffs, Monet’s garden in Giverny where water lilies still have the power to inspire. See iconic sights like the Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame. And write your own adventures as you hike the unspoiled wild Breton coast.
items.tourOgTitle: French Feast: Normandy, Brittany & Aquitaine

items.title: Star Collector: Iberian Charms & Splendors
items.journeyText: Journey from Bordeaux to Barcelona on Star Explorer 16 Days Aug 30 – Sep 15, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin your voyage in Bordeaux, France, visiting picturesque destinations on your way to Barcelona, Spain.  An overnight stay in Bordeaux allows you to savor world-renowned wines. Sail on to Bilbao, Spain, and enjoy another overnight. Continue to Gijon, Spain, known for its maritime heritage, before heading to Vigo, Spain. Discover the charm of Porto, Portugal, with its riverside vistas. In Lisbon, Portugal, experience an overnight stay that lets you wander through the narrow streets of Alfama. Next, sail to Seville, Spain, where an overnight stay allows time to explore the grand Seville Cathedral. Cross over to Tangier, Morocco, where the vibrant souks offer a taste of Moroccan charm. Continue to Malaga, Spain, birthplace of Picasso. In Cartagena, uncover Roman ruins. Valencia, with its futuristic City of Arts and Sciences, is the next stop before concluding your journey in Barcelona.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Iberian Charms & Splendors

items.title: Ocean Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Sapporo / Otaru, Hokkaido on Star Seeker 13 Days Sep 01 – Sep 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge yourself in leisurely, unscheduled days where time suspends in the magic of the sea. Sleep late. Dine early. Establish your own rhythm in sync with the waves and the arc of the sun and moon overhead. Watch the constellations drift and let your mind shake off all the cobwebs of shore. Feast on the impossible beauty of liquid sunsets, and let your soul dance with the dolphins in the spray off the bow.
items.tourOgTitle: Ocean Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Pacific Horizons & Japanese Mysteries
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker 24 Days Sep 01 – Sep 25, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Let Windstar be your guide on a journey that blends the anticipation of crossing the Pacific with the ports kept secret. During your days at sea, take time to explore Star Seeker, our newest yacht, and enjoy the unique opportunities onboard — from wellness treatments at the World Spa by Windstar to gourmet dining options with dishes created by James Beard Foundation award winning chefs. Guests are invited to visit the Open Bridge, where you can engage with officers and learn about navigation firsthand. Once you arrive in Japan, the mystery begins: ten ports revealed only 36 hours in advance, some completely new to Windstar. The adventure concludes in vibrant Osaka, a city alive with food culture, history, and easy access to Kyoto’s temples and gardens.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Pacific Horizons & Japanese Mysteries

items.title: Star Collector: Mysteries & Masterpieces of Japan & South Korea
items.journeyText: Journey from Seward, Anchorage, Alaska to Tokyo on Star Seeker 34 Days Sep 01 – Oct 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Step aboard Star Seeker for a one-of-a-kind adventure that combines the thrill of the unknown with the joy of discovery. Your voyage begins in northern Japan with 10 days of mystery, each port revealed just 36 hours before arrival. Will it be a fishing village tucked along rugged coastlines, a hidden cultural gem, or a new-to-Windstar harbor? After this intiail intrigue, the curtain rises to reveal an unforgettable lineup of destinations: Osaka, Takamatsu, Hiroshima, Nagasaki and more — plus scenic cruising through the Seto Inland Sea and past haunting Hashima Island. You’ll even cross into South Korea for a stop in Busan.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Mysteries & Masterpieces of Japan & South Korea

items.title: Star Collector: Iberian Nights & Adriatic Delights
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Venice on Star Explorer 24 Days Sep 07 – Oct 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Lisbon to Rovinj on an extraordinary journey where boutique ports and storied cities reveal the heart of the Mediterranean. Overnight stays in Lisbon and Seville provide time to savor their vibrant culture, cuisine, and nightlife. Along Spain’s coast, discover Marbella’s chic Puerto Banús, Cartagena’s Roman history, and Valencia’s lively blend of tradition and innovation. The French Riviera unfolds through smaller gems like Port-Vendres and Sanary-sur-Mer, balanced by the glitz of Monte Carlo and Cannes. Continue to Italy’s Portofino and Portoferraio before sailing into the Adriatic for Kotor’s fjord-like beauty and Croatia’s medieval treasures in Dubrovnik, Split, and Rovinj.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Iberian Nights & Adriatic Delights

items.title: 2027 Japan Mystery Cruise
items.journeyText: Journey from Sapporo / Otaru, Hokkaido to Osaka, Kyoto on Star Seeker 11 Days Sep 14 – Sep 25, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the thrill of the unknown on a Mystery Cruise aboard our newest yacht, 224-guest Star Seeker, beginning in Hokkaido, Japan’s wild northern frontier. Each destination will be revealed just 36 hours before arrival, giving you the chance to uncover hidden gems across Japan and South Korea, including less-visited ports brand-new to Windstar. Your adventure concludes in vibrant Osaka, the gateway to Kyoto, after days of surprise, discovery, and unforgettable moments. A journey with Windstar isn’t just about where you’re going—it’s about who you’re sailing with. When you cruise with us, you become part of the Windstar family, embraced with warm hospitality and thoughtful service at every turn, ensuring that every mystery feels like coming home. Don’t miss this one-of-a-kind adventure!
items.tourOgTitle: 2027 Japan Mystery Cruise

items.title: Star Collector: Italian Trio
items.journeyText: Journey from Barcelona to Venice on Star Explorer 16 Days Sep 15 – Oct 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the culture, history and cuisine on both sides of the Italian peninsula during this 15-day cruise of the Adriatic, Ionian, Ligurian and Tyrrhenian seas. This back-to-back cruise is ideal for optimizing shore excursion time in Italy, Croatia, Montenegro, Monaco, France and Spain. Stroll through Roman ruins in Rovinj, Croatia, sample olives and smoked hams at a centuries-old family farm in Montenegro, or savor an unforgettably romantic evening dinner at Château Eza in Èze 1,400 feet above the beaches of the French Riviera.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Italian Trio

items.title: Star Collector: Eternal Greece
items.journeyText: Journey from Istanbul to Piraeus, Athens on Star Legend 16 Days Sep 16 – Oct 02, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark through Greece and Turkey, exploring less visited ports and experiencing the beauty of the Greek Isles. Sail to Kusadasi, home of the ancient Greek city of Ephesus. Continue through the Aegean Sea to Kavala, known for beaches, local cuisine, and historic sites. In Thessaloniki, explore the city’s landmarks or visit the Museum of the Royal Tombs, a UNESCO site. In Volos, take an excursion to the Meteora Byzantine Monasteries. On Skopelos, see filming sites from "Mamma Mia!" before heading to the Corinth Canal and Delphi. Visit Santorini's Oia for its iconic, white-washed buildings with blue domes. In Bodrum, explore the Castle, the ancient Mausoleum of Halicarnassus, and the Museum of Underwater Archaeology. Conclude your journey at the Greek islands of Mykonos and Lemnos, then end in Istanbul with tours of the Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, or a guided food tour through the markets.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Eternal Greece

items.title: Star Collector: Fall Leaves & Caribbean Breezes
items.journeyText: Journey from Montreal, Qc to San Juan on Star Pride 21 Days Oct 11 – Nov 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark in Montreal, City of a Hundred Steeples, and overnight in Quebec City, with its UNESCO World Heritage Old Town, to find 400-year-old ramparts filled with history. Enjoy the breathtaking seascapes of Gaspé, waves crashing against limestone cliffs, and watch sugar maples and birch trees flout their fall colors. Retrace the battles for North America in the Fortress of Louisbourg, the UNESCO town of Lunenburg, the Citadel in Halifax, and Boston — where the Freedom Trail leads you to Paul Revere’s house. Then, trade in your autumn palette for Bermuda’s spring colors — blushing pink beaches and turquoise waters. Wander historic forts and UNESCO sites in Bermuda, St. Kitts and San Juan before sailing on to chic St. Bart. Granite boulders form The Baths on Virgin Gorda, perfect for a soak or snorkel. Colorful Old San Juan will keep you busy as you await your flight home.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Fall Leaves & Caribbean Breezes

items.title: Kyoto & the Zen of Japan Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Kobe / Kyoto to Tokyo on Star Seeker 12 Days Oct 13 – Oct 25, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: From the tranquil Zen beauty of Kinkaku-ji Temple to the neon plasma screens and incessant press of pedestrians throughout Tokyo’s Shibuya Station, this tour throughout Japan combines pristine natural beauty with cosmopolitan contrasts. Nibble on the freshest of fish paired with soy sauce and wasabi in the famous Shimizu Fish Market. Meander among East Asian relics and prehistoric stone tools in Busan’s museums, and royal tombs in Gyeongju, one of South Korea’s most famous UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Sip green tea in the peaceful shade of the scenic Ritsurin Garden in Takamatsu, or participate in a formal tea ceremony. Examine Kyoto’s storied Nijo Castle in detail as part of an inland stay, or explore the Zen temple Todai-ji in Nara. This is a perfect journey for those who love Japan, and adventurous travelers who want to go further inland to explore the culture and history of Kyoto.
items.tourOgTitle: Kyoto & the Zen of Japan Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Riches of the Rivieras, Romans, and Greeks
items.journeyText: Journey from Piraeus, Athens to Barcelona on Wind Surf 14 Days Oct 14 – Oct 28, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the Rivera’s most iconic destinations, Italy's picturesque coastline and ancient Greek temples during this Mediterranean cruise. Seek out Cézanne's artistic inspirations amid lush gardens, Roman walls, and stunning St. Sauveur Cathedral in Aix en Provence. Test your luck during a late-night port stay in Monte Carlo. Lace up your shoes for a hike among elegant Italian villas, olive groves, and Medieval ruins high above the cliffs surrounding Portofino. Wander Pompeii's silent baths, theaters and temples in the shadow of Mt. Vesuvius. Take to the skies on a helicopter tour above Messina and the summit of Mount Etna - Europe's highest volcano. Drift into the underground caves of Vlyhada and Alepotrypa during a boat tour of the Dyros Caves outside Gythion. Tour the hidden medieval city of Monemvasia and sample local olive oils drizzled on fresh-baked bread in a shaded olive grove.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Riches of the Rivieras, Romans, and Greeks

items.title: Grand Japan
items.journeyText: Journey from Kobe / Kyoto to Tokyo on Star Seeker 10 Days Oct 15 – Oct 25, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Immerse yourself in Japan’s unique culture — celebrate a respect of order, harmony, and self-development as you embrace new technologies and celebrate ancient traditions. Admire Tokyo’s sparkling skyline bathed in glowing pastel neon lights. Indulge in Takamatsu’s tiny restaurants and generous portions of sizzling chicken, steaming noodle bowls and mysterious seafood pieces shrouded in delectable fried batter. Experience the beauty of Japan’s Inland Sea and join a jostling crowd in an aromatic Shimizu seafood market. This voyage remains one of the most highly personalized and authentic explorations of Japan’s iconic islands at the edge of the Far East.
items.tourOgTitle: Grand Japan

items.title: Star Collector: Enchantment of the Western Med
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Lisbon on Wind Surf 15 Days Oct 21 – Nov 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience the best Western Mediterranean ports in detail during this cruise through Italy, Monaco, France, Spain, Gibraltar, and Portugal. Stroll among opulent casinos, high-end boutiques, and historic Formula One landmarks in Monte Carlo. Sip wormwood-based absinthe in the French village of Antibes outside of Cannes. Or meander among the dusky walls and long shadows in Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, taking in the aromas, sights and sounds of the Catalonian heart of Spain.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Enchantment of the Western Med

items.title: Mind, Body and Spirit Collection: Bermuda Bliss
items.journeyText: Journey from Boston, Ma to San Juan on Star Pride 10 Days Oct 22 – Nov 01, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a wellness voyage with Debbie Dixon, a yoga teacher, life coach and inspirational speaker. Sail from the iconic skyline of Manhattan, absorbing the grandeur of the Statue of Liberty. Once at sea, you’ll have daily chances to rejuvenate your being with meditation, breathwork and yoga — and engage in transformational talks focused on mental, physical and spiritual health, designed to deepen your personal growth. Ashore in Bermuda, you’ll stroll the UNESCO site of St. George’s, as a palette of pastel-colored buildings and azure waters evoke a sense of serenity. Immerse yourself in history, from the imposing silhouette of St. Peter's Church to the architectural marvel of the Town Hall. Refresh yourself with specially crafted elixirs to enhance your wellness journey, or enjoy the juice cleanse and healthy food options available to restart your health through nutritious meals.
items.tourOgTitle: Mind, Body and Spirit Collection: Bermuda Bliss

items.journeyText: Journey from Boston, Ma to San Juan on Star Pride 17 Days Oct 22 – Nov 08, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from the North Atlantic into the heart of the Caribbean on an extended journey shaped by island character and days unrushed at sea. Take advantage of rare overnights in Bermuda’s historic towns before continuing toward San Juan’s timeless fortresses and colorful shoreline. You’ll also have two full days to experience Gustavia and Virgin Gorda, giving you more time to enjoy their beaches, cafés, and sheltered bays. From there, explore quiet anchorages in the Virgin Islands, snorkel pristine bays, and wander small-ship harbors like Jost Van Dyke and Virgin Gorda.

items.journeyText: Journey from Malaga to Santa Cruz De Tenerife on Wind Spirit 20 Days Oct 30 – Nov 19, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Travel from Iberia’s southern shores to Morocco’s medinas and onward to Atlantic islands seldom reached on a single itinerary. An overnight stay in Málaga provide time for Andalusian art and villages, followed by Tangier’s kasbah lanes and another overnight in Marrakesh for souks, gardens, and Berber flavors. Cross to Madeira for an overnight in Funchal, where levada walks, wine tastings, and hillside viewpoints reveal another side of the Atlantic world. Continue to Porto Santo, La Palma, and El Hierro—each offering landscapes that range from volcanic vineyards to forested trails. This extended voyage rewards travelers who value immersive days ashore.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Morocco, Madeira & the Canary Islands

items.title: Kyoto & East Asia Dreams Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Kobe / Kyoto to Halong Bay, Hanoi on Star Seeker 12 Days Nov 02 – Nov 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This unforgettable voyage across East Asia promises to make your dreams come true. Unlock the secrets and ancient beauty of Kyoto with two nights at a 5-star hotel. Discover iconic landmarks, from the Golden Pavilion to the historic Gion district. Spend a day in Nara, a city rich in crafts and cuisine, and home to eight UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Marvel at the awe-inspiring Todai-ji Temple, housing the world’s largest Buddha statue; view Kasuga Shrine, lined with thousands of lanterns; and stroll Nara Park, where sacred deer freely roam. Pass by Osaka Castle before you board your yacht for the sparkling Japanese islands of Amami and Okinawa. Explore Taipei’s temples and enjoy an overnight stay in Hong Kong. Visit breathtaking Halong Bay, where you can tour the captivating scenery aboard a traditional fishing junk, before heading to Hanoi, Vietnam's cultural heart.
items.tourOgTitle: Kyoto & East Asia Dreams Cruise Tour

items.title: East Asian Legends
items.journeyText: Journey from Kobe / Kyoto to Halong Bay, Hanoi on Star Seeker 10 Days Nov 04 – Nov 14, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the diversity of East Asian cultures as you make your way from traditional rural villages to subtropical beaches. On Japan’s Amami Island, instead of sake, you’ll drink kokuto shochu made of brown sugar. And instead of kimonos in vivid colors, you’ll find complex patterns in earth tones made with a mud-dyed technique that’s been in use for 1,300 years. Shop for distinctive and colorful Ryukyu glass in Okinawa, once made from the old bottles discarded by U.S. troops. Explore Ishigaki’s Yaima Village, an open-air museum of preserved Ryukyu-style houses. In Taiwan’s capital, Taipei, browse the National Palace Museum’s massive collection of Chinese art treasures, or head to the old-town market where you’ll find Chinese medicine apothecaries, traditional handicrafts and more. Listen for the noon-day gun on Garden Road, a tradition established by the British in the 1860s.
items.tourOgTitle: East Asian Legends

items.title: Star Collector: Okinawa Days & Mekong Ways
items.journeyText: Journey from Kobe / Kyoto to Bangkok / Klong Toei on Star Seeker 20 Days Nov 04 – Nov 24, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Gorgeous landscapes, complex pasts and delicious cuisines are yours as you explore 22 different ports throughout Japan and Vietnam. See classic icons in mainland Japan with its feudal castles, ancient capitals, forested mountains, and steaming hot springs. Travel south to subtropical Okinawa, with beaches, mangroves, withs its own distinct culture due to its past as part of the Ryukyu Kingdom. You’ll find a similar dichotomy in Vietnam as you travel from the north’s more temperate landscape to the tropical south. Feast your eyes on the karst landscape of Halong Bay, Da Nang’s amazing beaches and Marble Mountains, and historic sites from My Son Sanctuary and Hue to Hoi An, with an optional overland to Angkor Wat. Stops in Taipei, Taiwan, Busan, South Korea, Phnom Penh, Cambodia, and one of Thailand’s most spectacular islands add to an already incredible journey.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Okinawa Days & Mekong Ways

items.title: Star Collector: Wonders of Southern Japan & Southeast Asia
items.journeyText: Journey from Kobe / Kyoto to Phuket on Star Seeker 31 Days Nov 04 – Dec 05, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This month-long voyage will create a lifetime of memories, from pristine rural locales to glimmering neon cities. Step into a watercolor scene: longtail boats cruising the serene waters and karst pillars of Halong Bay, water buffalo tilling verdant rice paddies, vermilion torii guarding Shinto shrines, and magical Thai islands we’ve hand-selected from over 1,400 choices. Expand your culinary horizons with Peranakan fusion food in Malaysia and Singapore, Khmer noodles in Cambodia and Ishigaki’s melt-in-your-mouth beef. Browse the famous night markets during overnight stays in Hong Kong, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City and Singapore. Anchor it all with a better understanding of the past as you visit the National Palace Museum in Taipei, with one of the largest collections of Chinese art in the world, or Hoi An’s Ancient Town, with its beautifully preserved 18th-century merchant houses.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Wonders of Southern Japan & Southeast Asia

items.title: Heart of Hanoi & East Asia Legends Cruise Tour
items.journeyText: Journey from Kobe / Kyoto to Halong Bay, Hanoi on Star Seeker 13 Days Nov 04 – Nov 17, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Embark on a captivating journey from Japan to Vietnam, where each stop reveals a new world of culture and beauty. Sail from Osaka to the lush shores of Amami and Okinawa, known for their subtropical landscapes and pristine beaches. Stay over in Hong Kong, where the Symphony of Lights illuminates the harbor skyline. Revel in the natural beauty and welcoming tranquility of Vietnam’s Halong Bay. Your adventure culminates in Hanoi, where a 5-star hotel provides your luxurious home base to explore the wonders of the city on foot or traditional cyclo. Start your day with a Tai Chi lesson. Savor a tasting tour of world-famous Vietnamese street food. Take in the Old Quarter’s storied past and vibrant night market. Immerse yourself in Vietnam’s artistic heritage with a traditional water puppet show and a visit to Bat Trang Pottery Village to see centuries-old craftsmanship in action.
items.tourOgTitle: Heart of Hanoi & East Asia Legends Cruise Tour

items.title: Star Collector: Iberian Charm, Italian Elegance & Riviera Nights
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Lisbon on Star Legend 15 Days Nov 05 – Nov 20, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail from Portugal’s vibrant capital, Lisbon, with time to explore its historic neighborhoods and lively culture before heading along Spain’s sun-drenched coast. Experience the Andalusian spirit in Cádiz, the dramatic Rock of Gibraltar, and the artistic treasures of Málaga. Discover Almería’s Moorish legacy and Cartagena’s Roman roots before relaxing in Palma de Mallorca’s island charm. Continue to Barcelona, where an overnight stay allows you to savor Gaudí’s architecture and Catalan cuisine, before tracing the French Riviera with time to enjoy Nice’s glamorous seaside. Conclude your voyage with Italy’s treasures—from Genoa’s maritime history and Tuscany’s Renaissance wonders to the Eternal City of Rome.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Iberian Charm, Italian Elegance & Riviera Nights

items.title: Ocean Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Philipsburg, St
items.tourMetaDescription: Indulge yourself in leisurely, unscheduled days where time suspends in the magic of the sea. Sleep late. Dine early. Establish your own rhythm in sync with the waves and the arc of the sun and moon overhead. Watch the constellations drift and let your mind shake off all the cobwebs of shore. Feast on the impossible beauty of liquid sunsets, and let your soul dance with the dolphins in the spray off the bow.
items.tourOgTitle: Ocean Crossing

items.title: Star Collector: Hearty Ports & Rum Punches - A Transatlantic Crossing
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to Philipsburg, St
items.tourMetaDescription: Cruise from Portugal across the Atlantic to white Caribbean beaches, vibrant tropical fish and savory West Indies cuisine during this 19-day transatlantic crossing. Relax, unwind and refocus with back-to-back spa days throughout your ocean crossing and dine on award-winning meals. Relive history while sailing aboard a former America's Cup competition sailboat or cook up delicious French meals with a certified chef in Philipsburg, St. Maarten. Roll out in offroad vehicles for an unrushed day of snorkeling on Tortola's secluded beaches. Swim and frolic with dolphins near Jost Van Dyke in the British Virgin Islands. Snorkel above colorful coral and dizzying schools of curious fish on Virgin Gorda in the British Virgin Islands. Glide over a sunken ship in a semi-submersible and take in a glowing Caribbean sunset during a catamaran cruise off Gustavia's tropical beaches on St. Barts.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Hearty Ports & Rum Punches - A Transatlantic Crossing

stops.port: Virgin Gorda / Prickly Pear, British Virgin Islands

items.title: Hidden Gems of the Canary Islands & Madeira
items.journeyText: Journey from Santa Cruz De Tenerife to Santa Cruz De Tenerife on Wind Spirit 10 Days Nov 09 – Nov 19, 2027 10 Days Nov 19 – Nov 29, 2027 10 Days Nov 29 – Dec 09, 2027 SEE ALL 11 DATES Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Columbus slept here, Winston Churchill painted here, and Agatha Christie wrote here, but you don’t have to be famous to fall in love with this place. This volcanic archipelago off the coast of Africa can and does charm everyone who visits, although it’s not the same charm for all. Some admire the diversity and drama of the landscapes, a tapestry of smooth and rough, black and green, blue and gold. Others are wooed by quaint colonial towns built a century before Columbus sailed, their cobbled streets lined by dry-stone homes with hand-carved wooden balconies. Sip a glass of sweet and citrusy poncha. Ride wicker toboggans, camels and classic cars. Breathe in air scented with orange, oleander and eucalyptus. And gaze at stars so numerous and bright they seem to put galaxies within reach.
items.tourOgTitle: Hidden Gems of the Canary Islands & Madeira

items.title: Star Collector: Journey of the South Pacific Seafarer
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Benoa (Denpasar), Bali on Star Breeze 49 Days Nov 18 – Jan 06, 2027-2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This far-reaching South Pacific journey links French Polynesia’s reefs and volcanic peaks with cultures and coastlines stretching deep into Indonesia. Start among the Tuamotus, the Marquesas, and the Society Islands before moving on to Aitutaki’s lagoon, Tonga’s shoreline, and Fiji’s national parks. Continue through Vanuatu’s Melanian Cultures and onward to the Solomon Islands and Papua New Guinea, where WWII history and local traditions provide meaningful context. A call in East Timor offers coastal viewpoints and Portuguese-influenced heritage, while Komodo provides a rare chance to see the island’s famed dragons. The voyage concludes in Bali, ideal for spending extra time here to explore both its famed resorts and temples such as Uluwatu.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Journey of the South Pacific Seafarer

items.title: Star Collector: Grand South Pacific Adventure
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Singapore on Star Breeze 53 Days Nov 18 – Jan 10, 2027-2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Journey across 26 different ports and some of the Pacific’s most compelling island groups, with overnights in Bora Bora, Papeete, Fiji and Bali, plus repeated calls to Moorea for unhurried exploration. Travel from French Polynesia’s biosphere reserves, the Marquesas’ dramatic valleys, and the Cook Islands’ lagoons to Tonga’s royal landmarks and Fiji’s volcanic highlands. Continue into Vanuatu, the Solomon Islands, and Papua New Guinea, where waterfalls, traditional cooking, and marine biodiversity reveal the region’s depth. Crossing into East Timor and Indonesia brings striking contrasts, including Komodo’s rugged terrain and Bali’s cultural traditions. Ample sea days—including a short 3-night crossing of Java Sea—providing restorative space to read, work on passion projects, recharge, or simply enjoy open-ocean quiet.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Grand South Pacific Adventure

items.title: Star Collector: Caribbean Explorations
items.journeyText: Journey from Philipsburg, St
items.tourMetaDescription: Skip the usual Caribbean cruise stops and discover the small harbors, overlooked havens and most remote secrets among the Leeward Islands. Whether you’re looking for hidden shops, sampling new cuisine or seeking a local place to sip rum cocktails over the melodic beat of steel drums, this highly personalized adventure is an intimate opportunity to familiarize yourself with the lesser-known charms of Barbuda, Soper’s Hole in Tortola, Gustavia in St. Barthémy, St. Lucia’s Pigeon Island and much more.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Caribbean Explorations

items.title: Beach Fun & Sun: A Remote Caribbean Getaway
items.journeyText: Journey from Philipsburg, St
items.tourMetaDescription: Bask on remote beaches resplendent in natural beauty during this relaxing and uncrowded getaway to secluded Caribbean destinations Windstar specializes in. Board a private speedboat bound for Little Bay, Anguilla’s smallest and most private beach, then snorkel among flitting grunts, wrasses and snappers. Guide your own rigid inflatable boat (RIB) through Sir Francis Drake Waterway bays and isles around Jost Van Dyke. Sink in solitude to the silent depths where an 1867 steamship rests, an iconic Tortola dive site that doubled as an underwater movie set. Embark from our yacht’s onboard Marina Platform on your own self-directed snorkeling and kayaking adventures. Find the warm sunset twilight during an overnight port stay at Virgin Gorda. Windstar invites you to join us for our private Signature Beach Party, a fun in the sun affair, full of the rhythm and joy of the Caribbean.
items.tourOgTitle: Beach Fun & Sun: A Remote Caribbean Getaway

items.title: Star Collector: Caribbean Islands & Colombian Coast Discovery
items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Colon on Star Pride 14 Days Nov 22 – Dec 06, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Trace a route shaped by early explorers, coastal trade routes, and the natural beauty of the southern Caribbean. Visit San Juan, Santo Domingo, Cartagena, and Santa Marta—four of the New World’s oldest cities—then snorkel Isla Catalina’s well-known reef and the coral gardens of Les Saintes. An overnight in Cartagena lets you explore its walled quarters after the day-trippers leave. Farther south, rainforest hikes, calm anchorages, and island communities like Bequia and Les Saintes offer a more relaxed rhythm. Together, the journey brings historical context and Windstar-style access to a wide sweep of the Caribbean.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Caribbean Islands & Colombian Coast Discovery

items.title: Star Collector: Windward Islands, Spanish Cities & Costa Rica
items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Puerto Caldera, San Jose' on Star Pride 21 Days Nov 22 – Dec 13, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Begin among the Windward Islands, sailing into St. George’s, Bequia, Mayreau, and Les Saintes, where coral-rich waters, quiet anchorages, and easygoing beaches set the tone for the opening days of your journey. Continue on toward Isla Catalina, Santo Domingo, and an overnight in Cartagena, exploring colonial plazas, sea-worn fortifications, and offshore islands known for excellent snorkeling and diving. From the San Blas Islands to Colón, the route carries you through remote stretches of coastline before your daylight transit of the Panama Canal offers a rare, close-up perspective. The voyage concludes along Costa Rica’s Pacific shore, with time in Isla Parida, Golfito, Puerto Jiménez, and Quepos—places where rainforest trails, calm bays, and abundant wildlife reward unhurried exploration.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Windward Islands, Spanish Cities & Costa Rica

items.title: Classic Caribbean
items.journeyText: Journey from Philipsburg, St
items.tourMetaDescription: From the lush volcanic landscapes of Nevis Peak to the captivating charm of Les Saintes; hidden coves and secret beaches to exotic markets and lively cafés, you’ll discover the best of this region on a single Caribbean voyage. Sandy beaches, turquoise waters, verdant hills, and beautiful waterfalls blend seamlessly with the music, flavors, and joie de vivre that define Caribbean life.
items.tourOgTitle: Classic Caribbean

items.title: Star Collector: Coffee, Canal & Callaloo: Central America, Columbia & the Caribbean
items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Puerto Caldera, San Jose' on Star Pride 14 Days Nov 29 – Dec 13, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Combine Central America’s majestic natural scenery with Caribbean small-port charms during this 2-week cruise through Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico. Learn the ecological importance of cloud forests from an engaging naturalist as you search leafy rainforest canopies for sleepy sloths, rare birds and skittering primates. Dive, swim and hike among the refreshing tropical splendors of Windstar’s Signature Beach Party on Panama’s Isla Parida archipelago. Discover the engineering challenges and triumphs during a narrated daylight transit of the Panama Canal. Sink your teeth in doughy, cheese-stuffed Arepas paired with rich, fresh-roasted artisan coffees at a Colombian café. Wander the length of El Morro’s fortress walls in San Juan, Puerto Rico, a former sanctuary for New World seafarers and daring smugglers aligned with the Spanish Empire.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Coffee, Canal & Callaloo: Central America, Columbia & the Caribbean

items.title: The Spanish Main: Rise of the New World
items.journeyText: Journey from San Juan to Colon on Star Pride 7 Days Nov 29 – Dec 06, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: History buffs, beach bums, and xenophiles will all find something to celebrate on this unique itinerary to Central America and the Caribbean. Discover the barely inhabited tropical islands and private gleaming white-sand beaches. Step back in time to the days of the Spanish Empire as you visit four of the oldest cities in the Americas. Explore forts pockmarked by time and cannon balls. Encounter pirate lore as you dive the wreck of Captain Kidd’s ship off Isla Catalina. And relive it all over mofongo and rum in Old San Juan.
items.tourOgTitle: The Spanish Main: Rise of the New World

items.title: Flowers of the South Pacific: Fiji, the Cook Islands & French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Lautoka, Viti Levu on Star Breeze 15 Days Dec 02 – Dec 17, 2027 15 Days Jul 27 – Aug 11, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Remote beaches and rich Polynesian culture abound throughout this iconic South Pacific voyage to Fiji, Tonga, the Cook Islands, and French Polynesia, where you’ll experience the pristine beauty of turquoise lagoons, white-sand beaches, and vibrant coral reefs. On Rarotonga, join a guided nature trek, where you’ll learn about the island’s culture and history from a local. Explore the subterranean splendors of 'Ana Hulu in Tonga, a coral limestone cavern concealing centuries-old freshwater lakes, or wander scenic rainforest paths in Taveuni's Bouma National Heritage Park. Indulge in sweet cocoa farm treats during a delicious tree-to-bar tour on Vana Levu, or dine on Fijian fish dishes and tropical fruit cocktails. Rekindle romantic magic at beachside resort accommodations during an overnight stay on Bora Bora, and allow flowers to perfume the air as you sail into a fiery sunset.
items.tourOgTitle: Flowers of the South Pacific: Fiji, the Cook Islands & French Polynesia

items.title: Star Collector: Polynesia, Melanesia & Indonesia Discovery
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Benoa (Denpasar), Bali on Star Breeze 35 Days Dec 02 – Jan 06, 2027-2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail through French Polynesia to and the volcanic archipelagos of Melanesia and Indonesia. Lagoon-rich islands like Moorea, Bora Bora, Aitutaki, and Rarotonga offer reef exploration, mountain scenery, and Polynesian cultural traditions. Fiji adds rainforest waterfalls on Taveuni, geothermal activity in Savusavu, and quiet village beaches in the Yasawa Islands. Farther west, Vanuatu’s waterfalls and Champagne Bay’s clear shallows meet the WWII history of Guadalcanal and the coastal traditions of Papua New Guinea, including the pristine reefs of the Conflict Islands. Dili introduces Portuguese-influenced architecture, while Indonesia combines Komodo’s wildlife with Bali’s temples and dynamic food culture.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Polynesia, Melanesia & Indonesia Discovery

items.title: Star Collector: Legacy of Pacific Wayfinders
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Singapore on Star Breeze 39 Days Dec 02 – Jan 10, 2027-2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Traverse an extensive arc of the Pacific and Southeast Asia, connecting French Polynesia, the Cook Islands, Tonga, Fiji, Melanesia, Indonesia and Singapore. Along the way, explore lagoon-rich islands such as Moorea, Bora Bora and the Cook Islands; discover the cultural depth of Tonga and Fiji; and experience the dramatic coastlines and community traditions found throughout Vanuatu, the Solomon Islands, and Papua New Guinea, including Champagne Bay and the Conflict Islands.  Farther west, encounters in Dili and Komodo reveal the landscapes and wildlife of East Timor and Indonesia, followed by an overnight in Bali to explore its Hindu temples, local artisans, and renowned resort areas.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Legacy of Pacific Wayfinders

items.title: Star Collector: Atlantic Crossing to the Virgin Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Lisbon to San Juan on Star Legend 21 Days Dec 06 – Dec 27, 2027 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This extended Atlantic-to-Caribbean sailing follows a rare winter route that links Europe, the open ocean, and the islands of the eastern Caribbean in one continuous journey, with experiences shaped by both destination and time at sea. Begin in Lisbon with its historic neighborhoods and riverfront cafés, then pause in Madeira for botanical gardens, coastal walks, and views from Monte. A true transoceanic crossing follows, offering days to settle into shipboard life before landfall in the Caribbean. Once there, small-ship access opens the door to snorkeling off Jost Van Dyke, beach time at Virgin Gorda’s Prickly Pear, exploring colonial streets in San Juan, and dining ashore in Gustavia after sunset. Cruz Bay and Basseterre invite hiking, sailing, and easy island exploration, creating a journey defined by variety, distance, and unhurried discovery.

items.tourMetaDescription: Journey across 26 different ports and some of the Pacific’s most compelling island groups, with overnights in Bora Bora, Papeete, Fiji and Bali, plus repeated calls to Moorea for unhurried exploration. Travel from French Polynesia’s biosphere reserves, the Marquesas’ dramatic valleys, and the Cook Islands’ lagoons to Tonga’s royal landmarks and Fiji’s volcanic highlands. Continue into Vanuatu, the Solomon Islands, and Papua New Guinea, where waterfalls, traditional cooking, and marine biodiversity reveal the region’s depth. Crossing into East Timor and Indonesia brings striking contrasts, including Komodo’s rugged terrain and Bali’s cultural traditions. Ample sea days—including a short 3-night crossing of Java Sea—providing restorative space to read, work on passion projects, recharge, or simply enjoy open-ocean quiet.

items.title: Star Collector: Polynesia, Melanesia & Indonesia Discovery
items.journeyText: Journey from Benoa (Denpasar), Bali to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 34 Days Jan 28 – Mar 02, 2028 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail through French Polynesia to and the volcanic archipelagos of Melanesia and Indonesia. Lagoon-rich islands like Moorea, Bora Bora, Aitutaki, and Rarotonga offer reef exploration, mountain scenery, and Polynesian cultural traditions. Fiji adds rainforest waterfalls on Taveuni, geothermal activity in Savusavu, and quiet village beaches in the Yasawa Islands. Farther west, Vanuatu’s waterfalls and Champagne Bay’s clear shallows meet the WWII history of Guadalcanal and the coastal traditions of Papua New Guinea, including the pristine reefs of the Conflict Islands. Dili introduces Portuguese-influenced architecture, while Indonesia combines Komodo’s wildlife with Bali’s temples and dynamic food culture.
items.tourOgTitle: Star Collector: Polynesia, Melanesia & Indonesia Discovery

items.title: Star Collector: Journey of the South Pacific Seafarer
items.journeyText: Journey from Benoa (Denpasar), Bali to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 48 Days Jan 28 – Mar 16, 2028 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: This far-reaching South Pacific journey links French Polynesia’s reefs and volcanic peaks with cultures and coastlines stretching deep into Indonesia. Start among the Tuamotus, the Marquesas, and the Society Islands before moving on to Aitutaki’s lagoon, Tonga’s shoreline, and Fiji’s national parks. Continue through Vanuatu’s Melanian Cultures and onward to the Solomon Islands and Papua New Guinea, where WWII history and local traditions provide meaningful context. A call in East Timor offers coastal viewpoints and Portuguese-influenced heritage, while Komodo provides a rare chance to see the island’s famed dragons. The voyage concludes in Bali, ideal for spending extra time here to explore both its famed resorts and temples such as Uluwatu.

items.title: Winter in Croatia & Greece
items.journeyText: Journey from Venice to Piraeus, Athens on Star Explorer 8 Days Feb 06 – Feb 14, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover the Adriatic and Greece from new perspectives during this 8-day cruise that touches on storied landmarks and intimate, little-known ports on the Adriatic Sea and in Greece. Admire Zadar’s Medieval city walls and charming boutiques. Learn about the global success of Croatian organic vineyards as you sample wines in a farming village. Take in Dubrovnik’s Old Town charms from the heights of a cable car. Savor local smoked hams, sausages and homemade cheeses on a Montenegro olive farm tour outside Kotor. Transit the tapered, sheer-walled Corinth Canal, a time-saving dream of the rulers of antiquity. This Adriatic-to-Greece odyssey ends in Athens, among the shadows of the Parthenon, silent monuments to ancient athletic competitions and the savory aroma of souvlaki, seasoned and skewered grilled meats wrapped in pita bread and sold in countless cafés and sidewalk restaurants.
items.tourOgTitle: Winter in Croatia & Greece

items.title: Flowers of the South Pacific: Fiji, the Cook Islands & French Polynesia
items.journeyText: Journey from Lautoka, Viti Levu to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 14 Days Feb 17 – Mar 02, 2028 CALL FOR AVAILABILITY VIEW DETAILS
items.tourMetaDescription: Remote beaches and rich Polynesian culture abound throughout this iconic South Pacific voyage to Fiji, Tonga, the Cook Islands, and French Polynesia, where you’ll experience the pristine beauty of turquoise lagoons, white-sand beaches, and vibrant coral reefs. On Rarotonga, join a guided nature trek, where you’ll learn about the island’s culture and history from a local. Explore the subterranean splendors of 'Ana Hulu in Tonga, a coral limestone cavern concealing centuries-old freshwater lakes, or wander scenic rainforest paths in Taveuni's Bouma National Heritage Park. Indulge in sweet cocoa farm treats during a delicious tree-to-bar tour on Vana Levu, or dine on Fijian fish dishes and tropical fruit cocktails. Rekindle romantic magic at beachside resort accommodations during an overnight stay on Bora Bora, and allow flowers to perfume the air as you sail into a fiery sunset.

items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to Oranjestad, Aruba on Star Pride 14 Days Feb 21 – Mar 06, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Sail between Costa Rica and Aruba on an unforgettable journey showcasing the best of Latin America. Discover Costa Rica’s stunning Pacific coast with stops in Playa Flamingo, Punta Leona, wildlife-rich Quepos, and Puerto Jimenez. Enjoy beach barbecues on Panama’s secluded Isla Parida and the pristine sands of Isla Aroma in the San Blas Islands. Experience the marvel of the Panama Canal transit and explore Panama’s vibrant Bocas del Toro. Savor an overnight stay in Cartagena, Colombia, where you can wander its colorful colonial streets. This voyage combines the best of Costa Rica, Colombia and Panama for a true Latin America exploration.

items.title: Star Collector: Costa Rica, Panama & Aruba
items.journeyText: Journey from Puerto Caldera, San Jose' to San Juan on Star Pride 21 Days Feb 21 – Mar 13, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Experience a route that links Costa Rica’s national parks and quiet bays with Panama’s tropical islands. Spot squirrel monkeys in Manuel Antonio, zipline above the canopy in Playas del Coco, and explore coastal villages where local markets and wildlife refuges sit just steps apart. Continue to the San Blas Islands for reef snorkeling and time with the Kuna people before a full Panama Canal transit narrated by a canal expert. Arrive in Cartagena for an overnight that lets you explore its walled district after hours before continuing north to the ABC Islands, where time in Willemstad, Curaçao features pastel Dutch colonial architecture, floating markets, and calm coves ideal for swimming. Your journey continues to St. Barts, known for its bright turquoise bays and relaxed French-Caribbean ambiance, followed by visits to Jost Van Dyke and Virgin Gorda in the British Virgin Islands, where white-sand beaches and iconic granite boulders offer some of the most picturesque settings in the Caribbean.

Explore Italy and Sicily with their fabulous food, wine and culture – with major players like Rome, Naples, and overnights in Venice, Catania and Crotone, a small town with a surprisingly rich and colorful history. Walk Dubrovnik’s storybook Old Town and get to the heart of Croatian culture with visits to village homes and cottage industries, cooking classes, olive oil tastings and more. Whether you’re learning to cook Neapolitan pizza in the shadow of Mt. Vesuvius or discovering the lost art of silk production in Dubrovnik, you’ll experience the most intimate and authentic version of the Mediterranean.

items.tourMetaDescription: Begin along the southern Caribbean coast, where time in Cartagena reveals centuries of fortifications and plazas, and the San Blas Islands introduce clear shallows, local communities, and a chance to enjoy the Marina. Bocas del Toro adds wildlife-rich mangrove channels before your daylight Panama Canal transit offers an up-close look at locks, lakes, and the workings of this crucial passage. From Panama, the journey shifts toward the islands off South America and the northern Caribbean. Explore Aruba’s Dutch-Caribbean architecture, Curaçao’s backcountry tracks, and Bonaire’s protected reefs. Continue to Gustavia, Jost Van Dyke, and Virgin Gorda for beaches, snorkeling, and classic small-ship anchorages before concluding in San Juan.

items.title: Panama Canal, Cartagena, San Blas Islands & More
items.journeyText: Journey from Fuerte Amador, Panama City to Oranjestad, Aruba on Star Pride 7 Days Feb 28 – Mar 06, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: It’s something of an insider secret: cruises that many Panama Canal travelers overlook when exploring the extreme southern edge of the Caribbean. But those who explore beyond the traditional islands know that this is where you find the epicenter of colonial history and amazing biodiversity. This is the heart of the Spanish Main, where untold wealth boarded galleons bound for Europe and colonial forts thwarted off pirate attacks. It’s the narrow isthmus that holds the Panama Canal, an epic engineering feat. And it’s the home of indigenous tribes like the Kogi, the Ngobe-Buglé and the Kuna, who have managed to maintain their traditional ways of life. These shores are also some of the most beautiful and biodiverse on earth, home to marine-rich coral reefs and subterranean bat caves.You don’t have to go far to find untouched islands or jungle-shrouded channels. All this in seven days, on a ship perfectly designed for adventure.
items.tourOgTitle: Panama Canal, Cartagena, San Blas Islands & More

items.title: Winter in Italy and the Adriatic
items.journeyText: Journey from Civitavecchia, Rome to Piraeus, Athens on Star Explorer 8 Days Mar 01 – Mar 09, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Discover a different side of the Mediterranean, with this itinerary that offers a perfect combination of small towns and large, major attractions and new discoveries. Learn to cook authentic Croatian dishes or have a favorite vintage at a Sicilian winery. Discover gems like Preveza and Crotone  – small towns that give you access to a unique Vlatch culture and one of the most beautiful medieval villages in Italy . From Crotone, discover Castello Aragonese located in nearby Le Castella or Santa Severina, one of the most beautiful ancient villages in Italy.  Preveza serves as the gateway to multiple archaeological sites, including the ancient city of Nikopolis. Transit the narrow Corinth Canal to Itea and visit the UNESCO site of Delphi.  Take your time and explore the Acropolis, Pompeii, the Sistine Chapel and Corfu’s Old Town. Spend the night in Catania with a view of Mt. Etna.
items.tourOgTitle: Winter in Italy and the Adriatic

items.title: Star Collector: Windward Islands, ABC Islands & the Virgin Island
items.journeyText: Journey from Oranjestad, Aruba to San Juan on Star Pride 14 Days Mar 06 – Mar 20, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: This extended Caribbean route follows a steady arc from the Windward Islands into the ABC Islands and onward to the British Virgin Islands. Days unfold in Grenada, Bequia, and St. Lucia, where volcanic peaks, protected bays, and easy access to snorkeling and diving shape the rhythm of the voyage. Les Saintes adds remarkable underwater visibility before the itinerary shifts south toward Aruba, Curaçao, and Bonaire for reef exploration and backcountry adventures. Northbound, time in Gustavia, Jost Van Dyke, and Virgin Gorda highlights classic small-ship anchorages and shoreline trails, including the granite formations of the Baths. The journey concludes in San Juan after visiting some of the Caribbean’s most distinctive coastlines and island cultures.

items.tourMetaDescription: Travel through three distinct Caribbean regions on a route that offers broad geographic range and access to smaller ports. In the Windwards, sample spices in St. George’s and explore Bequia’s maritime traditions before sailing toward the ABC Islands for protected diving sites and colorful coastal towns. Continue north to Gustavia’s boutiques, Jost Van Dyke’s laid-back coves, and Virgin Gorda’s iconic Baths, where trails weave through giant granite boulders. San Juan’s Old World architecture and dining complete the experience. Throughout the itinerary, contrasting islands—arid ABC reefs, lush Grenadine bays, and BVI anchorages used by private yachts—create a journey rich in local culture, shoreline activities, and opportunities to enjoy the advantages of small-ship travel.

items.journeyText: Journey from Philipsburg, St
items.tourMetaDescription: Cruise from Portugal across the Atlantic to white Caribbean beaches, vibrant tropical fish and savory West Indies cuisine during this 19-day transatlantic crossing. Relax, unwind and refocus with back-to-back spa days throughout your ocean crossing and dine on award-winning meals. Relive history while sailing aboard a former America's Cup competition sailboat or cook up delicious French meals with a certified chef in Philipsburg, St. Maarten. Glide over a sunken ship in a semi-submersible and take in a glowing Caribbean sunset during a catamaran cruise off Gustavia's tropical beaches on St. Barts.

items.title: Star Collector: Marquesas, Tuamotus & Society Islands
items.journeyText: Journey from Papeete, Tahiti to Papeete, Tahiti on Star Breeze 21 Days Oct 05 – Oct 26, 2028 Starting from Per person, based on double occupancy
items.tourMetaDescription: Go farther into French Polynesia on a voyage that spans the Society Islands, Tuamotus, and the dramatic Marquesas. With extended time in both Fakarava and Rangiroa, explore two of the South Pacific’s most celebrated atolls—drift snorkeling through shark-filled passes in Fakarava’s UNESCO-listed biosphere and navigating Rangiroa’s famed Tiputa Pass with expert guides. In the Marquesas, step ashore in Omoa on Fatu Hiva, where tapa cloth is still crafted by hand, visit the monumental tiki at Lipona Me’ae on Hiva Oa, and explore Nuku Hiva’s storied Taipivai Valley. Throughout the Society Islands, enjoy an overnight in Bora Bora, a private beach celebration on a secluded motu, and time in Moorea’s Cook’s Bay, framed by soaring green peaks.
